tei:div.tei:p: rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ / thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/ / rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing*/ / thugs rje'i dbang gi sna tshogs skur sprul nas/ / lhag bcas 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ / legs par sgrol mdzad rje btsun ma la 'dud/ / shes bya'i gnas rnams gsal bar legs ston ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ / srid gsum 'gro ba sdug bsngal las skyob skyob pa dam pa'i chos/ / tshogs gnyis sog pa'i zhing mchog mchog gyur 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag la legs par rab dang dngas pa'i sems kyi 'dud/ / bla ma'i rnam thar yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung dbyangs rgya mtsho yis/ / bskal pa rgya mtshor brjod kyang mi zad na/ / blo dman bdag 'dra'i spyod yul ma yin kyang*/ / dad mos 'dab shog ldan pa'i bung ba'i tshogs/ / bskul tshig snyan sgra dar dir sgrog pa dang*/ / rang gi dad pa'i dran pa gso phyir dang*/ / gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas kun blangs nas/ / bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar pad mo'i tshal/ / legs bshad 'od zer 'phros pas kha phye ste/ / dad yod ldan pa'i bung ba'i tshogs rnams la/ / ngo mtshar sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed phyir rtsom/ / de la bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rnam par thar pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' dag ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis kyang bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par yang brjod par mi nus te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ni cig car la lar sgo mang brgya nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ / la lar skye ba mi snang la lar skye ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs dang*/ / la lar byang chub la lar de ni mya ngan 'das ston kyang*/ / de ni gnas de las kyang rnam par g.yo mi mnga' la thams cad mdzad// ces gsungs pa ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sa bcu gnyis kyis dbang phyug tu gyur te/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas tshar nas/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ da gzod sprul pa'i sku tshogs pa bstan te/ skad cig 'ga' la zhing khams la lar ni lhums su 'jug la lar ni sku bltams/ la lar gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad/ la lar ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ la lar ni rab tu byung nas dka' ba spyad/ la lar ni bdud btul nas sangs rgyas/ la lar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston/ de bzhin du dag pa'i zhing khams la lar ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ kyai rdo rje dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ la lar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ la lar tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ la lar grub thob dang*/ paṇḍi ta dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag dang/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa dang*/ sman dang bya dang nya dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpas 'dul ba la byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par rol pa/ mdor na gdul bya gang dang gang thabs gang gis 'dul ba la de dang de'i tshul bzung nas/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya la mtha' yas pa'i skad kyis mtha' yas pa'i chos ston par nus pa'i mtha' yas pa'i skye ba bzung ste/ bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams lam gyi rten dang lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god par mdzad pa las/ zhing 'dir skal ba dman par gyur pa'i sems can gdul ba'i phyir/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse dang 'phrin las cig tu bsdus te/ bdag cag la sogs pa kha cig gi snang tshul du tha mal pa ltar rigs mthun par sprul te lam sbyong ba'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa'i yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas kyang chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te/

bla ma'i yon tan don la gnas pa la sgro btags skur pa ma btab snyan ngag gi ma bsgribs par go bde ba'i tshul du brjod na/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal sras lag len 'di spyir gyis mdo rgyud thams cad snying po btus pa lta bu'am/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi phyag len mdor bsdus pa yin zhing*/ khyad par du sems chen po nyid kyis phyag len dang mdzad spyod kyi rnam par thar pa rags rim 'di nyid la tshang bas/ 'di nyid la rnam thar gyis spyad du byas nas/ bshad tshod phyag len gyi rnam thar cig tu sbyar te/ rgyal sras lag len gyi don gyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa pad mo'i tshal zhes kyang bya/ rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes kyang bya ba mtshan gnyis dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyis ston pa la thog mar bsdus don cung zhig bsnyad na/ rgyal sras lag len la don gsum ste/ mchod par brjod cing brtsam par dam bca' ba dang*/ brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin/ mjug gi don bsdu ba'o/ / gnyis pa la sngon 'gro chos la 'jug tshul dang*/ dngos gzhi skyes bu gsum gyi lam bstan pa/ sngon 'gro chos la 'jug tshul la bdun las/ dus gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len/ rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa spangs pa'i phyag len/ mthun rkyen bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phyag len/ yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten pa'i phyag len/ mi rtag pa 'khrungs pas tshe blos btang ba'i phyag len/ slu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len no/ / dang po dus gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len la yang lnga ste/ dal 'byor gyi ljon shing yul gang du rigs rus gang las 'khrungs pa'i 'khrungs tshul/ de nyid tshogs gnyis kyis brlan dang ldan pa'i yab yum gang gis bskyed pa'i skyed tshul/

de nyid byams pa'i nyi 'od dang ldan pa'i ma mas skyed bsrings pa'i bsring tshul/ dang po nyid nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i sad tshul/ dug gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i byung tshul/ gnyis pa rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len la yang lnga las/ rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis thos bsam gnyis kyi grur zhugs te gsung rab rgya mtsho'i nang nas mkhyen gnyis kyi nor bu blangs pa'i blang tshul/ lung rigs kyi mche sder dang ldan pa'i ri dwags dbang pos phas rgol gyi glang po bcom tshul/ /don gnyis kyi nor bu blangs pa'i phyir so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi grur zhugs te thar pa'i ba dan btsugs pa'i tshugs tshul/ gzhung lugs kyi pad tshal legs bshad kyi tsha zer kyis phye ste tshig don phun tshogs kyis sbrang rtsis blo gsal gyi bung ba tshims par mdzad pa'i mdzad tshul/ legs par bshad pa'i ldai mig gis gsung rab rin po che'i gter mdzod kha phye ba'i phye tshul lo/ / dngos gzhi skyes bu gsum gyi lam la/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bur rtogs pas rgyu mi dge ba la 'dzem pa'i phyag len/ skyes bu 'bring gis lam srid pa gsum gyis bde ba mi rtag par rtogs pas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i phyag len/ skyes bu chen po'i lam la bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa/ de dag gi bslab bya la bslabs pa gsum las/ byang chub kyi sems ni byams snying rje yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pas/ mnyam nyid kyi byams pa chen po mnga' ba'i mnga' tshul bzod med kyi snying rje chen po mnga' ba'i mnga' tshul/ bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len/ gnyis pa sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa la gnyis las/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la'ang*/

mnyam bzhag tu bdag gzhan brje ba sgom pa'i phyag len/ rjes thob tu rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba la/ mi 'dod pa'i chos bzhi/ bzod dka' gnyis/ 'byor rgud gnyis/ chags sdang gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len/ gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems la yang mnyam bzhag tu spros bral la 'dzin med sgom pa dang rjes thob tu chags sdang gi yul gnyis la bden zhen spang ba'i phyag len/ gsum pa de dag gi bslab bya la bslab pa la lnga las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab pa'i phyag len/ mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi la bslab pa'i phyag len/ nyon mongs pa spong tshul bslab pa'i phyag len/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bsgrub pa la bslab pa'i phyag len la gsum las mdo rgyud nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bas/ gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dad mos kyi chu gtsang gis gang ba'i gdul bya'i snod du sku gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar mdzad pas gzhan don sgrub tshul/ 'bad med lhun grub gyi 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gzhan don sgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba la bslab pa'i phyag len no/ / gsum pa mjug gi don bsdu ba la/ brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu/ rtsom byed kyi rnam par thar pa'i don bsdu ba gnyis/ rnam par thar pa'i don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams gdul ba dang*/ las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i phyir zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i bstan tshul/ de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul rnams kyi ston par byed pa las/ na mo lo ki sha ra ya/ gang gi chos kun 'gro 'ong med gzigs kyang*/ / 'gro ba'i don la cig tu brtson mdzad pa'i/ / bla ma mchog dang spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ / rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes mchod par brjod cing*/

phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / dam chos bsgrubs las byung ste de yang ni/ / de yi lag len shes la rag las pas/ / rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len bshad pa bya/ / zhes brtsam par dam bca' nas/ dang po yul gang du rigs rgyud gang las 'khrungs tshul ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ ma ga ta rdo rje'i gdan las byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i sa cha/ rnam thos bu'i pho brang bzhin du 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa/ sham bha la'i pho brang bzhin du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyud mar byon pa/ na len tra'i gtsug lag bzhin du mkhas grub du mas nye bar bsten pa/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang las/ lho nub dpag tshad phye dang gsum tsam bgrod pa na/ brag ri dkar po'i phreng bas kun nas bskor ba/ rtswa dang lo ma dang*/ 'bras bus brgyan pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ 'bab chu shel gong ltar dngas shing gtsang ma 'bab pa/ lo tog phun sum tshogs pa skye ba me tog dang*/ bai ḍūrya lta bu'i ne'u gsing sngon pos brgyan pa'i yid du 'ong ba phul byung brag skya zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs so/ /gdung rus ni tod yin thog pa'i rgyud pa bzang po yin ces grags so/ / chu dang me tog ljon zhing 'bras bu mdzes/ / ne gsing sngon po bai ḍūrya 'dras brgyan/ / yid 'ong yul der rigs rgyud phun tshogs pa'i/ / mi yi mchog gyur rgyal ba'i sras de 'khrungs/ /yab yum gyis bskyed pa'i tshul ston pa ni 'di ltar/ 'das ma 'ongs thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mngon par shes pa thogs pa med par mnga' ba des/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba/ dal 'byor gyi chos/ ha cang rigs che zhing mtho ba yang ma yin/ ha cang chung zhing dma' ba yang ma yin pa zhig tu sku 'khrungs na bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan par gzigs te/ yab ni/ dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ 'khor dang ma nus pa la byams pa/

khengs pa dang nga rgyal chung zhing shes rab che bar gyur pa dkon mchog dpal zhes bya ba dang*/ yum ni/ skar ma'i nang na zla ba bzhin du bud med kyi nang na rnam par mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ za ma bud med kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa 'bum sgron zhes bya ba gnyis kyis sras su sprul te/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug stong mo mon mo gos kyi dbon rgyud du sku 'khrungs so zhes grags so/ /lhums su zhugs pa'i dus na yum la spyan ras gzigs rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor lus la thim pa'i rmi nyams dang ldan cing*/ sad pa'i tshe na nyams gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thugs la shar/ lus bde zhing yang ba dang*/ byams snying rje 'bad rtsol med par skye ba byung ngo zhes grags so/ /zla grangs thim thim gyi bar du lhums su bzhugs nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i sems can du ma'i don mdzad cing bltams pa'i dus na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor phyir byung nas zhing sbyangs/ sems can smin par byas nas slar dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i snang ba dang*/ sngar med pa'i dri zhim po bsnam pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra snyan pa grags pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang*/ phyi rol du yang sngar mi skye ba'i rtswa dang*/ me tog la sogs pa skyes/ lo legs pa dang*/ yams nad 'khrug pa zhi ba la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma dang bcas nas sku 'khrungs te/ mtshan dkon mchog bzang po zhes gsol lo/ / rgyal ba 'bum phrag tu ma skyed pa'i yum/ / ma rig mun sel bstan pa'i sgron me dang*/ / dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpal las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ / dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po de la 'dud/ / gzhon nu yid 'ong 'khrungs pa la/ / dga' ldan gnas nas lha'i bus/ / me tog sogs kyis legs mchod pas/

/ sa phyogs de yang mchod rten 'gyur/ / yid 'ong gzugs mdzes mdangs ldan pa/ / sprin dkar steng nas glaug 'gyu'am/ / yang na dmigs med thugs rje yis/ / pad dkar bsdus nas gyon pa 'dra/ / gzhon nu de'i gsung snyan gyis/ / dri za'i glu dbyangs zil gyis mnan/ / thub pa'i bstan pa ma 'grib pa/ / yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba mtshar/ /byams pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i ma mas bskyed bsring tshul stan pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ sras rgyal bu don grub btsas nas zhag bdun na yum 'das pa bzhin du/ dgung lo gsum lon pa na yum 'das/ lnga lon pa na yab kyang 'das/ de dus nye ba kun gyis zangs mo che 'di bu 'di la zhog gzhan dngos po rnams yab kyi dge rtsa la gtong byas pas/ nga la cang mi dgos thams cad pa'i dge rtsa la thong gsungs nas/ dngos po gang 'dug yab kyi dge rtsa la btang*/ sems dpa' chen po yum gyi a phyi chos nyid 'dren gyi sar khrid de dgung lo lnga pa nas dgu'i bar du gsos/ de bar bya na yang ma chag par byin/ gces spras dang brtse gdung chen pos bskyangs pas shin tu dṛn che ba cig bdog gsungs/ rgyal sras de'i sku lus dang*/ / kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje dang*/ / zhabs tog byas pa'i dge ba gsum/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel/ /dang po nyid nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad tshul ston pa ni/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*/ / mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*/ / dge la yang dag spyod pa ni/ / rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni 'khrungs ma thag nas/ zhi ba dang*/ dul ba dang*/ nges pa dang*/ yid gzhungs pa dang*/ snying rje chen po'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing bu chung gi spyod pa las 'das pa zhig byung ste de yang skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin goms pa'i stobs kyis/ bu chung smra shes tsam gyi dus na nyin gcig yum gyi pang na bzhugs dus/

rlung po 'khor byed pa cig gis shing lo gcig nam mkha' la khyer song ba gzigs nas drag tu bshums pa la/ yum gyi ci byung dris pas/ de la phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ sems can cig nam mkha' la khyer song gsungs pa dang*/ sems can ma yin shing lo yin byas pas bshums pa'i 'phro bcad ces pa dang*/ ba mo 'byung dus snga dro cig sgor bzhud nas gos med par sgren mor byung bas/ yab kyi gos gar song byas/ snying rje ba'i 'khyags pa de 'dra la g.yogs nas yod zer khrid nas ltar phyin pas/ sngom pas gang ba'i sho phung ba mo skya khad pa zhig la gos g.yog pa mtha' la rdos mnan byas 'dug zer/ gzhon nu'i dus na bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems de lta bu dang*/ yang na bsgom byed pa yin zer nas sku rnam snang gi chos drug ldan du bcas nas nyin mtshan bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' ba byung zhes grag go /bshum pa'i dus na dpe cha shog 'khyar phyag tu gtad pa dang*/ shin tu mnyais shing bshum 'phro chad pa dang*/ byis pa gzhan mis brdungs tsa na bshum pa zhig yod ces grags so/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pas sa skyar gdan drangs dus 'phros pa'i gsung gleng byung dus su/ gong gi de lta bu rnams thos te bden lags sam zhus pas/ de ltar grags gda' te bdag rang gi ni mi dran lags zhus/ dran tsam na chos la gzhan gyi thu yugs la sogs mi gus pa byas tsa na mi bzod pa skye zhing*/ dang po byis pa'i dus rang nas khong khrau shas chung shing snying rje che ba gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang kha tshig min par skye ba zhig yod/ de stobs kyis su la'ang tshig ngan smra mi nus/ nga chung chung gi dus su sa skyar kar phubs kyi sgor tsar mi cig gi don med par mgo la brgyab pas skrang 'bur chen po byung yang khong khro ma skyes gsungs pa dang*/ byis pa gzhan dang rtse ba na/ gzhan pham nas ngus na bdag mi bzod cing*/

rang pham yang mya ngan tsam med pa yod gsungs pa dang*/ rtswa shing 'thu ru chas dus grogs kyis rnyed na rang gi ma rnyed kyang mi sdug rang gi rnyed kyang grogs kyis ma rnyed na khong tsho la pha ma sogs kyis 'thab tu yong bsam nas res 'ga' rang gi rnyed pa nas byin res 'ga' 'thu rogs byas gsung ba dang*/ byis pa'i dus rtse mos pher tsam na mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ chos 'chad pa dang sgom byed pa la sogs dge ba'i phyogs kyis dus 'da' ba zhig yod gsung zhes thos so/ / skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ / tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin goms pa'i mthus/ / gzhon nu'i dus nas stong nyid snying rje 'byongs/ / zas gtsang sras po de dang 'gran pa 'dra/ /

pha yul spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ / gnyen gyi phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo/ / dgra'i phyogs la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ / blang dor brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can/ / pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / ces gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ a phyi'i sa na bzhugs dus phyugs lug 'tsho ba la byon cing*/ a phyi la khral 'bab pa la/ ra lug bsad kyin hor 'dra la sha sprod pa dgos pa byung bas/ ra lug gsod sar khrid pa'i dus bshums shing 'chang nas snying rje ba yin mod gsungs te/ yun ring por 'khrid du mi 'jug par brgyal brgyal du bshums kyang*/ dbang med du khrid kyin bsad pa lan mang rab byas pas/ a phyis byams po byas kyang*/ de lta bu la yid 'byung zhing skyau ba skyes te/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su/ phyugs lug 'tsho sa nas bros te/ yab kyi pha spun bu ston pa rin chen bkra shis kyi sar bsam gling du byon te/ yi ge 'bri 'don la sogs pa bslab pas/ rig pa'i gnas rnams mthong pa tsam gyis shes pa byung bas/ kun gyi 'di ni phal pa zhig ma yin nges zhes gleng ba byung zhes grag go / de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rab tu byung bas 'dzin par dgongs nas dgung lo bcu bzhi pa sprai'u'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i cha la bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud bla ma dpal 'bar bas mkhan po mdzad/ de'i gcung po mkhan po rin chen dpal bzang pas slob dpon mdzad/ grib tshod pa dge slong rin chen rdo rjes mdzad/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs nas/ bzang po dpal zhes mtshan gsol lo/ /de'i nyin par sngar med pa'i dri zhim pos khyab pa dang*/ rol mo'i snyan pa grags pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa kun gyis thun mong du grub par byung zhes grag go / rgyal bas rgyal srid spangs pa bzhin/ / rgyal sras pha yul rab spangs te/

/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad phyir/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa'i tshe/ / sngar med spos kyi dri zhim rnam par ldang*/ / rol mo'i sgra snyan nam mkha' dgod pa 'dra/ / lha'i me tog char pa bzhin du 'bab/ / sprin chen rnams kyang bla re bres pa mtshar/ /de lta bas na byang chub kyi sems gnyis goms pa'i phan yon bsngags pa dang*/ pha yul spangs pa dang rab tu byung ba'i yon tan bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las dug gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste dang po'o// // rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ dal 'byor gru chen rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir/ / bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ / nyin dang mtshan du g.yel ba med par ni/ / nyan sems sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btab stai/ dang po rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis thos bsam gyi grur zhugs te/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling nas mkhyen gnyis kyi nor bu blangs tshul ston pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /ston pa rin chen bkra shis kyis yi ge 'bri 'don btsun pa byed pa bshad gsar la sogs pa'i grogs byas pas drin che bar dgongs nas/ zhing khang rnams kyang a khu la gnang stai/ 'jig rten gyis bya ba la snying po med/ nga'i zhing dang nyid rang la gang yod kyis mi phongs tsam yod mchi/ gal te ma 'dang na ngas bsod snyoms byas nas kyang skyong ba yin/ sems las mi 'tshal ces zhal ta mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas ky-i bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin pa la/ bshad nyan gyis lung gi chos 'dzin sgom sgrub kyis rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin par dgongs nas dgung lo bco lnga pa'i dus bya lo la/ bo dong e bsam gling pa'i dgon lag yin pa'i stobs kyis/ e'i chos grwa chen por byon te/

bla ma kun dga' rgyal ba'i drung du dang por mngon pa kun las btus la nan tan mdzad/ de yang dang po nas dul ba dang zhi ba dang bzod pa dang byams pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pas/ grogs kyi slob gnyer la 'gran zla dang phrag dog gi dmigs rkyen du mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ gzhan las blo gros kyis nus pa chung zhing dman pa'i tshul bzung yang*/ skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas goms pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi lo mang po'i bar du 'bad pa bas mkhas par gyur te/ de dus 'jam dbyangs rong pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan bya ba na re/ mang ja'i tshogs gral du/ nyid btsun chung bzang po dpal dang bcas pa'i blo gsar ba rnams la nga 'dri ba bya rgyu yod do/ /mngon pa nas zang zing med pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal bya ba cig bshad 'dug stai/ zang zing med pa'i tshor ba yin na sdug bsngal yin pa'i dam bca' bud zer/ 'di la lan thob zer ba la/ 'di la gzhan gyis ni lan gang yang ma byung*/ de lta bu 'byung bar gzhung rang nas nyan thos dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig la zang zing ni med kyang las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin zhes sdug bsngal 'byung bar bshad yod dgongs nas/ de lugs kyi sgrub byed 'gal spong gsungs pas/ mkhas pa thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur te/ bla ma nam bkra ba bya ba na re/ nyid thogs med dngos su 'dug thogs med gnyis pa yin gsung la mchod par mdzod zer bas/ mchod par mdzad nas nga thogs med gnyis pa yin gsungs pas/ dus de nas bo dong thogs med ces mtshan yongs su grags so/ /gzhan yang byams pa'i chos lnga/ sa sde lnga sdom rnam gnyis/ pra kar ra ṇa sde brgyad rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa 'phags pa thogs med lta bur gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug bslab btus rnams dang*/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug la sogs pa dbu ma'i bstan bcos rnams dang*/ mdor na lung gi chos thams cad kyi tshig don la mkhas pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub lta bur gyur nas/

dpal ldan sa skyar byon te/ mkhas pa chen po bla ma gzhon rgyal bya ba'i drung du sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa la mkhas pa sbyangs shing*/ gtso bor tshad ma rnam nges la thugs sbyong mdzad cing*/ chos mchog rgyan/ lha dbang blo/ shākya blo dzña na shrī la sogs pa'i 'grel pa chen po rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa dpal chos kyi grags pa lta bur gyur te/ de dus sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas/ le lo'i dbang gis shas cher ma 'bad kyang*/ / 'on kyang kho bo'i blo dang phrad pa na/ / shes bya'i tshig don lhan cig dmigs nges yin/ /zhes gsungs so zhes grag go / rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis/ / thos bsam gnyis kyi grur zhugs te/ / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho chen po nas/ / mkhyen gnyis nor bu blangs pa mtshar/ /lung rigs kyi mche sder dang ldan pa'i ri dwags dbang pos phas rgol gyi glang po bcom tshul ston pa ni 'di ltar/ rigs pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa thogs pa med pas the tshom gyi tshogs bsgral bar nus pa grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa dang*/ sun 'byin gyi cha la snyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don la dbang 'byor pas chos dang chos ma yin pa na rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po des/ dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes pa'i dus su gtsang phyogs kyi chos grwa kun du grwa bskor mdzad nas/ lta ba log par 'dzin pa'i rgol ba ngan pa rnams lung rigs kyis sun phyungs te spobs pa med par byas/ lta ba phyin ci ma log par 'dzin pa rnams mthun phyogs su bsdus pas/ kun kha mthun par grwa skor ba byung ba la kun las shes rab che ba dang*/ ston pa bzang ba ma byung zhes gleng ba byung ngo zhes grag go /des na sde snod 'dzin pa gnam kyi skar ma tsam phyi nang du/ sems dpa' chen po nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba lta bur gyur te/ mkhas pa'i grags pas sa'i steng thams cad khyab par mdzad/

lung rigs kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa'i tshe na/ byams pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ klu sgrub rje 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ chos grags rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin gsungs nas/ thugs ngar mdzad pa cig yod ces grags so rnams gsung ngo*/ /dus phyis 'gol ba'i dus su mtshan nyid pa'i gsung gleng byung ba'i tshe/ 'o skol yang dgong mo thal 'gyur 'phen len byed rtsa na rig pa ngar pa cig bdog gsungs/ ri dwags dbus na seng ge ji bzhin du/ / mkhas mang rgya phrag du ma 'dus pa'i tshe/ / lung rigs nga ros phas rgol skrag mdzad pa'i/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba de la 'du/ /don gnyis kyis nor bu blang pa'i phyir so so thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi gru chen por zhugs te/ thar pa'i ba dan btsugs pa'i tshul ston pa ni/ bstan pa la zhugs nas yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por ma sgrub na/ so so thar pa'i las sgrub pa dang*/ las kyi cho ga la mi dbang ba dang*/ gsang sngags las kyang dge slong la bsngags pa che bar gzigs nas/ dgung lo sum cu pa byi ba'i lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes drug gi snga dro'i cha la/ mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen mgon dang*/ las kyi slob dpon bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ gsang ste ston pa bla ma kun dga' rgyan/ grib tshod pa slob dpon shākya byang chub dad pa'i dge 'dun dge slong rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis thog drangs pa rnams kyi dbus su e'i chos grwa chen por bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ dgra bcom pa chen po'i rnam par gyur te/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi nang nas gtsug gi nor bu lta bur 'gyur te/ lam mchog so so thar pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ / nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs kyis rab dben zhing*/ / nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ / sems dpa' khyed ni gnas brtan dgra bcom 'dra/ /gzhung lugs kyi pad tshal legs bshad kyi tsha zer gyis phyes te tshig don phun tshogs kyi sbrang rtsis blo gsal gyi bung ba tshim par mdzad tshul ston pa ni/

de yang 'di ltar/ nang du bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo du ma nyams su myong bar byed pa don dam par byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i ngang nas/ phyi ru bstan pa bzung ba'i phyir bshad nyan g.yel ba mi mnga' bar mdzad do/ /dus chos la phar tshad gnyis mngon pa kun las btus/ mdo sde rgyan rgyud bla ma spyod 'jug dang po ti drug drug gsungs/ zhar chos la bka' mdo rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa 'grel bshad/ man ngag gi skor mtha' yas pa rnams/ 'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis thog drangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho lta bu la gsungs shing*/ bshad nyan la gnod dogs nas gshin chog la sogs pa rnams la yang ma byon par/ bshad nyan la brtson pa'i stobs dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi nus pa dang*/ gzhung lugs 'chad pa na tshig don gsal zhing 'brel chags pa/ chad lhag med cing rna bar snyan pa'i tshig gis brda 'phrod pas nges shes skyed pa la gzhan las phul du phyin pa'i legs par bshad pa'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ nyan pa po'i mi shes pa'i dri ma bsal te/ blo gros kyi pad mo'i ze 'bru gsal bar mdzad pa la brten nas/ g.yu chu ba slob dpon kun rin bya ba dka' pod bcu gsum blo la 'chad pas thog drangs pa'i po ti mang po mkhyen pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang*/ grwa skor 'khor ba'i ston pa du ma zhig bton cing*/ bstan pa rin po che'i khur chen po 'khur ba'i dus su dgung lo so gnyis pa yos lo la 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched yum dang bcas pa dang*/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan kun spangs nam mkha' grags/ byang sems rin chen mgon rnams kyis rta ra'i gdan sa mdzad par zhu ba gsol ba la/ zhal bzhes ma mdzad pas/

bla ma mnur pa chos 'phags rgyan dang*/ rin po che shes rab 'bum pas kyang gdan sa mdzod gsungs pa'i zhal ta nan chen po mdzad pa/ bla ma'i bka' bcag par gyur dogs nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ byang sems rin mgon gyis dbu mdzad pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang shab tshang pa la gtogs pa'i dge bshes gra bu slob rnams kyis zhu 'bul byas pas chos grwa chen po e'i zur chen mdzad de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha'i skar ma tsam gyi dbus na/ sems dpa' chen po nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba ltar du ni mdzes/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang bzang ba'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du ni khyab/ 'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis thog drangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gtsug gi nor bu lta bur ni bskur/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis ni zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas/ 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa'i bya bas ni dus 'da'/ dbul phongs thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa char bzhin du ni 'bebs/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas rta ra'i gdan sa lo bdun mdzad ces grag go / mkhyen brtse'i tsha zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ / ma rig mun sel blo gros pad tshal 'byed/ / shes bya'i gnas rnams ji bzhin gsal bar ston/ / sems dpa' khyed ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /legs par bshad pa ldai mig gis gsung rab rin po che'i gter mdzod kha phye ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ 'di ltar thos te/ mngon pa kun btus la dpang lo'i ṭīkka gzhi byas nas brjod bya'i tshogs mang nyung 'dra ba la 'phral zhal gsal ba 'chad bde zhing go sla ba/ khyad par du las dang po la phan pa zhig bya dgos dgongs pa la/ dpang lo'i ṭīkka la gnod dogs nas ma mdzad/ snga gzhung la mchan zhib po zhig btab gsungs/ de dus phar tshad gnyis la'ang ṭīkka byas na legs rab yong bar gda' ste/

sgros gsar rnying dang de 'dra'i chags sdang gi rkyen du gyur dogs nas ma byas par phar phyin gyi gzhung la mchan cig btab gsungs/ dgung lo so brgyad pa la 'jam dbyangs don yod pas bskul nas/ mdo sde rgyan la ṭīkka mdzad/ khong gis bskul nas sbyar byas na/ stong sob tu song dogs nas ma byas/ 'di la dka' las kyang che rab byas nas brtsams te/ legs rab cig byung nas 'dug gsungs/ de'i rjes la rgyud bla ma'i ṭi kā mdzad/ de'i rjes la slob dpon grub rgyal ba'i don du spyod 'jug gi ṭīkka mdzad/ dpang lo'i drung du spyod 'jug su mkhas kyi gleng mo byung bas/ la la na re/ kyi ston pa mkhas zer/ dpang lo'i gsung ni mi mkhas/ spyod 'jug la bod gangs can gyi khraud na rgod tshangs pa dang*/ gu ru thogs med gnyis las mkhas pa med/ spyod 'jug gi don thams cad khong gnyis kyi rgyud la ldan pa yin gsung zhes grag go /bshad nyan mdzad dus slob dpon dang mched grogs 'ga' res/ phyag rdzas srab pa la grwa ba mang po skyong dgos pas lag len skor rnams skyong bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ lag len skyong na nga'i lag len de 'di lta bu zhig yin te dgongs nas rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len bshad par bya zhes lag len bshad/ bshad par bya zhes lag len gyi sgra la brten nas rang gzhan thams cad rgyal sras lag len la 'jug pa'i phyir rgyal sras lag len mdzad/ brtsams zin nas zhu dag la khang thog byon te mdun na bzhag yod pa'i dus/ rlung chen po cig byung nas khyer song bas shog bu gcig kyang ma rnyed/ de nas yang blo la gsal le 'dug pas ldab nas bris/ de phyogs thams cad du dar ba 'di'i rten 'brel yin pa 'dra gsungs/ de'i dus su snyung po cig byung ba la grwa pa rnams kyis zhal ta 'jog pa zhu zhus pas nga'i kha chems rgyal sras lag len yin gsung zer/ de nas thams cad kyis sku rim rgya chen po bsgrubs shing gsol ba btab pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la yun ring du bzhugs so/

/brtsam chos thor bu ba mdzad pa la 'jug pa sems bskye dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ smyung gnas rnams kyi cho ga blo sbyong*/ rten 'brel snying po skyid sdug lam khyer rnams kyi khrid yig /bla ma dang bla ma brgyud pa'i bstod pa/ rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras la bstod pa/ rang la bskul ba dang gzhan la gdabs pa snga rting yi ger thebs pa la brgya dang bcu gsum mdzad de/ sna tshogs rin chen gter kha phye ba ltar/ / don mang gzhung nyung 'dus pa gsal bar ston/ / sdeb legs bstan bcos rtsom pa'i mchog tu gyur/ / mkhas pa dpa' bo de dang 'gran pa 'dra/ / de bas na thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya zhing*/ rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par byas pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //

chos kyi 'gal rkyen grogs ngan spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ gang dang 'grogs na dug gsum 'phel 'gyur zhing*/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyam sa 'gyur la/ / byams dang snying rje med par bsgyur byed pa'i/ / grogs ngan spong bar rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / dgung lo nyi shu lon pa'i dus su ston pa nam rdor bya ba'i bshad slong kyis grogs la byon pas/ rnyed che bar yong*/ 'o skol gnyis ka bshad gsar ba yin byas nas rdzun byed dgos zer ba la/ sngon nas bden pa'i tshig smra ba la goms pas/ grogs ngan gyi dbang du ma btang bar rdzun mi zer gsungs pas/ khong yang dad nas nga la nyid lta bu'i grogs po yod pa zer nas bkur ba'i yul du 'dzin to zhes grag go /gzhan yang 'di ltar/ dper na smyaun pa la lam mkhan bcol na lam log tu 'khṛd pa las 'os med/ de bzhin du gang zag thos pa chung la lta ba mtho ba/ rgyud tshod dma' la spyod pa rtsing ba'i smyaun pa lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang*/ ne tsho smra mkhan bzhin du kha nas zab mo'i tshig bzang kham po che bshad kyin don gyi lag len med pas las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzems pa de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang*/ rje dpon ngan pa bzhin du slob mas bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog bag tsam chung shing 'gyangs pa dang*/ ko long sdom du yong la nor snying sdug re phul ba dang 'dzum yal yal yong la slob ma de chos bzhin byed mi byed mi blta bar 'phral gyi zas nor la dung nge byas pa de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang dper na bud med mo gsham bzhin du/ bla ma ngan pa re dang phrad pa na/ gzhan skyes bu dam pa kun gyis drung du 'gro mi ster khong rang gi drung du ji tsam bsdad kyang yon tan ci yang mi skye ba de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa rnams kyang grogs ngan yin te/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbang ler/

nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnam bral rdzas la rkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ / slob ma rnams ni slu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i lam las sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nga rgyal gyis khengs shing snying rje chung ba/ khong khro shas che ba gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams 'chol par spyod pa/ dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gi dkor la rngam zhing rdzas la zhen pa/ mdo rgyud phyin ci ma log pa'i thos pa med pas rmongs shing*/ yang dag pa'i man ngag med kyang yod par tshul 'chos pas slob ma slu ba/ bag med pas chang dang bud med la chags pa/ rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig phyin ci log tu 'chad pa'i bla ma'i ming btags rnams kyang*/ bdud kyi sprul pa'am grogs po yin pa'i phyir/ rgyang ring du spangs te/ rang byung gi grogs byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang*/ nam yang 'bral ba med par mdzod/ zla ba'i dkyil khor mun pa dang bral bzhin/ / bdud kyi grogs ngan ring du rab spangs te/ / grogs kyi mchog gyur byang chub sems gnyis dang*/ / nam yang 'bral ba med pa de la 'dud/ / mthun rkyen bshes gnyen dam pa bstain pa phyag len ston pa ni/ gang zhig bsten na nyes pa zad 'gyur zhing*/ / yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ / bshes gnyen dam pa rang gi lus las kyang*/ / gces par 'dzin pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu nor bzang gis theg pa chen pa'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa gcig bsten pa'i tshul ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'dis kyang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag bzhi dang 'gran gyi do zla bral ba'i yongs 'dzin rin chen gnyis rnams bsten te/

de yang thog mar shes bya rgya chen gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin bcu phrag cig ni 'di ltar dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i dus su/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston la/ sems bskyed/ phar tshad gnyis/ mngon pa/ gshin rje dgra nag gi mngon rtogs yum sgrub mi 'khrugs pa'i sgom bzlas rnams gsan/ bla ma kun rgyal ba la mngon pa kun las btus la sogs pa byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos skor rnams gsan/ 'jad rong pa 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan la tshad ma rnams nges gsan/ sa skya'i mkhas pa chen po bla ma gzhon rgyal ba la/ sde bdun 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma bkra shis mgon la mngon pa kun las btus gsan/ slob dpon shākya byang chub la phar phyin gsan/ khro phur tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon la/ yum rgyas pa brgyad stong pa brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs gsan/ 'jam dbyangs nyag gcig la/ nyi khri khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab sna tshogs/ shes rab khri ba/ nyi khri le mang*/ nyi khri snang ba/ le brgyad ma sa sde lnga rnams gsan no/ / pang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la/ sa sde lnga theg bsdus skor gsum/ mngon pa kun las btus/ thub pa dgongs rgyan rnam bshad rigs pa/ las sgrub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel/ dbu ma sgo rim sogs dbu ma'i skor/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs/ brgyad stong don bsdu/ de'i 'grel pa/ byang chub gzhung lam/ phung po lnga'i rab byed/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ sdud pa'i 'grail pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi mdzad pa rnams gsan/ gu shri rin chen seng ge la mngon pa kun las btus gsan no/ / shin tu bka' drin che ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig bsten tshul ni/ dgung lo lnga ba'i dus su bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud sangs rgyas dbon la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhus pas dbang bzhi'i don ngo 'phrod pa byung zhes grag go /bsam gling pa'i rin po che dpal 'bar ba dang*/

mkhan po rin chen dpal bzang po gnyis la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de'i bslab bya dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma mdo sde dpal ba la rnam rgyal sgrub thabs dang*/ gzungs sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gis las tshogs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed drag po'i rjes gnang*/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa gzer lnga'i gdams pa/ rnam dag gtsug nor sogs gsan/ bla ma mnur pa chos 'phags rgyal mtshan la/ yo ga'i skor gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' man ngag gi bka' thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ zab chos gsan/ byang sems rin chen mgon la bde mchog sgrol ma 'khor chen dgyes rdor dgra nag tshe dpag med/ kun rig rnams kyi dbang*/ byang chub dgongs brgyan/ theg bsdus skor gsum/ byams chos lnga rtsa 'grel/ nyi shu ba sum cu ba/ sems bskyed lan drug rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang*/ mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ a phyi ma'i gtor dbang gtor chog la sogs pa gsan/ bla ma ra sa ba rin chen gling pa la 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs zhus nas nyams len mdzad pas don spyod kyi shes rab chen por song gsungs/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po la snying po don gsum/ sems nyid ngal so khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i skor rnams gsan/ bla ma ri pa dpal she la/ zha ma nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po stod skor/ nā ro chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gsan/ kun spangs nam mkha' grags la/ bde mchog gi dbang lan gnyis dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs/ bslab btus mdo btus phyag rgya chen po gang gā ma gsan/ bla ma 'di la ni ma 'ongs pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' ste/ gzim khang chos rdzong rtsig rtsig pa'i bkod pa'i zhal ta ar po rnams la mdzad pa'i rtsa na sems dpa' chen po yang bzhugs pa la/ nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ btsun rgan blo ma khugs dgongs yod mchi ste/

khang pa 'di'i bed sus spyod mi shes so a gsung zhing*/ mkhar las grub nas dgun cig bzhugs pa dang sku bsnyung ste/ sems dpa' chen po gdan drangs nas nga'i tshig bzhi po 'di nyid kyis bsgral cig gsungs te/ nga ma shi bar rtsar bzhugs gsungs pa dang*/ shi nas zhe dgu'i bar cho ga re gyis gsungs pa dang*/ gzim khang 'di dang gzhis nas khal brgya thon pa gcig 'bul bas bzhes gsung ba la/ gzhis lo cig bsnams nas khong rang gi dus mchod la phul/ gzhan rnams gsung bzhin du bsgrubs te/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khang pa 'di grub nas khong pas dgun cig las ma bzhugs 'o skol gyis lo gsum cu rtsa grangs shig tu bed spyad 'dug de dus ma 'ongs pa'i mngon shes gsungs par gda' gsungs/ zab chos sna tshogs zhus pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig ni 'di ltar/ bla chen kun blo la sems bskyed rgyal sras lam bzang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug sogs gsan/ 'dzim pa'i bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho la/ 'khor chen dang sgrol ma'i rgya gzhung*/ don zhags skor rnams gsan/ de'i sku mched bla ma rdo rje dpal bzang la gzer lnga'i byin brlabs/ bshes springs la sogs gsan/ bla ma rin ye ba la 'jug pa sems bskyed/ byams chos lnga rtsa 'grel/ dpe chos dang man ngag rin spungs sogs gsan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pa la/ sgrol ma dang*/ bde chen ral gcig gi dbang*/ sems bskyed/ sa skya ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong min pa/ dbu ma chen po'i khrid rnams gsan/ mkhan bu ston pa la bde mchog gsang 'dus dpal chog rdor sems rnams kyi dbang*/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ṭīkka/ las chog gi ṭīkka rnams gsan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sems bskyed sgrol ma'i dbang*/ dril bu bskor gsum gyi lung*/ bde mchog mchod 'phreng*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa sum pa lo tsā'i snyan brgyud/ rnam rgyal gyi bstod pa/

tsanṭa go mis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ ra sa pa bla ma bsod nams lhun grub la gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma blo bzang ba la glang ri thang pa'i blau sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma gsan/ spyi bo lhas pa'i mkhan po shes rab rgyal grub bzang la/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa sogs gsan no/ / dag snang rgya chen sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig ni/ ti shri'i kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma mkhas btsun chen po bla chen bsod blo/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shar pa kun bsod/ drang po lung pa'i mkhan po thugs rje shes rab/ slob dpon dpal gyi mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge /bla ma rgyal po dpal ba bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos 'brel re yong gsungs/ 'gran gyi do zla bral ba'i yongs 'dzin rin chen gnyis ni 'di ltar/ bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ gnas brtan chen po'i sprul pa/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po mkhan rin po che bsod nams grags la/ mdo rgyud thams cad snying po/ man ngag thams cad kyi nying khu/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi lam theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhus pa'i dus su skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas dpon slob kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i rten 'brel gyi byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi dbyar gyi chu klung chen po'i rgyun bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klaung chen po 'khrugs nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi rgya mtsho chen por phyin te/ bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu las sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus lon te/ mkhan chen rin po che dang mjal ba na gnas brtan chen po zhig dang mjal ba'i snang ba yong gin 'dug gsungs/ jo bo rje'i bla ma gser gling pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i tshe phyag thal mo sbyor/ spyan chab 'don pa bzhin du/

mkhan chen rin po che'i mtshan brjod pa dang*/ phyag thal mo sbyar spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad nas nga'i bla ma de'i thugs rje de lta bu gzhan la rang med gsungs nas/ gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'dzin te/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ don zhags kyi skor/ sman bla'i rjes gnang dang mdo mchog /'dul ba mdo rtsa ri khrod ma lo gyon ma dang 'od zer can gyi gzungs jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sems skyed cho ga /dze ta ris mdzad pa la sogs pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa rigs gtad sogs skyer sgang ba'i chos skor rnams zhor nyan mdzad/ de'i rjes la 'jug pa sems bskyed sogs kyang zhus so/ / dang por rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par sbyangs shing*/ bar du rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po gnyis la goms par byas pas/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes nas 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med par mdzad pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa/ rin po che sher 'bum pa la/ rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ sdud byed rnams kyis bsdus/ rigs gsum mgon pos bkral/ lo paṇa rnams kyis bsgyur/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab/ bshad pa'i srol ma chag /bka' rgyud grub thob rnams kyis zam ma chad/ byin brlabs kyis na bun ma yal ba/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying po/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi spyi lam sbyor ba yan lag drug zhu ba'i thog mar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par zhus te/ mtshams dam por bcad nas yan lag drug gi khrid zhus te sgom pa'i dus na/ 'od gsal chos kyi sku la mnga' brnyes te/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ye shes lhun grub kyi rten dang*/ brten pa lha dang lha mo dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams nges pa gsum ldan du zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du rol ba gzigs/ snga phyi med steng 'og med 'dus ma byas rgyar ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung*/ gsal la ngos bzung med/

bde la zag pa med/ snang la rang bzhin med/ mdangs 'od gsal gshis skye med mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa/ gzhon nu ma la pra phab pa bzhin du/ me tog bkram pa dang*/ rin chen phyag rgya dang*/ mun pa nges par 'joms pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad gzigs pa dang*/ nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma shar/ rdo rje lus kyi rtsa 'dir rlung 'di rgyud/ byang sems 'di 'bab pa mngon sum du gzigs/ zhing khams brjod kyis mi lang rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i skar ma tsam gyi zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa sogs nyams dang grub rtags brjod kyis mi lang ba yod de/ kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma bris so/ / bla ma 'di la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi mos gus mnga' ste/ bla ma rgyud pa'i lo rgyus gsungs pa'i dus su dpang lo'i gsung na re/ gal te rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ / stong pa nyid ni rtag sgom na/ / blo ni gzhon pa la dga' ba/ / 'byung ba dag ni the tshom med/ /bya ba der ni so che shes rab 'bum khong la yod par gda' gsung pa yin/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs ma gzigs ni cha med/ thugs rje chen po thugs rgyu la 'khrungs ngo shes de yin gsung nas phyag thugs kar sbyar te/ spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad/ bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su yang*/ bsnyung ba med par rdo rje'i sky-il mo dkrung bcas pa la grongs gsungs/ dus lan cig ched kyi shog gsungs te/ snyan nas snyan du thugs nas thugs su rgyud/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgya bar nus shing*/ rab tshe 'di 'bring bar do/ tha ma yang skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug na sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag grub thob kyi zam ma chad/ byin brlabs kyis na bun ma yal ba/ mkha' 'gro ma kha rlangs pa thul le ba'i man ngag thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang*/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skye sbyor dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams kyi khrid dbang mdor bstan/

smyung gnas kyi skaur rnams gsan te/ 'gro don phyag rgya chen po yong ba'i rten 'brel mdzad do/ / rgyal ba lta bu'i bshes gnyen du ma la/ / rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud dbang dang man ngag sogs/ / rgyal bas gsung bzhin thugs su chud gyur pas/ / rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /

yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyi 'grib/ / rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ / rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye/ / dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /bo dong e'i rta ra'i gdan sa sems dpa' chen po rang gi bu chen/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan seng ge la gtad nas kyang bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched/ yum dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ e'i chos dpon mdzad par zhu ba gsol bas/ ngas mkhan po btsal yong gi gsungs nas sa skyar byon te/ lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la e'i bla chos la 'byor par zhu phul bas/ gu ru thogs med thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ nga'i bla ma stag sdai ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis ma thob pa'i gdan sa yin sang rang 'gro gsungs nas mnyes 'dug gsungs/ de nas legs pa gdan drangs nas sa sde la sogs pa'i phyag dpe rnams lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la phul nas/ dben pa bsten pa la thugs phyogs te/ 'du 'dzi mi gtsang ba ltar rgyang bsrings nas/ / rang gzhan don du bsam tan sgom pa la/ / rab tu brtson par 'dod pa'i skye bo yis/ / phyi dang nang gi dben pa thob par shog /ces sogs dang*/ rang bzhin nyams dga' gzhan gyi 'tshe ba med/ / chu dang lo ma 'bras bu'i 'byor pa med/ / chags dang sdang ba'i gtam yang mi thos pa'i/ / dben pa'i nags tshal dag tu gnas par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas/ rang bzhin gyis 'dug na nyams dga' zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba me tog rnam pa sna tshogs skye ba/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra snyan pa 'byin pa/ rtswa dang lo ma dang*/ 'bras bus brgyan pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ mdun na chu bo chen po bzhi'i ya gyal yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gtsang chu'i chab sgra snyan po lhung lhung du 'bab pa/

de'i nye 'khor na bai ḍūr lta bu'i ne'u gsing sngon po la me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa dag gis tshom bu bkod pa bzhin du brgyan pa/ 'tsho ba rnyed sla zhing chom rkun dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa med pa/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas bskor ba'i dbus g.yas ru byang gi sa cha/ grub chen rgyud mar byon pa'i gnas mchog ri bo po ta la dang tshul mtshungs par gyur pa dngul chu'i chos rdzong du dgung lo zhe gsum pa la byon nas sku mtshams bcad/ mthun rkyen gyi zhabs tog slob dpon bsod nams brtan gyi pha ma gnyis dang phyug mo sna tshogs kyis bsgrubs te/ nye gnas ma gtogs su la'ang mjal kha med cing*/ nyin mtshan thams cad stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de dus e nas dge bshes rnams kyis gdan 'dren pa la phyin te/ da dung chos gsung bar zhu 'phrin phul bas/ mjal kha yang ma gnang bar/ brtse yang gzhan phan nus med ma ṇi ba/ / mchi ma'i rgyun dang snying rjes gdong dang yid/ / rnam par brlan par gyur nas rang nyid kyis/ / slob ma rnams la snying gtam 'di skad smra/ /zhes pa nas/ phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ /ces sogs gdams pa gnang te gtong*/ de nas lo 'ga'i bar du/ gsol 'dren pa'i bug sgo ma gtogs pa sbring 'gags mdzad/ phyi nas 'bul ba'i dad rdzas thams cad kyang blangs/ thengs gcig sha gsar gzugs shig dang*/ zho zhig dang*/ phud dam gang 'bul ba byung ba nye gnas kyis blangs pas/ nyid rang gsol gsungs nas gsol du ma gnang*/ nye gnas kyis kyang za ma nus par chang dang zho bo/ sha de chu bya la byin ces grag go / ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su rnyed bkur la/ / re sa med cing kha zas zhim po yi/ / ro la chags pa spangs te 'khor ba yi/ / ra ba las ni thar pa bya phyir 'bad/ /lo nyi shu rtsa grangs kyi bar du sku mtshams khor yug la bzhugs te/ de dus chos rje kun mkhyen pas dngul chur byon nas/

rang re zhal cig mjal bar zhu chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pa'i na gsungs pa la/ da lta mtshams dam po'i dam bca' zhig bdog pas mi mjal bar zhu/ da gzod nged mjal du yong zhes zhal gyi bzhes/ khong gi grub mtha'i dri ba'i lan zhu yig phul te sku mtshams ma phye zhes thos so/ /de dus chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa bo dong du byon nas mjal du 'byon gsung ba la yang*/ re nga mi byon par zhu zhes zhu ba bskur te/ de'i dus su mi chen kha drag pa sus zhus kyang mtshams ma phye bar/ sku ni 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs bas dben/ / gsung ni bre mo'i gtam gyis dben/ / thugs ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas/ / dben par gyur te zhes grag go / po ta la dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i/ / dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas kyi mchog gyur der/ / 'du 'dzi mi gtsang ba ltar rgyang bsrings nas/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dben pa bsten la 'dud/ / mi rtag pa thugs la 'khrungs pas tshe 'di blos btang ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i mdza' bshes so sor 'bral/ / 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas shul du lus/ / lus kyi mgron khang rnam shes mgron pos 'bor/ / tshe 'di blos btang rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klong chen po 'khrugs kyang*/ 'o skol la nyams myong tsam med snying rje shas chung gsungs nas khengs skyung 'ba' zhig mdzad pa la/ mi rtog pa thugs la 'khrungs par zhal gyis bzhes te/ gnas dben par rig pa dngas pa'i dus su/ mi 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba shi zer ba thos tsa na 'o skol gyi lus 'di la yang chu'i lbu ba'am/ rlung nang gi mar me bzhin du bzod blags ye med pa zhig yong gin 'dug gsungs/ nye gnas kyi gzim khang la mkhar lan cig byed pa yin zhus pas/ 'o skol yun ring sdod pa'i nges med/ de'i rkyen gyi sems can mang po 'chi gsungs nas ma gnang*/

bla ma rin ye ba'i sar bzhud pa'i shul du babs nas byas pas/ sems can mang po shi yod nga gzungs sngags 'dren dgos sdug ge kun de la ci rer 'dug snying rjer gsung zhes grag go /de'i dus su gsungs pa/ shin tu nyams chung chu bur lta bu'i lus/ / sna tshogs rkyen ngan rlung gis rab bskyod nas/ / skad cig gnas pa'i gdeng yang mi 'dug na/ / chos min yid la sems pa'i long 'dug gam/ / di ring tsam yang mi 'chi gdeng med cing*/ / shi nas gar skye rang dbang med bzhin du/ / don med tshe 'di'i bya ba lhur blangs nas/ / rang gis rang nyid bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rgan gzhon dar ma go rim ma nges pas/ / 'chi snyam med par glo bur 'chi 'gyur zhing*/ / sman spyad rim gro sogs kyis bzlog mi nus/ / 'di 'dra bsams la tshe 'di'i zhen pa spongs/ / nor ldan lag stong sgren mor 'gro 'gyur zhing*/ / kha drag can la yud tsam bsdad dbang med/ / 'khor mang nang nas grogs med gcig pur 'gro/ / 'di 'dra bsam la tshe 'di'i zhen pa spongs/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ mi rtag sgom pa 'di zab zer nas gnas lugs kyi don lta bu'i zab pa de lta min te/ 'di rgyu la skyes na dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i lcag byed/ mthar 'od gsal chos sku thob pa'i rgyu byed pas 'di sgom pa gal che gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid ni mi rtag pa thugs la 'khrungs pas/ 'dod yon gyi 'khri ba chod/ phyi tshis kyi grabs gshom bor/ tshe 'di'i mdun ma mi chos kyi bya byed skad skad krig krig thams cad the la bor blos btang ba de yin no/ / 'dus byas thams cad ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin/ / mi rtag mi brtan snying po med rtogs nas/ / phyi tshis grabs gshom tshe 'di'i bya byed kyis/ / snang ba nub par gyur pa de la 'dud/ / da slu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/

rang yang 'khor ba'i gtsor rar bcings pa yi/ / 'jig rten lha yi su zhig skyob par nus/ / de phyir gang la skyabs na mi bslu ba'i/ / dkon mchog skyabs 'gro rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / dbus su byon pa'i dus gung thang nas lha sar 'byon pa'i chu khar 'bebs dus/ rta bdun brgyad cig la mi re re bzhon nas chu la rkyal btang nas byung bas chu dkyil du thams cad nub nas song bas gzigs pa dang a ka kha skyon che gsungs nas phyag thal mo sbyar te/ sgrol ma sgrol ma 'phags ma 'phags ma gsungs nas spyan chab nyil nyil 'dug pa dang*/ mi rta zung cig ma rtogs pa rta dang ma bral bar yug cig na chu 'gram thon byung mi rta zung gcig chus khyer song ba dang*/ sems dpa' chen po'i sku rgyab nas da ci med pa'i mi dkar po gzugs ring phrug gos dkar po snying song ba zhig ske rags dres ma chig rkyang bcings pa zhig byung nas nga 'gro nga 'gro zer zhing chu la tshom tshom med par rgal song nas mi de'i lag pa nas drud byung ste/ ci yang ma nyes par sos rting*/ mi dkar po de gar song cha med la song bas/ kun ya mtshan par gyur te/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas kyang ci tho dod gsungs/ drung nas 'phags ma la gsol ba btab pas 'phags ma'i sprul pa yin las che zhus pas/ yin pa dag kyang srid re mtshar cig byung*/ lar rang gis blo gtod nus na dkon mchog 'dis rang mi slu ba zhig yin gsungs zhes grag go /dbyar cig bo dong na bzhugs pa'i dus su char pa ye ma bab pas/ chen po dpal rgyal bas char 'bebs shes tshad bsags nas phab kyang ma phebs par re thag chad pa'i dus su/ chen po pas/ bya rgod gshongs kyi jo bo ba la drung nas sku khrus cig gsol la char 'bab pa'i gsol ba cig 'debs par zhu zhus pas/ de bzhin bgyi gsungs nas byon te gsol btab pas/

jo bo'i drung na bzhugs pa'i bar de rang la yang char pa thor thor babs/ de nas skad cig nyid la sprin chen po 'dus/ 'brug sgra zab mo ni skye bo rnams la gtam snyan skyel ba bzhin du grags/ mi rnams ni dga' seng seng por gyur te 'di ltar/ sprin mgo nag po mun nag spel ba bzhin/ / me long nang bzhin thal ba'i dkyil na mdzes/ / rma bya rab dga' ze ba sprel ba rnams/ / glu gar mdzes pas rab tu bstod pa bzhin/ / sprin tshogs de dag dpa' bo dgod pa bzhin/ / rgyun chags zab mo'i sgra 'byin rnam par mdzes/ / de yis char phab mu tig gtor ba bzhin/ / 'brug gi rnga sgra rab tu dgang gyur na/ / glog phran 'gyu ba bro gar byed pa bzhin/ /de'i nub mo nas char chen po gnya' shing gi rgyun tsam pa zhag bdun gyi bar du bab pas/ chen po yang dga' ste/ ngas zhu ba 'bul rin chog zhus pas/ jo bo 'di la byin brlabs shig rang gda' gsung zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod de yi ge mang dogs pas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /jo bo 'di dang*/ skyi rong gi 'phags pa wa ti'i mched zla grags pa'i 'jad sna gsar gyi jo bo dang*/ ngur smrig gi sgrol ma rang byon rnams kyis sems dpa' chen po la gsung byon par grags so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mes tshig pa'i dus dang*/ bla ma rin ye ba gtsang po'i 'khor la tshud pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas me dang chu'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas/ dkon mchog 'di la snying thag pa nas gsol btab na byin brlabs kyis tshul 'phral la yong ste gsungs/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sems dpa' khyed nyid kyis/ / rang dang rang gi spyan chab las 'khrungs pa'i/ / rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'phral du sel ba mtshar/ /de bas na 'gal rkyen grogs ngan spangs pa dang*/ /mthun rkyen bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/

dben pa bsten pa/ mi rtag pa sgom pa dang*/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon dang bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/ 'gal rkyen grogs ngan spang ba dang*/ bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa dang*/ yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten nas tshe 'di blos btang ste/ bslu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// // sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bur rtogs pas rgyu mi dge ba la 'dzem pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ shin tu bzod dka'i ngan song sdug bsngal rnams/ / sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bur thub pas gsungs/ / de phyir srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las/ / nam yang mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ lta ba mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i don rtogs kyang*/ nyes ltung shin du phra ba la yang 'dzem par mdzad de/ dam pa'i don du las 'bras ma grub kyang*/ / kun rdzob las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ / sdig pa spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa 'di/ / mtho dman kun la dgos pa'i spyod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dang po lpags thul gon pa tsam yang nyes par song dogs nas/ ya nga ba chen po byung ste/ phyis 'dul ba thos tsa na de tsam gyi spyod lam dog po yang mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ nye gnas kyi lo gcig la zhing duu ma btab pa gzigs pas/ sems can mang po 'chi ru yong*/ 'o skol lo yi ci byed gsungs nas byed du ma gnang*/ dbyar yog mo'i me shing ma 'don de la sems can mang po yod/ ma shi na 'khos shig shar nas 'ong gsungs/ dbyar 'od khang med dus nub mo dkar me phul na phye ma leb 'chi ru yong gsungs nas dkar me nyin par 'bul/ dbyar kha mchod pa lnga se gyis phyis na sems can rkang 'og tu song ba mi mthong gsungs nas mdor na las rgyu 'bras la mngags pa chen po mdzad do/

/ mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i don rtogs pas/ / spangs blang dgag sgrub spros pa kun bral kyang*/ / rgyu 'bras slu ba med pa'i don gzigs pas/ / nyes ltung shin tu phra la'ang 'dzem pa mtshar/ / srid pa gsum gyi bde ba mi rtag par rtogs pas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ srid gsum bde ba rtswa rtse'i zil pa bzhin/ / yud tsam zhig gis 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ / nam yang mi 'gyur thar pa'i go 'phangs mchog / don du gnyer bar rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ lha'i nang nas tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin mi'i nang nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob kyang mi rtag cing 'jig pas snying po med/ thar pa bla na med pa'i byang chub 'di don du gnyer dgos gsung zhing 'di ltar gsung ngo*/ / thar pa'i lam du mi 'gyur dge ba yis/ / re zhig bde 'gro'i bde ba thob 'gyur kyang*/ / mkha' la mda' 'phangs sa la ltung ba ltar/ / 'phen shugs zad nas ngan 'gror ltung ba 'gyur/ / me yi rang bzhin tsha ba yin pa ltar/ / 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal yin par gsungs/ / bde phyir sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod skyes bu yis/ / thar pa don du dge bar 'bad par bya/ zhes gsungs so/ / srid gsum bde ba snying po med gzigs nas/ / rang gzhan don du tshogs gnyis grur zhugs te/ / sku gsum nor bu rin chen len par byed/ / sems dpa' khyed ni rgya mtsho'i ded dpon 'dra/ /skyes bu chen po ni lam mnyam nyid kyi byams pa chen po mnga' ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ byang chub sems pas sems can la/ / bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin/ / rkang gi khongs nas byams pa che/ / de lta'i rtag phan byed par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni nang na byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin mnga' bas/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du byams te/ de yang 'di ltar/ yon bdag gi rigs 'ga' zhig gis/ dmag la 'gro ba'i dus rim gro la gtor ma'i chas mang po skyal tsa na/

gtor ma phul nas 'phrin las bcol ba'i skabs su/ 'o skol rang dkon mchog chos skyong la zhu ba byed tsa na/ phyogs gnyis ka ru rgyu 'khrug pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig zer ba la rtogs shig rgyal cig 'phags par mdzod mi zer nyi cag rnam pa'ang de bzhin mdzod/ kho pa ta rgyal ba zhig 'dod de/ rgyal ba ma byung yang 'khrug pa zhi na phar tshur gnyis kar la des chog /de bzhin byas pas yon bdag bslus par yang mi 'gyur gsungs/ sems can 'di dang 'di zer bya ba bde zhing 'dug zer ba gsan tsa na/ de legs so gsungs nas shin tu mnyes shing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo*/ / bdag gi sdug bsngal rlung shugs kyis bskyod nas/ / gang gi bzhin ras nag po'i sprin bsdus te/ / mchi ma'i char phab ngud mo'i 'brug sgra bsgrags/ / de 'dra yal bar 'dor bar rigs sam ci/ / bdag nyid bde ba'i nyi zer phog pa yi/ / gang gi bzhin ras pad mo'i tshal rgyas te/ / so'i ze 'bru dkar po ston gyur pa/ / de 'dra yal bar 'dor bar ga la rigs/zhesagasung ngo*/ / gang gi rang bzhin byams pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ / rnam par brlan pa bzhin du sems mthun zhing*/ / phun sum gnod pa med pa'i sems gyur nas/ / dka' thub can bzhin gcan gzan khro bo spyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ drung na 'khod pa'i ri dwags dang gcan gzan kun gcig la gcig phan tshun gnod pa med cing byams te/ gzhan gyis phul ba'i sha khyi chen po zhig yod pa kun kyang rna mo'i rtsed mo'i phyir brdung ba ltar byas tsa na mi rmug par bros cing sprang po la rmug pa'i tshe na ni bgrangs pa dang rmug 'phro gcod pa cig yod do/ /zhum bu kun kyang bye'u mthong khar babs pa'i dus/ gnod pa'i sems spangs nas de byung ba la dga' zhing 'drogs dogs pa'i phyir des mi mthong ba'i sar phyin nas nyal cing*/ bye chung la yang gnod pa med do/

/ spyang ki zhig yod pa kun kyang 'tshe ba'i sems spangs te/ gting la sha byin kyang mi za ba cig byung zhing*/ ngang pa zhig yod pa kun kyang sems dpa' chen po bskor ba mdzad pa'i dus su kho yang skor ba byed/ bzhugs pa'i dus su kho yang sdaud/ sems dpa' chen po'i spyod lam gyi lad mo byed pa zhig byung 'dug de la mnyes shing*/ dmag byung nas bo dong du 'byon dgos pa byung dus/ nye gnas la gzhan dngos po mi thub ngang pa de ma lus pa gy-is gsung zer/ mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mo'i gsung na re/ dud 'gro de kun gyi byed lugs de rang ngo mtshar che/ byang chub kyi sems 'di 'byongs tsa na gang yang dbang du 'du ba cig yin par 'dug gsung zhing khong rang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar na yang 'di ltar bkod yod do/ / dbus pa'i dmag 'jad du byung dus dngul chu rnams la/ dngos po la ma chags par thams cad bros/ 'gro ba mi yong ba'i rgas pa rnams kyi g.yog ngas byed pa yin gsungs te/ shul na yod pa rnams bred nas drung du 'tshogs te/ bsdad yod pa'i dus/ dmag mi rnams khro zhing rngam pa'i tshul gyis drung du byung ste/ zhal mthong ba dang 'phral du btul pa dang*/ khro zhing brngam pa rnams kyang zhi nas drung na 'khod pa rnams la gnod pa mi byed par byin brlabs zhus kyin 'gro/ 'ga' zhig ni dad pa skyes te/ mchi ma 'byin cing mi bsad pa'i sdig bshags byed do zhes grag go /drung na 'khod pa'i slob ma rnams kyang*/ nga kho na la mnyes shing byams snyam du thams cad de ltar ru sems shing*/ de rnams kyang gcig la gcig mthong che zhing byams pas phan tshun che mi rtsod par gral 'og tu sdod pa la has thob byed cing cig gi cig snyan par smra'o/ / byams pa'i rang bzhin byams pa'i thugs mnga' bas/ / drung na 'khod pa'i mi dang gcan gzan kyang*/ / gcig la gcig byams byams pa'i sems dang ldan/ / char sprin mug po lta bu'i mdog 'dra ba'i/

/ khro zhing gtum pa'i dmag dpung lhags pa'i tshe/ / gang gi sku ni mthong pa tsam gyis kyang*/ / khro ba zhi nas gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ / 'gro rnams byams pas 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzod med kyi snying rje chen po mnga' tshul ston pa ni/ 'gro ba 'di kun thugs rje'i bdag can des/ / bdag tu 'dzin pa de la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ dper na ma bu gcig po yid du 'ong ba la brtse ba ltar 'khor ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po mnga' zhing*/ khyad par du dngos su sdug bsngal ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa la brtse ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / dgung lo bcu drug tsam lon pa'i dus su/ zang zing gi phan 'dogs bag tsam byas pa'i dge bshes shig gis sang nyin la sleb dgos pa'i don gal can zhig gi bang chen bcol te bo dong nas sa skyar byon pa'i phyed lam sleb pa'i thang dkyil cig na khyi gu bzhi lnga zhig skyes pa yas bor nas song 'dug pa gzigs nas/ snying rje nas bshums shing*/ de ring 'di pha skyel du phyin na ni khong gi don mi 'grub/ di ring bzhag na ni/ dgun yin pas 'khyags nas kyang 'chi/ pho rog dang gcan gzan dag gis kyang bsod snyam du bsam pas di ring 'di pha bskyal la/ do red mtshan rkyang nas 'gro dgos pa yin dgongs te/ khyi khu skyel ba'ang log byon pas/ dge bshes de dang da res ma 'phrad pa bya dgos dgongs pa la/ srang bar zhig tu 'phrad pas nyid kyis don gal can gyi btab bcog pa 'dug zer nas 'thab tu byung bas/ skye lo byung gsungs/ de nas de ma khad log nas byon pas tho rangs kha sa skyar phebs/ lan bsgyur tsha ba gcig gsol nas byon pas dgong mo bo dong phebs te/ dge bshes des kyang ngo mtshar che ngas 'thab pa de yang bzod par gsol zer bas byung gsungs/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i phyag len du gda'o/ /yang dgung lo nyi shu tsam lon pa'i dus su e'i dge 'dun rnams chos gzhi la btegs par/

rgya sgo'i 'gag na sprang mo zha ba gcig yod pa ngu bzhin 'dug pa thugs kyis ma bzod ste ci nyes dris pas/ btsun pa thams cad 'byon par 'dug des na nga la lto gter mi mi yong zer/ ngas khyod len du yong gi sdug bsngal ma byed gsungs nas thag pa khyer nas log byon te nga la khur gsungs pa la/ mos 'khur mi nus pa 'dug pas/ gdong la mo'i gos stan rnams bskyal/ de nas mo rang khur nas chos bar sar skyal gsungs/ snying rje'i dbang gi sems can don mthong na/ / rang gi sdug bsngal dag la'ang mi gzigs par/ / sems can so so'i 'dod don sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / thabs mkhas thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /des na sems can dngos su sdug bsngal mthong na lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ gzhan gyi sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di 'dra 'dug zer ba gsan na/ nga'i ma rgan dai snying re rje gsungs te bshums nas gsung gleng kyang 'phro chad nas 'gro zhing*/ glang ri thang pa la gzhan gyis ngo nag po byas pa gsan nas/ nga'i ma rgan sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di la bsams tsa na ngo gdong dkar po yong sa mi 'dug gsungs zer/ de khong pa mad par gda' gsung nas spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad cing 'di ltar gsung ngo*/ / sdug bsngal mang gzir 'gro 'di yal bor nas/ / rang nyid zhi bde 'ba' zhig don gnyer bas/ / pha ma me yis tshig pa yal bor nas/ / rang nyid bsil ba'i rdzing bur khrus byed 'dra/ / 'gro 'dis rang gi bde ba yal bor nas/ / bdag gi don du sdug bsngal khur blangs pa/ / sa dang rgya mtsho'i rdul bas ches mang na/ / de dag bdag gis ji ltar yal bar 'dor/ / thog med dus nas lan mang phan btags pa'i/ / 'gro mang bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ / mthong thos dran kyang gas par ma gyur pa/ / bdag gi snying 'di lcags la byas sam ci/ / sngon chad yang yang sdug bsngal sel byed ma/ / mnar med me yi nang du tshig gyur na/ / de la snying rje'i bsam pa mi skye ba/

/ bdag 'dra mi'i lus can dud 'gror zad/ /gsung zhing snying rje'i nyams byung rgyal du btang na nyin mtshan khor yug tu de nyid la rtse gcig tu 'byams nas phyi rol pas ltas na brgyal ba ltar mngon pa yong gin 'dug gsung*/ dbus pa'i dmag rting ma 'jad du byung dus dngul chu'i mdun gyi thang chen po dmag gis gang ba gzigs pas/ sdug ge tsho sdug ge tsho/ nga'i ma rgan 'di tsam zhig 'khrul nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa de snying rjai snying rje gsung ste bzhugs gdan gyi steng du 'drel ldog mdzad cing*/ bshums pa'i mthar brgyal brgyal gyi bar du bshums 'dug ces grag go / gzhan yang 'di ltar thos so/ /ngan song gsum a cang che/ mi'i nang nas kyang sdug bsngal la dngos su spyod pa 'di rnams snying shin tu rje mod/ bsam mno legs par btang na sdug bsngal spyod pa 'di rnams snying rje gsungs zhing*/ da lta 'jig rten na mi che ru re drung du re/ 'khor mang kha drag nor che/ las su sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa de 'dra rnams gzigs pa'am/ dran pa'i de dag gi gleng mo byung tsa na yang spyan chab 'byin cing*/ sems dpa' chen po yi gsung na re pha rol po rnam rtog skyer yong bsam pa byung nas nyams dkyil gin tshod bzung ba min na de 'dra rnams dang phrad pa na mchi ma rang dbang med par yong gin 'dug gsung*/ 'o skol chos pa 'di rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa 'di rnams la snying rje skye thang pa zhig 'dug pa la skye ba nyung ba de/ rang re rnams kyang tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor kha drag de rnams la skyon gnas su mi lta ba'i blo ngan de phugs su zhugs pas lan 'dug da lta sdug bsngal ba rnams la snying rje ba de sdug bsngal de la rang re yang skyon du lta bas yin par 'dug ste/ de gnyis rang skyon gang che mi shes gsung*/ tshogs chos gsung pa'i dus sems can gyi sdug bsngal la sems dpa' chen po nyid kyis bshums tsa na tshogs pa byin po ngu cong theg theg yod pa de la mtshan nyid pa zhig na re/

mkhan bu ston pa dang paṇa chen pa kun chos gsungs tsa na bzhad gad theg theg nyams dga' zhad che bar 'dug 'di pa'i chos gsung ba 'di sdug zhad che mi gces shi ba bzhin du ngu cong theg theg zer/ de kho'i de 'dra mo yang yod do/ /des na sems can gyi sdug bsngal snying rje chen po 'khrungs tshul gong 'og rnams su'ang bstan cing ston par 'gyur la phal cher ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo*/ / bu gces shi ba'i ma ma ji bzhin du/ / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong thos dran gyur na/ / spyan chab si ta'i rgyun ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ / 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po la phyag 'tshal lo//

byams pa dang snying rje chen po sngon du song ba'i sgo nas bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len ston par byed pa ni/ thog med dus nas bdag la brtse ba can/ / ma rnams sdug bsngal rang bde ci zhig bya/ / de phyir mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir/ / byang chub sems bskyed rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i dus/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa zhing gzhan du myur por gshegs pa mngon par shes pas mkhyen te/ mtshams hur thon mdzad nas byon pa'i lam khar mi gnyis kyis ra cig mi 'gro bzhin khrid 'gro ba dang phrad pa la ci byed dris pas/ hor 'dra la sprod pa yin zer/ snying rje bas bshums te/ gser zho phyed byin nas 'di hor 'dra la byin la ra 'di ma bsad la blang byas gsungs/ de nas shangs kyi mda'i gad skyibs shig tu phebs pa dang*/ 'dir ja skol ngal gso ba yin gsung 'di na chu mi gda' zhus pas/ chu'i khag ngas khur/ me shing 'thus la shog gsungs/ shing btus nas slebs pa'ang chu 'di na gda' yi gsungs nas phyag gis bye ma la rud rud mdzad pa sngar med pa'i chu byung bas zhabs tog pa rnams kyis bsam pa la mig 'phrul yin nam bsam pa byung zer/ ja gsol zin pa'i rjes la yang chu 'dug yar lam phyed kyis ltas pas chu'i rjes yang mi 'dug zer ro/ / de nas mkhan chen rin po che dang mjal bas/ nyid byon pa de dga' gsungs nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ 'jug pa sems bskyed 'di sngar bla ma rin ye ba la thob lags te/ drung du zhig thob na bsams pas sku khams kyis lcogs tsam du gda' na thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas de dus snyung rab 'dug te/ shin tu yang spro mo da lta rang mchod pa bshoms cig gsung zer/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga dngos gzhi grub nas/ mkhyen par gsol ba gdab pa'i skabs su/

sa chen po ni rab tu g.yo/ lha'i me tog ni char bzhin du 'bab/ spos kyi dri zhim po'i ngad pa ni rnam par ldang*/ rol mo'i sgra snyan pa ni dbyar gyi 'brug bzhin du grags/ sprin rnams 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bla re bres par gyur ces grag go /cho ga tshar ba'i rjes la mkhan rin po che yi gsung na re/ chos bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod/ da ste btsun rgan di ring shi yang 'gyod pa med do gsungs nas/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te/ de nas ring po ma thog par gshegs shing*/ gshegs khar sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad po de nar ba zhig gsungs nas/ gshegs zhes grag go /mkhan rin po che'i slob ma rnams na re/ bla ma rgyal sras pa de la mngon par mkhyen pa yod med las 'das nas 'dug mkhan chen pa gshegs pa'i le kha der khong gis phebs nas byon zer gin 'dug zer/ des na sems dpa' chen po nyid kyang*/ nyin zhag re la dus gsum du smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len cing*/ gang gis rang gi bde ba yal bor nas/ / yu bu'i don du bam khur blangs pa yi/ / sems can tshogs 'di blo yis yal bor na/ / theg chen dam chos thos pa'i dgos pa ci/ / des na mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir/ / bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ / rang don spangs te dngos sam brgyud nas kyang*/ / gzhan don sgrub byed skyes bu mchog yin no/ /gsung zhing dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag du ma la byang chub sems kyi sdom pa gnang nas byang chub sems dpar gyur par mdzad cing dus phyis mkhan byang chub sems dpa' chen po byang chub rtse mos dbu mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ba' zhig tshogs pa la 'jug pa sems bskyed gsungs pa'i skabs su/ 'o skol gyis mkhan chen rin po che ba la 'di zhus pa'i dus su/ chos bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod pa yin gsungs nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad cing gda'/

'o skol la bdag rgyu tsam med de da khong pa de skad gsung gin gda'/ 'on kyang byas pas/ jo bo rje yab sras sku mched gsum la sogs pa'i dus su'ang chos 'di la bka' dog pa yin pa 'dug dus phyis kyang 'di 'bogs pa nyung bar gda'/ gang ltar lags kyang*/ 'o skol las dbus gtsang gnyis na/ chos 'di phog pa mang ba med/ sngar yang rgyud la skyes pa yang mang po byung zhing*/ da 'o skol nas chos 'di'i bka' yongs su gtong ba yin pas/ nyid cag dge ba'i bshes gnyena'abogs par nus pa thams cad kyis phog cig gsung ngo*/ / gnas brtan chen pos rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas/ / theg chen chos kyi bdag por lung bstan tshe/ / sa chen g.yo zhing me tog char bzhin 'bab/ / rol mo'i sgra dang spos kyi dri zhim ldang*/ / mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bla re bres/ / byams dang snying rje'i sprin chen las byung ba'i/ / byang chub sems kyis char pas 'gro ba yi/ / phan bde'i lo thog smin par mdzad pa mtshar/ /de lta bas na sdig pa mi dge ba la 'dzem pa dang thar par don du gnyer ba dang byams snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las sdig pa mi dge ba la 'dzem pa dang*/ thar pa don du gnyer ba dang*/ byams snying rje chen po sngon du song ba'i sgo nas/ bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // bdag gzhan brje ba sgom pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ sdug bsngal ma lus bdag bde 'dod las byung*/ / rdzogs pa'i byang chub gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ / de phyir bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag / yang dag brje ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / ces gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /slob dpon dpal ye bas blo sbyang la/ nyams su sgom dus/ khong la shig nad byung bas/

sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gis/ nyid rang gis snying rus skyed la gsos gal te mi gsos pa 'dra na 'dir byon/ nged kyis kyang gso rogs bya yin gsung zer/ khong gis yun ring po'i bar du gsos kyang nyung du ma song bas/ drung du phyin nas bslab ye ru mal bcas nas zhag shas song ba dang*/ shig rnams nyung du song 'dug pas/ rnam rtog skyes te drung du ltar phyin pas/ drung pa la shig gi 'jig pa 'dug pa mthong bas/ drung nas 'o rgyal nga rang gi snying rus skyed la gang gsos gsos byed nga la thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ nyid kyi shig blangs pa ma yin nga rang la yod pa yin gsungs nas ma gnang*/ de nas zhag 'ga' na thams cad yal nas song zhes thos so/ / yang grwa yang dben pa'i mkhan po 'dis/ lo gnyis gsum dngul chur bzhugs pas/ lan cig khong na nas mgo bo dang snying kha la gzer chen po skyes te/ zug bzod thabs med pa yod pa'i skabs su nye gnas nyul ba la byon pa la/ na bza' chos gos cig yod pa yang 'bul bar skur zug gzer yod tshul yang bshad de/ nye gnas drung du bzhud nas dum pa lon pa'i dus su zug zer thams cad gar song cha med la song bas/ rje rin po ches nga'i na tsha rnams blangs pa yin nges par 'dug zer zhing nges shes skyes nas dad gus thun mong ma yin pa tshud 'dug cing*/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len pa 'di kun snying rje'i bsam pa drag pos blang na ngo shes pa nyams su myong bas grub pa la gsung zhing gzhan gyi na tsha la sogs la gtong len gyi dmigs pa byas tsa na khams nyog por 'gro yin 'dug gsungs/ bla ma gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa dad pa dben shri byung ba'i res/ sems dpa' chen po rang la yang gong du gdan 'dren pa'i mjal sa yod ma zer ba yang 'dug sang gser yig pas sleb yong ba yod zer ba'i bya nam byed na byung bas rang re la gdan 'dren med mchi stai/

so mi bsod pa zhig yong pa yod pa bden mchi gsungs/ gal te gdan 'dren yod kyang rang res 'khyus pas nye 'khor rnams la/ mi bde ba yongs gsungs nas 'byon du ma gnang*/ sang hor gyis sleb byung nas sa skyar gdan drangs pa'i phyag phyi la bdag gis kyang phyin pas/ sa skya'i rgyab der drauo 'debs pa'i sar khyi rgad po cig byung ba la hor gyi 'bar bor ches rdau cig brgyab pa la skad ngan cher po shor bas/ sems dpa' chen po rang la brgyab pa bzhin du a gsungs nas dkar yol 'chor la khad byung zhing spyan chab mang po bton/ de nas sa skyar byon nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos gsung nas/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad do/ / gser yig pas tshong 'dus na mar gdan drangs pa'i dus/ hor kyi g.yog po gsum la nag chen po thug nas bsod du byung ba la gsung byon pas srog las thar bar mdzad/ sku zhang gis rtsis kyi rten 'brel la dben shri'i gdan gyi 'og rang gi gzugs/ rang gri dang rang thag 'ong bcug pas dben shris mthong nas rtsa ra chen po byed pa la byung ba la yang gsung byon pa tsam gyis grol bar byas te/ rin spungs bar byon nas dbus su 'byon ma dgongs par yar byon te/ zha lur gdan drangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad/ de dus mkhan chen bu ston pa bsnyungs nas grongs la khad pa 'dug pa la mjal te/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la zhugs pa'i rten 'brel dang bdag gzhan brje ba'i dmigs pa mdzad pas de'i nub mo nas sku bskyed byung nas bsnyung ba dngas te/ de dus bla ma rgyal sras pas mkhan po'i snyung nad blangs zer ba'i grags pa chen po yang byung zhing mkhan po'i zhabs btegs pa zhig gi rmi lam du mdang drung pa la/

bla ma rgyal sras pa sku lus shel dkar ltar dngas par gyur pa gser gyi dbu rgyan gsol nas dbang bskur mdzad pa rmis lags zhus pas/ rm-i lam bzang po yin nga yang mdang khams bde zhing rig pa dngas pa zhig byung gsungs nas mnyes 'dug zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod do/ /yi ge mang pas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / 'gro kun pha mar shes nas sems rgyud snying rjes brlan/ / bdag la gces 'dzin spangs nas gzhan skyon bdag la len/ / 'gro la phan sems skyed nas bde dge gzhan la gtong*/ / kun rdzob byang sems sgoms la dgos pa'i chos gsum yin/ /zhes kyang gsung ngo*/ / bdag gzhan 'khor 'das nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin du/ / bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs kyang*/ / bdag la gzhan gyi sdug bsngal len byed cing*/ / bdag gi bde dge gzhan la gtong bar mtshar/ / mi 'dod pa'i chos bzhi lam du 'khyer ba la dang por ma rnyed pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ su dag 'dod chen dbang gis bdag gi nor/ / thams cad 'phrog gam 'phrog tu 'jug na yang*/ / lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams/ / de la bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len ston te/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pas chos zhu ba la sa skyar gdan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te/ tshur byaun dus la tshas nag por jag pa byung ste/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku la ma reg zhabs tog pa rnams 'ol le ba re bkyigs te jag pa za ma za dus zhabs tog pa zhig bky-ig pa grol byung ba'i tsa na/ jag pa'i ral gri zhig bzhag 'dug pa khyer nas braus na bsam yin yod tsa na/ sems dpa' chen pos mkhyen nas ston pa blo rtsab rtsob ma byed ang gsungs nas/ 'bros ma nus zer/ dngos po rnams rin chen sgang pa'i sa char ma 'khyer/ ngas blos btang yod pas 'phrogs pa yin snyam pa'i blau yang ma byed/
