nga'i go lag khyer na yang khyer gsungs pas jag pas phyag 'tshal nas nged tsho la/ phongs nas thabs rdugs pas nyid lta bu zhig dang thug zer yin 'dug zer/ jag pa rnams rjes zlos byed du bcug pas bsngo ba yang mdzad ces thos cing*/ nor la chags pa'am bdag la sdang ba yis/ / bdag gi bdog kun 'phrogs nas nyin cig tsam/ / 'tsho ba'i zas tsam med pa'i skabs byung na/ / de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gnod lan du phan 'dogs par dam bcas pa ltar mdzad do/ /dus phyis sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ dbus pa'i dmag mang po mthong ba des/ dpon chen byang pa 'dis 'o skol la chos 'brail ma byas pa'i gong du brtson sdug ge zhig mi gsod pa'i zhu ba byas kyang ma 'grub pa de gnyis lo mang po'i bar du dge sbyor gyi bskul ma byas/ de bar la dge sbyor gang byed kyang de rnams dang*/ dbus pa'i dmag sngon ma rang re dngul chu ba 'joms mi de rnams kyi don du bsngos/ smon lam rnam dag btab yod de e phan ni mi shes gsungs/ sems dpa' 'di yi longs spyod gzhan bdag gis/ / 'dod chen dbang gis 'phrogs par 'gyur pa'i tshe/ / byams pa'i gzhu brdungs dge ba'i mda' 'phen zhing*/ / snying rje'i dpung gis de yi sdig sdug rnams/ / thams cad phrogs nas sems dpa' khyed nyid ni/ / rab tu khros nas gnod lan 'jal ba 'dra/ / sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston par byed pa ni/ bdag la nyes pa cung zad med bzhin du/ / gang dag bdag gi mgo bo gcod byed na'ang*/ / snying rje'i dbang gis de'i sdig pa rnams/ / bdag la len pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / bshad nyan mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched kyis bo dong du chos gsung ba'i dus/ rgya sgo lam 'gag na shig nad tshabs can byung ba'i sprang rgan lus kyi zungs shor ba gos dang stan la sogs pa shig gi phung por gyur pa cig 'dug pas de la drung sku mched pa'i skya bo tshos drung nas skyug bro 'gag der ma bsdad zer zhing 'bud pa gzigs pas/

snying rje drag tu skyes nas spyan chab shor te/ de'i nub mo kho'i gos dang stan shig gi phung por gyur pa ltar nang du khyer/ sprang po la nam bza' gcig gnyis/ bza' rgyu gnang nas shig rnams la sku lus sbyin par btang stai/ shig gi phung po'i gseb tu gzims nas zhag gcig gnyis song ba dang*/ slob dpon dang mched grogs gcig gnyis kyis tshor nas ltar byon pas/ sprang po'i gos dang*/ stan shig gi phung po rnams gsol/ sku lus thams cad 'brum pa thug po byung ba bzhin song 'dug par mthong bas/ khong rnam pa ha las te/ nyid da rung lus gtong ba'i dus tsam la ma sleb las che/ de 'dra rang ha cang thal drags mi mdzad pa zhus pas/ bdag gis lus can thams cad la/ / lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis/ / rtag tu gsod dam dmod pa'am/ / brdaig sogs ci dga' byed la rag /ces dang*/ 'gro mang rdaug pas bdag gi spyir 'tshog gam/ /'gums kyi mi gsod 'jig rten mgon dgyes mdzod/ /gsungs nas ma gsan pa dang*/ khong rnams pas 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pa'i drung du phyin te 'di bzhin mdzad yin gda'/ nged tshos zhu ba byas kyang 'di skad gsungs nas mi gsan par 'dug /drung nas gsung 'byon dgos par gda' zhus pas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pas kyang de ma thag byon te/ de lta bu rang mi mdzad par zhu ha cang 'o rgyal drags tsam 'gyur kyang mi shes zhus pa la yang*/ lus tsam gyis kyang gzhan la phan thogs par/ / nam zhig 'gyur ces bdag gi gang bsam pa/ / smon lam de ni 'bras bu yod par bya zhes dang*/ / gzhan la mi phan sred zad bde ba yang*/ / dmyal ba'i me ltar mthong nas rab spongs zhing*/ / gzhan la phan na mnar med me nang du/ / rab dga' 'jug pa rnams kyis rjes su slob/ /gsungs te ma gsan par gsos pas ring por ma thogs par shig rnams yal nas song zhes grag go /de dus ha cang so tsha drags nas ma zug pa'i dus su/ stod kyi cha la dar res dum re dkris kyin bzhag gsungs/

gang zhig khro dang nga rgyal dbang gyur na/ / bdag gi lus la rma srol cher gtod de/ / 'chi bar nges pa'i gnas skabs byung gyur na'ang*/ / de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par gyis/ /zhes dam bca' ba bzhin ni mdzad do/ /yang bo dong du sprang phrug zhig nad byung ba zhig gi shig thams cad blangs pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i sku lus la 'phungs nas zhag gcig la shi 'dug zer/ sems dpa' chen po la brten nas de sa gnas gong ma zhig tu 'phos nges bsam pa 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang bo dong dang dngul chu gnyis su sprang po shig nad byung ba mang po'i shig blangs te/ nyung por yal gin song zhes grag go /dus phyis 'phan yul glang thang ba yin pa'i ston sgom byang chub sems dpa' chos mchog bya ba la khong rang la shig nad byung ba'i steng du gzhan gyi shig nad kyang blangs te sems can la lus dngos su sbyin pa btang nas gshegs pa'i de ma thag la bdag gis thugs dam la 'dogs par zhu ba'i 'phan chas khyer nas nye gnas la 'di ltar zhus byas pas nye gnas drung du song nas log byung ba la/ ci gsung byas pas/ go rjes su yi rang shākya thub pa rus sbal sku 'khrungs pa'i dus srin bu ke ta ka brgyad khri la sku lus sbyin par btang ba dang*/ don gyis cha mthun pa de yin khong gi sems la 'gyod pa yod pa'i rigs su mi 'dug ngo mtshar che/ 'o skol blo sbyong pa yin pas/ da shig de tsam zhig 'chir 'jug pa snying rje/ yar long la shog gsungs yin 'dug /drung nas sku nas bgres pa dang shig tshan ches drags pas ci 'gyur mi shes zhus kyang mi gsan par long shog gsungs/ da sngar nyid cag shig nad byung ba gso ba byas pa drag zer la/ slob dpon yon tan 'od dang*/ dge slong lha bzang*/ dkon mchog rin chen/ nam mkha' bzang po/ bdag cag rnams kyis gso lo bgyis pas drung du yang zhu ba 'grub bo/ /de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod de mang dogs pas ma bris so/

/ lhun po'i ngogs la bya tshogs babs pa bzhin/ / srab 'jam gser mdog 'dra ba'i sku lus la/ / ru mtshon rnon po'i mchu rnams ltar zug nas/ / 'bum phrag du ma'i shig gi khrag 'thung tshe/ / mtshon gyi phug pa'i zug tsam 'byung na yang*/ / bdag nyid sdug kyang 'gro la phan gyur na/ / pad mos brgyan pa'i mtsho ru ngang pa ltar/ / dmyal me'i nang du'ang dges pas gshegs la 'dud/ /

ma grags pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ 'ga' zhig bdag la mi snyan sna tshogs pa/ / stong gsum khyab par sgrog par byed na yang*/ / byams pa'i sems kyis slar yang de nyid kyi/ / yon tan brjod pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni thams cad thams cad kyi/ yon tan 'ba' zhig nas brjod kyi/ gzhan gyi skyon nas brjod pa lan cig kyang ma mthong zhing ma thos la/ gang zhig thos na bdag la 'gro kun gyis/ / khrel bar gyur pa'i grags ngan mi zad par/ / phyogs bcur bsgrags pa mthong thos dran gyur na/ / de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyid/ /ces gsungs shing*/ 'ga' zhig gis la la la 'phyas mos btang tsa na/ nā ro pas te lo pa nya bsha' ba la sogs pa mthong ba dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dpal gshin rje khyim btsun nyo chang byed par mthong ba la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas/ 'o skol rang blo ma dag pa yin kho kun ci 'dra yin mi shes/ lar yang 'o skol gyis mi la skyon brjod mang po byas na 'o skol la yang thams cad kyi tshur 'thab pa zhig rten 'brel la cis kyang yong gsung*/ de shin tu mad par sems dpa' chen po'i yon tan 'ba' zhig brjod cing*/ skyes bu dam pa kun gyis kyang bstod bskur bsngags gsum 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ltar thos so ste/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i gsung na re/ thog mar shes bya kun la mkhas par bya/ / bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ / tha mar 'dris pa'i don la brtson pas bsgom/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /zhes sa skya paṇa ṭi tas gsungs pa de/ gu ru thogs med khong gis byas pa yin/ 'o skol chos pa rnams kyi nang na chos byed pa ta mang rab 'dug te brtan pa thob pa du tsam bdog pa/ gzhan gyi ni nga la rgyus med brtan pa thob ngos shes pa gu ru thogs med khong yin/

pho skyes pa spam zer na de kun la zer ba lags/ mi gzhan gyis nga'i rgyud tshod sleb pa la da rung dka' las chen po yod/ ngas gu ru thogs med kyi rgyud tshod sleb pa la bskal ba mang por tshogs gsog dgos/ nga khong gi bla ma yin khong nga'i slob ma yin te/ nga'i bla ma zhig las kyang de la mos/ mi rgan nam 'chi ba'i sngas kha der gu ru thogs med yod pa zhig byung na dga' ste/ nga phyogs thams cad du rgyug khong pa gcig tu bzhugs pa 'dis yid smon thog tu e 'bab mi shes zhes gsung zer zhing*/ gsung yig snyan ngag dang bcas pa bskur ba'i nang na yang*/ khyod la nga 'dra'i slob dpon brgya yod kyang*/ / nga la khyod 'dra'i slob ma khyod las med/ /ces sogs kyis bstod pa mang po yang 'dug go /kun mkhyen rong pa'i gsung na re/ nga la pha bas lhag pa'i bu gcig yod pa yin/ nga'i slob ma 'di 'dra gzhan na yod na smon ne 'chor/ skyes bu dam pa 'di 'dra 'jig rten na dkon gsung zer/ bla ma rin ye ba bla ma yin kyang*/ sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan nas brjod tsam na phyag thal mo sbyor spyan chab 'don zer ro/ / slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis chos rje kun mkhyen pa la mjal du phyin dus/ khyed dngul chu ba bla ma'i skal ba rgyal/ rgyal sras pa de ming don mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po yin/ khor mdzad spyod rnam par dag pa 'phrin las rgya chen po can des grub mtha' de 'o skol 'dod pa de bzhin mdzad na lta spyod phun sum tshogs pa yong ba gda' ste/ khong yang lta ba rang snga rabs pa la zhen che ba 'dra/ khong dang lta ba 'di'i chos kyi 'brel gtam zhig las ci bya bsam pa yin te/ ngas lan cig dngul chur phyin pas kyang khong mtshams dam po la bzhugs 'dug pas ma mjal/ dri ba 'ga' zhig bskur bas kyang ngas ci yang mi shes zer ba'i lan gcig las ma byung*/ da rung khong dang cig 'phrad dgos/ gang ltar lags kyang rgyal sras de mtshungs pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/

'di nas 'phos ma thag byams mgon gyi drung du zang thal le 'gro rgyu de yin/ de'i rgyu thams cad kho la tshang ba yin gsungs zer*/ yang rta nag tu byon pa cig la/ dngul chu'i thad kyi sprin la phyag btsugs nas der 'dus pa rnams la pha gi'i 'og nas sangs rgyas mi'i gzugs su bzhugs pa cig yod pa yin e shes gsung zer/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam sgeg gi gsung na re/ dbus gtsang gnyis po 'di na mthong thos dran pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'dug stai/ gzhan su bas kyang bo dong thogs med de smon/ nga yang tshe gzhug la sgom cig zhu rgyu byung na bo dong thogs med de la sgom cig zhu/ khongs mtshams dam po cig yod par 'dug pas/ rten 'brel ma 'grig na nga rang gi slob ma rdor gzhon la sgom cig zhu/ de gnyis min pa'i bla ma dang sgom su la'ang yid mi smon gsungs/ bla ma mnyam med pa khong rang gi slob ma sgom la 'gro ba rnams la/ khyod tshe 'di dang 'dra 'dres kyi chos shig byed na bla ma 'di dang 'di'i rtsar rgyug sa med rdul med kyi chos shig byed na bo dong thogs med de'i rtsar rgyug dang da lta de las lhag pa med do gsung pa 'dug zer zhing mkhan chen bu ston pas kyang*/ sde snod gsum gyi don la mkhas gyur cing*/ / rgyud sde zab mo'i rtogs pa kun chub pas/ / byang chub sems gnyis 'byong pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa yang mdzad cing*/ sems dpa' chen pos zhal lur byon pa'i res/ kho rang gi grwa pa rnams la/ da lta bod gangs can gyi khrod na chos shes nas nyams su blang ngo shes pa rgyal sras thogs med pa tsam yin/ ngas kyang chos shes pa shes te kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyi gsung zhig la brten nas bshad nyan byed dgos pa byung bas/ khong gi 'dra ba'i nyams len byung ba med/ 'di lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po la chos 'brel thos pa tsam res kyang 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ro shes pa yin pas/

mtshams la yod pa rnams kyang*/ kho la chos zhus/ de bar gyi zhabs tog thams cad bla brang nas byed pa yin gsungs zer/ de'i res sems dpa' chen pos kyang*/ zla ba gcig zha lur bzhugs nas gang la gang 'dod kyi chos gsungs nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad ces grag go /de la sogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun gyis bsngags pa brjod pa'i rnam grangs mang po thos so/ /yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / chags sdang dbang gis gzhan dag gi / skyon brjod tshig gi 'phreng ba dang*/ / phan tshun 'phros pa gyur pa bzhin/ / nam yang lhan cig mi gnas pa*/ / skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi/ / bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa gsum/ / snyan pa'i tshig gis bos pa bzhin/ / khyod la rab tu 'dus pa mtshar/ / dmod pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ 'gro mang 'dus pa'i dbus su 'ga' zhig gis/ / mtshang nas 'bru zhing tshig ngan smra na yang*/ / de la dge ba'i bshes kyis 'du shes kyi/ / gus par 'dud pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re gzhan dag gis rang re'i chos rgyud dang bla ma dang rang la smod sa byung ba'i dus su mad lags byas pas/ de kas tshig ske yang chad nas phan tshun rgyud sreg res yang mi yong*/ rang re bzod ldan du yang 'gro ba yin gsungs nas dam bca' yang 'di ltar mdzad de/ 'gro mang dbus su sdang yid ldan pa'i mis/ / tshig ngan bzod par dka' ba dma' phab nas/ / gdong pa 'degs pa'i skabs kyang med byas na/ / de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dngul chu ba'i bya bral ba 'u re ba gcig gis jo mo nang du grub mtha'i gleng mo byed pa 'ga' zhig gi gseb tu byin pas/ la la na re/ bla ma rgyal sras pa de kun grub mtha' dang gang gis yang phyogs zhen mi mdzad par thams cad la dag snang sbyor ba gcig yod pa 'dug zer ba dang*/

gcig na re/ mkhan chen bu ston pa de yang mkhas pa yin pa la nges don 'di ma go /rgyal sras pa'i de yang shes nas btang snyoms su 'jog pa de rang min las che zer ba la khos rtsod pa byas pa'i gleng mo drung du byung bas sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khos ma shes par 'dug mad lags zer rgyu yin te/ kun mkhyen pa'i grub mtha' 'di ni mdo rgyud mang po na bshad/ rgya gar nas kyis grub mtha' rny-ing pa yin pas rang res nor bar ma shes/ mkhan bu ston pa'i grub mtha' 'di yang ni/ khong cig pu'i ma yin/ mdo rgyud phal mo che thams cad dang*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal che ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas de bas kyang 'o skol gyis nor bar ma shes khong bden gsungs/ chos dang chos min blang dor dgag sgrub rnams/ / legs par 'byed pa'i mkhyen gnyis dang ldan kyang*/ / dag snang chen pos chos dang gang zag la/ / phyogs med ris med mnyam nyid mdzad pa mtshar/ / bzod dka' gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa las dang po ni/ bdag gi bu bzhin gces par bskyangs pa'i mi/ / bdag la dgra bzhin lta bar byed na yang*/ / nad kyi btab pa'i bu la ma bzhin du/ / lhag par brtse ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ de la 'di ltar bstan pa dang sems can spyi mthun la gnod pa chen po byed pa de 'dra rnams la 'ga' zhig gis 'di lta bu kun ha cang mi rig drags 'dug zer nas zhe sdang sgom pa gzigs tsa na/ ha cang mi rig pa byas tsa na de ka snying rje ba yin gsungs nas de lta bu'i rnams la lhag par yang brtse bar mdzad cing 'di ltar gsung ngo*/ / bdag gam bdag gi phyogs la gnod byed dam/ / bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la gnod byed pa'i/ / ma rung skye bo'i mthong thos dran gyur na/ / lhag par snying rje'i gnas su shes byas nas/ / rnyed bkur snyan smras sogs kyi dngos su phan/ / gdags par nus na gdags shing mi nus na'ang*/

/ byams dang snying rje drag pos bdag nyid kyi/ / bde dge ci yod de don bsngo ba gces/ /zhes gsung ngo*/ /bzod dka' gnyis pa ni/ rang dang mnyam pa'am dman pa'i skye bo yis/ / nga rgyal dbang gis brnyas thabs byed na yang*/ / bla ma bzhin du gus pas bdag nyid kyi/ / spyi bor le na pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar gsung ngo*/ /rang re la gzhan gyis dngos su brnyas pa dang tshig ngan smras pa'i/ de'i lan ma byas na pha rol po yang zhe sdang mi skye zhing*/ rang re yang skyon med kyi skyes bu bzod ldan du 'gro ba yin/ gzhan gyis mi rig pa byas rang res kyang de'i lan byas tsa na gnyis ka skyon can du 'gro ba yin gsungs shing*/ dam bca' yang mdzad de/ bdag la nyes pa yod dam med kyang rung*/ / mtho dman mnyam pa su yang rung ba yi/ / gnod pa'i rnam pa che chung ci byas kyang*/ / de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gsung ngo*/ / zhe sdang drag pos gang zag gzhan dag gis/ / gnod pa byed na'ang lan du phan 'dogs na/ / snying rje can gyi sems dpa' khyed nyid ni/ / sems can gzhan la brtse ba smos ci 'tshal/ / 'byor rgud gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa las dang po rgud pa lam du khyer ba'i phyag len ni/ 'tsho bas 'phongs shing rtag tu mi yi sa brnyas/ / tshabs chen nad dang gdon gyi btab kyang slar/ / 'gro kun sdig sdug bdag la len byed cing*/ / zhum pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab stai/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ dus phyis bsnyung ba'i dus su/ na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud cing dge sbyor 'phel du song gsung zer cing 'di ltar gsung ngo*/ / nad gdon chom kun dgra sogs dam chos kyi/ / bar chad yin zhes grags kyang rang gi blo/ / las su rung na de kun grogs su 'gyur/ / blo ngan 'di ni dam chos gegs gsung nges/

/zhes pa dang*/ 'byor pa med na med de dga'/ / bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la len/ / 'thab rtsod kyi khro 'khrug ji rnyed pa/ / 'dzin chags kyi nor las byung bar nges/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ / gnyis pa 'byor pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ni/ snyan par grags shing 'gro mang spyi bos 'dud/ / rnam thos bu yi nor 'dra thob gyur kyang*/ / srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying po med shes na/ / khengs pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sa'i steng na 'gran gyi do zla thams cad bral ba'i sems dpa' chen po 'di'i snyan pa'i dri bsung grags pa'i dri gzhon gyis sa'i steng thams cad khyab par byas pas/ rgya nag po'i yul nas kyang stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po dang*/ rgyal bu chen po tang thal rtse dang*/ rgya gar dang ba yul dang ya rtse dang*/ mnga' ris la sogs pa'i rgyal phran thams cad kyis kyang mos gus chen pos shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag po bo dong thogs med ces sogs kyis bstod pa gdams pa bskur bar zhu zhes pa'i 'phrin yig 'bul ba dang bcas pa rim par bskur zhing dad pa chen pos spyi bos gtsug tu bsgom par byed pa dang*/ dngos su mi chen gyi rigs 'dug pa la yang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ti shrī chen po bsod nams blo gros sku mched ta dben kun dga' rin chen dpal rgyal mtshan bzang po/ ta dben kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gdung rgyud rnams dang*/ mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mo dang*/ mkhas btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub chen po khyung ba/ dbus phyogs kyi yang phag gru rin chen/ stag lung rin po che*/ rgya ma rin po che/ mtshal pa'i sgom sde rin po che la sogs mdor na dbus gtsang gnyis kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa phal che ba slob mar 'dus shing*/

gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi ta dben grub shri si tu dpon chen du dben sha la sogs kyi las kha 'dzin pa'i mi chen thams cad kyis kyang spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur zhing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar dgos 'dod kyi longs spyod thams cad rtsol med du 'byung*/ 'das ma 'ongs thams cad mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa thogs med mnga'/ yi dam gyi lha ston nam dngas pa'i skar tshogs tsam gzigs/ ji lta ba dang ji snyaid pa'i don la dbang 'byor kyang*/ thugs la rlom pa dang khengs pa rdul tsam yang mi mnga' ste/ rang gi nye du'i bkur bsti rab spangs nas/ / gzhan gyi bkur bsti 'dod na blos btang nyams/ / de phyi gang du su dang 'grogs kyang rung*/ / mtho dman 'bring gsum spyi bor 'khur ba gces/ /gsung zhing 'di ltar gsung ste/ 'o skol chos pa rnams la yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan gang yod kyang*/ des rang mchog tu 'dzin cing nga rgyal gyis rang las dma' ba la brnyas bcos mnyam pa la 'gran sems/ mtho ba la phrag dog byed na chos gnad du ma song ba yin/ dper na sman gyis nad skyed pa'am/ 'dre shar nas gnod pa la glud nub sgor skyail ba dang 'dra/ des na yon tan du sangs rgyas thob kyang spros bral du shes dgos/ 'gran sangs rgyas tshugs zer bas 'dug ste de dang 'di gnyis dpe mi gcig gsungs/ sgom chen pa thos pa chung nge ba'i rigs nyams cung zad kyis nga rgyal chen po byed pa de 'dra gzigs tsa na/ dmigs su bkar nas mi gsungs kyang chos gsung ba'i bgros la/ sgom chen pa ci rigs shig nyams len tsam re skyes tsa na des ci 'tshengs cha med par nga rgyal rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug gi nang nas che shos de rgyas par byas nas/ blar btsog tu song ba de 'dra yong gin 'dug gsungs/ rang nyid dben par gnas pa'i rlom sems kyis/ / gzhan dag khyad gsod bdud kyi las yin pas/ / 'du 'dzi spangs dang yon tan skye sogs kyi/

/ rlom sems spong ba bstan pa la gces so/ /gsung ngo*/ / shin tu dbul kyang zhum pa'i sems dang bral/ / snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam gling khyab gyur cing*/ / chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ / gus pas mchod kyang khengs pa bral ba mtshar/ /

chags sdang gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa las dang po dgra rang rgyud 'dul ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ rang gi zhe sdang dgra bo ma thul na/ / phyi rol dgra bo btul zhing 'phel bar 'gyur/ / de phyir byams dang snying rje'i dmag dpung gis/ / rang rgyud 'dul ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni rang gi sems thul ba'i stobs kyis/ sems can ma rung shing dmu rgod pa khro zhing gtum pa rnams kyang sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyis dul bar 'gyur te/ gong du bstan pa'i dngul chur dmag byung dus bzhin no/ / sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ chos gcig gi de bzhin nyid mngon gsum du mthong ba bzhin du/ sngon la rang re'i sems 'di legs po cig thul na gzhan gyi sems kyang ngang gi dul ba cig yong gsungs/ de'i shes byed la/ sems 'di gcig pu btags pa yis/ / de dag thams cad btags par 'gyur/ / sems 'di gcig pu btul bas na/ / de dag thams cad btul bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sems can mi bsrun nam mkha' bzhin/ / de dag gzhom gyis yong mi lang*/ / khro ba'i sems 'di gcig choms na/ / dgra de thams cad choms dang 'dra/ / sa steng 'di dag kos g.yog tu/ / de rnyed ko bas ga la lang*/ / lham mthil tsam gyis ko bas ni/ / sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rang rgyud gyong po thul na dpa' bo'i mthar thug yin/ / khong khro'i dgra bo thul na rgyal ba'i mthar thug yin// zhes gsung ngo*/ / gnyis pa 'dod yon la sred pa spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra/ / ji tsam spyad ci nga srid pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ / gang la zhen chags skye ba'i dngos po rnams/ / 'phral la spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btabs ste/ de yang 'di ltar 'dod yon la sred pa chung bas/

gsol kun gang drangs kyang zhim pa dang mi zhim pa'i zhal nyod mi mdzad par gang drangs pa la gsol bas/ gzhan gyis bkur ba dang zhabs tog sla zhing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo*/ / chu rgya mtsho che la 'phyo ba'i nya/ / rkan lcags kyu rnon pos phug pa de/ / rang zas la sred pa ches bas lan/ / sred zhen gyi zas la ma rgyugs na/ / lcags kyus yas rkan 'bugs don med/ / yul mthun rkyen gyis 'khor bar 'dzin pa 'di/ / rang 'dod yon la sred pa che bas lan/ / 'dod yon gyi sred pa spangs tsa na/ / yul mthun rkyen lam gyi grogs su 'char/ / 'dod yon spyaud kyang zhen med shin tu gces/ /gsungs pa dang*/ 'o skol dang po grwa pa'i dus na dngos po gsog pa'i blo ma skyes pas 'phral lto skyid pa cig byung gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi mched grogs bla ma nam rdor ba bya ba na re/ nged grwa tshang yang gcig 'grogs yun ring rgyus che ste/ dang po rang nas snying rje che/ ma nus pa dang bkres pa mthong tsa na gsol 'phro bcad nas gnang gin yod/ 'dzin chags chung nas khal re tsam las med kyang 'di zad tsa na 'khos pa gcig 'char gsungs nas 'tshol phro dang 'dod mthun mi mdzad cing*/ da nang las gsol rgyu med kyang blo la las mi mdzad thugs bde mor gnas pa cig yod gsungs/ rang sems thul bas gzhan sems rang gi thul/ / gzhan gyi don du 'dod yon spyad gyur kyang*/ / zhen chags mi mnga' chags sdang rang sar grol/ / sems dpa' khyod ni 'dam skyes pad mo 'dra/ / don dam byang chub kyi sems ston pa las dang po mnyam bzhag tu spros bral la 'dzin med sgom pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ / sems nyid gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ / de nyid shes nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnams/ / yid la mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/

rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid sgom pa la goms pa'i phyir dang*/ sku tshe 'dir yang ting nge 'dzin gyi bogs dbyung pa'i phyir dben pa 'ba' zhig bsten pa'i stobs kyis/ phra rags rtog pa'i 'gyu ba chad nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dbyings su dag te/ sems chos sku lus 'ja' lus su gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bya dang 'jog byed ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngo bo yang mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po la dbang 'byor bas/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob la khyad med/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo la khyad med/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med la khyad med par dper na tshong pa gser gling phyin pa bzhin du/ snang tshad 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin/ gang shar chos kyi sku'i rol ba/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo/ gang shar chos sku'i yo lang du spyod cing*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad rlom sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad skyes 'gags med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul rnams ni/ bdag lta bu'i blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir brjod par mi nus shing*/ 'di ltar gsung ste/ don dam spros bral rtogs pas mnyam bzhag yo 'gul med/ / kun rdzob sgyu mar shes nas chags sdang 'dzin zhen bral/ / snang stong dbyer med rtogs pas dgag sgrub rang sar grol/ / don dam byang sems sgom la dgos pa'i chos gsum yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ / dran snang chos skur shar ba yis/ / mtshan bcas byas kyang mtshan ma med/ / sems dpa' khyed kyi mnyam bzhag de/

/ tshong pas gser gling phyin pa 'dra/ / rjes thob tu chags sdang skye ba'i yul gnyis la bden zhen spang ba'i phyagalen ston pa ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang phrad pa na/ / dbyar gyi dus kyi 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ / mdzes par snang yang bden pa med lta zhing*/ / zhen chags spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / sdug bsngal sna tshogs rmi lam bu shi ltar/ / 'khrul snang bden par bzung bas a thang chad/ / de phyir mi mthun rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ / 'khrul bar lta ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /dus lan cig sa skyar 'khrug pa byung nas 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched dbus phyogs la bros nas 'byon dgos pa byung ba'i dus/ sems dpa' chen po la bla ma rin ye bas nga la ni 'di lta bu yong ba ha cang mi rigs bsam nas zhe sdang dang sems la mi ran pa che rab yong gin 'dug nyid la byung ngam ma byung gsungs pa'i lan du spyir 'jig rten gyi bde sdug dang chags sdang sogs phal cher rang gi las snang yin zhing*/ de yang snang ba bden med rang gi sems/ sems nyid spros bral yin par shes pa'i go ba ra ri cig yod pa 'dis de lta bu la yang chags sdang gi rtog pa ma skyes gsungs zhes thos shing*/ des na phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang rdo ba'i dus nyid na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal stong du gdod nas zang thal du rtogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du byams pa'i stobs kyis chags sdang mi mnga' zhing*/ 'khor dang long spyod dang gnas la sogs pa gang la yang bdag tu 'dzin pa med de/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol gyi chos rdzong nas chos gzhan gyis dngos po khyer kyang ma byin len du mi 'gro ma byin lan du 'gro ba la bdag tu bzung ba zhig dgos pa yin te/ 'o skol gyis bdag tu bzung ba med pa'i phyir gsungs zhing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo*/

/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems snang yin/ / sems la bde sdug du mar snang ba 'di/ / sos ka'i dus kyi 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ / so sor snang yang bden pa yod min zhing*/ / sems kyi chos nyid yod med mtha' las 'das/ /zhes gsung ngo*/ / chags sdang skye ba'i yul rnams kyang*/ / nam mkha' ji ltar rtag pa yis/ / sems dpa' khyed kyi rjes thob des/ / zhen med sgyu ma mkhan po 'dra/ /de lta bas na byang chub kyi sems gnyis thugs la 'khrungs pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi phyag len bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // de dag gi bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab pa ston pa las dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ byang chub 'dod pas lus kyang gtang dgos na/ / phyi rol dngos po rnams la smo sa ci dgos/ / de phyir lan dang rnam smin mi re ba'i/ / sbyin pa gtong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang dang por za zing gi sbyin pa btang ba'i tshul ni 'di ltar lho sgo ru nad pa nyam chung yun ring pa na ba bza' rgyu med pa gcig la bsod snyoms mdzad pa'i rtsam pa bong khal cig yod pa byin pas sa steng 'chi ba'i 'dre med par byas zer nas ngu yin 'dug de la snying rje drag po skyes gsungs/ lan cig sa skya na sprang po 'chi la khad cig 'dug pa la/ ma shi bar nam la khyis za bar 'dug zer nas sems las 'dug pas/ bya bral ba cig la rngan pa byin nas bsrung du bcug pas/ de'i nub mo shi 'dugasbyin pa de gnyis rgyu chung yang yid tshim pa byung gsungs pas bshad nyan mdzad dus bshad sar bas bshad slong zhus pas nang la 'dong gsungs nas nang du phebs pa dang khyod rang de nas gang dga' ba cig khyer song gsungs pas/ brum rtse bzang po yod pa khyer song gsung pa dang*/

yang bro pas gnang sbyin zhus pa dang*/ khyo rang 'di nas gang dga' ba cig khyer gsungs pas/ gsol sder khyer song gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang na bza' la sogs pa gang yod gnang zhing*/ grwa skor ba la sogs la gzhan snang rgyu med na yol ba bla bre nas kyang bregs kyin gnang zhes thos so/ /thengs gcig nyan pa'i gser slong ba byung nas slong du byung pa la gzhan stair rgyu med par chos stan gyi brum rtse cig yod pa byin pas/ slob dpon gyis tshor nas khong tsho la nas khal cig byin nas brum tshe blangs te khyer byon nas stan gcig pu de las med pa gsungs nas 'thab tu byung gsungs/ yang rtse gdong du chos bar la byon dus nyi ma dpal bya ba'i cam rtse cig sku slu byas nas khyer ba la kho la sems las chen po 'dug pas/ sems dpa' chen po rang la cam rtse gnyis yod pa'i cig kho la gnang ste/ de dus mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa bo dong du byon pa dgun cig srod tho rangs gnyis ka chos gsan du byon pas/ cam rtse cig las med pa des grang po byung yang slob dpon la g.yar na yong ste/ 'thab tu yong bsam nas g.yar ma nus gsungs/ grwa pa'i dus su rtsam pa ched po med kyang sprang po la sder mas bcus kyin gnang tsa na/ de bzhin mdzad nas nyid rang la gsol rgyu mi yong zhus tsa na nam zad tsa na lta rgyu cig yod gsungs nas/ rang nyid dbul song yang gnas kyi slong ba po'i sems spong mi srid ces thos so/ /dngul chur nye gnas med pa'i shul du gser slong la byang dang ra nas yong ba'i mi gsum tsam cig slong du byung ba la na bza' ber thul cig dang rtsam pa gang yod gnang 'dug zer/ yang sprang po cig slong du byung ba la phrug cam cig rdzun la gnang ba la bzang po ster rgyu yod bzhin du mi stair ba dgongs te cam tshe blangs nas ber thul cig gnang bas phyi lo yang snyogs nas slaung du byung ba la phyug gi ring 'gag cig gnang gsungs/

yang thengs cig nye gnas med pa'i shul du sprang po cig slong du byung ba la gzhan gnang rgyu med par/ nye gnas na re/ ra lpags kyi sbud pa bzang po zhig yod pa yang gnang byung bas de gnad pos byung zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs du ma thos te brjod kyi mi lang ngo*/ mdor na rten mchod na bza' dbu zhwa/ zas nor gang slong yang mi ster mi srid do/ /rang re la dgos ched yod cing rang re la phan par nges na/ dbu dang spyan slong yang mi ster ba mi srid do/ / dbul dang nad sogs sdug bsngal gyis nyen dang*/ / 'phongs pas sdig la 'jug la de zlog phyir/ / gter mdzod byang sems sbyin pa khyad 'phags yin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ tshe 'dir lan dang phyi mar rnam smin dang*/ / re ba med pa'i sbyin pa thub pas bsngags/ /zhes gsung ngo*/ /chos der mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa btang pa'i tshul ni/ bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par bya phyir dang*/ / 'gro la snying rje chen pos kun slangs nas/ / zang zing med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa mdzod/ /ces pa dang*/ 'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa mthong gyur na/ / snying rje'i shugs dang thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /'jigs pa bsal nas zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /lo nyi shu rtsa grangs su khor yug tu sku mtshams dam po mdzad pa de grol ba'i rjes shig la/ dngul chur dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la sems bskyed blo sbyong dang skyes rabs dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa gsungs pa'i dus su/ lha'i me tog kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam 'bab ces grag go / yang thengs cig byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug gsungs pa'i dus su me tog char snga ma bzhin du babs pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol la ni 'di lta bu 'byung ba'i yon tan ci yang med/ chos 'di zab drags pas 'di'i yin mchi gsung ba la/ khams pa chos blo bya bas langs nas phyag 'tshal te/

chos rje rin po che de mi gsung bar zhu chos rang gi yin na/ ngas yang spyod 'jug tshar kha yar bshad de/ me tog gi char nyag ma cig kyang ma babs zhus zer/ de khong gi de yin bsams pa cig byung ngo*/ /de nas yun ring rab song ba'i skabs cig la gser yig pa dhar rma kir ti byung nas bo dong du gdan drangs te dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad de 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar byas nas yang sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs yod pa'i skabs su chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gdan 'dren pa la as phud dben shri byung nas/ sa skyar gdan drangs te/ gong ma'i gnang bzhin phul nas/ khyed bla ma'i yang bla mar 'dug khyed kyi bka' bla mas mi gcog pas/ bla ma zhal ta byed pa la 'byon dgos zer nas nan chen po zhus kyang zhal bzhes ma mdzad pa la/ sa skyar gros pas zhu ba byas te da res ma byon na gser yig pa 'di nas mi 'degs par 'dug pas dbus thug ci nas kyang 'byon par zhu zhes zhus pa dang*/ dben shris nged kyang bla ma gdan ma 'drongs bar la 'dir sdod/ nyin re la sems can brgya re tsam bsod pa 'di snying mi rje ba e yin/ khyed gar bzhugs kyang sems can gyi don las med pa la/ nged hor yang sems can yin yod zer bas/ spyan chab shor te/ nyin gcig gis hor 'degs snga na/ sems can mang po la phan par 'dug dgongs te/ sa skya gros pa dang dben shri 'dzoms pa la zhal bzhes mdzad de/ sa skya ru dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag mang po la chos gsungs nas 'gro ba dpag med pa'i don mdzad ces grag go /de nas dgung lo drug cu re bdun bzhes pa'i dus glang lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu drug la bo dong nas btegs te/ dpal sdings dang chu mig dang zha lu la sogs pa rnams su'ang dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad nas/

mkhan chen bu ston pa dang zhu 'brog par lhan du byon pa'i lam khar mdzo mo gcig yod pa la phyag phyi ba rnams kyis zan mang po byin nas/ 'brangs drags nas na ba la/ mkhan pas khro bo'i drag sngags la sogs pa bgrangs kyin byin brlabs byas kyang ma phan par mdzo mo shi bas/ sems dpa' chen pos mdzo mo'i spyi bo nas then then mdzad cing nga'i ma rgan de snying rje gsungs zhing yun ring bshums pa la mkhan pas bla ma pa dang gshegs par zhu gsungs pa dang*/ drung pa rdzun la gshegs par zhu/ 'o skol dub pas mi 'gro gsungs nas yun ring po'i bar du bshums shing bzhugs zer/ rjes la mkhan chen pa'i gsungs te/ mdzo mo'i don grub/ dud 'gro cig la de kun las tshogs bsags pa mi yong gsungs zer/ de nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis zhu 'brog lha khang nas bsdu ba byas te/ rin spungs phebs pa'i dus/ de nas mi mthong sa na sus kyang zhus pa med par ngur smrig gi sgrol ma rang byon bzhugs sa de ri 'di'i mdun na bdog gam gsungs nas mkhyen byung zer/ de nas si tu byang rgyal bas rdzong rnams su rim pa bzhin rgyu zhabs tog byas nas/ dbus kyi sa cha bsam yas la nyin lam gnyis tsam yod pa'i la ka cig tu phebs pa dang*/ sprin dkar po cig la tshad btsugs nas pha gi'i thad na gang yod gsungs pa la/ sa sna ba cig na re/ pha gi'i thad na bsam yas yod zer bas de'i tshod cig 'dug ngo mtshar che/ gsungs pa la slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis ci gda' lags zhus pas/ rgyu mtshan 'dra brda'i gsungs zer/ de na si tu byang rgyal gyis yar lung sne gdong du spyan drangs te/ gus pa chen pos ni bkur/ sgo mang pos ni zhabs tog byas/ gtsug gi nor bu lta bur ni mchod nas/ sne gdong dang khra 'brug dang*/ rtsai thang la sogs pa rnams su dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po rnams la chos gsungs pa'i dus/ lha'i me tog char bzhin du babs pas thams cad rang dbang med par dad par byas nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad cing*/

'chi nges pa'i mi mang po'i srog yang thar bar byas nas zla ba lnga pa la lha sar byon te/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du gser chab gsol dkar me phul/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gsol ba rgya chen po btab stai/ lha sar phyogs thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi skar ma tsam 'dus pa dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po lus pa rnams/ thugs skyed la sogs pa gsungs pa'i tshe/ lha'i me tog char bzhin babs pas thams cad dad par byas cing 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod nas/ gung thang dang gsang sde dang zul skyo dang*/ snye thang la sogs pa chos gang gsungs thams cad me tog gi char babs pas thams cad dad par byas nas phan bde la bkod pa kun la thun mong du grub bo/ /sems dpa' chen po'i drung du mtshur ston rin yes gsang phu dang gzhan du chos gsung dus/ me tog gi char babs pa las kyang*/ lha sa ru chos gsung dus me tog gi char 'bab phul che ba 'dug zhus pas/ gnas kyi khyad par yin mchi gsungs zer/ de nas yang si tu byang rgyal pas yar lung su gdan drangs te/ dpags shi dbang phyug gis brang khar nor dang bcas pa phul nas/ bsam gtan gling du bzhugs pa'i si tu 'khor dang bcas pas zhabs tog rgya chen po bsgrubs te/ rtse thang ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing*/ de'i dus si tu ba la sems dpa' chen pos/ btsun pa rnams la khral dmag dang bu lag 'gel ba 'di bstan pa la gnod pas 'di mi mdzad par zhu gsungs pas/ chos tshul bzhin du byed pa'i btsun pa rnams la ni zhabs tog ngas phar byed kyin yod/ de ma yin pa'i mdar zhing 'debs phur 'brog 'dzin las su tshong khe skyed pa 'di rnams la khral mi 'gel na de nas su la 'gel du 'dug zer nas byung bas 'o skol gyis kyang zer sa ma rnyed gsungs/

de nas gdan sa thel dang bsam yas la sogs rnams su yang chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la me tog gi char snga ma bzhin babs pas thams cad dad par byas nas phan bde la bkod cing*/ si tu bas 'bul ba rgya chen po bsgrubs pa rnams dang gzhan yang dbus phyogs nas byung ba'i phyag rdzas rnams sa skya thog drangs pa'i dgon pa rnams su ja skol btang*/ bshad nyan dang sgom sgrub la brtson pa rnams dang khyad par ma nus pa rnams la gnang zhing*/ thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas yang mtshal pas gdan drangs nas/ si tu dge legs pa dpal bzang po yab sras kyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi 'khor lo skor bas/ de dus rims nad chen po byung ba yang rgyun chad cing*/ btson pa mang po yang thar bar mdzad ces grag go / mdor na dbus phyogs kyis don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs thams cad chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par byas nas lha sar jo bo rin po che'i drung du dkar me phul gser chab gsol bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gsol ba rgya chen po btab nas/ si tu byang rgyal ba la sogs pa thams cad kyis dbus phyogs su gzhug pa'i zhu ba nan chen po byas kyang ma bzhugs par/ gtsang phyogs la byon te yar la stag tshang du spyan drangs te/ bla ma khyung po dang bla ma dbang gi thog drangs de'i dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing lam na yod pa'i sgom grwa bshad grwa grong khyer la sogs pa thams cad du chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po btang ste/ mdor na de'i res dbus gtsang gnyis char du chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas tshim par mdzad nas/ yos lo zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig la ri gru 'dzin dngul chu'i chos rdzong du phyag phebs zhes grag go
/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ / 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod re ba skong bar mdzad/ / sems dpa' khyed kyi sbyin pa'i phar phyin de/ / yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse mchod 'dra/ /

tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ tshul khrims med par rang don mi grub na/ / gzhan don sgrub par 'dod pa gad mo'i gnas/ / de phyir srid pa'i 'dun pa med pa yis/ / tshul khrims bsrung ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni/ so sor thar ba'i sgor zhugs nas bslab pa nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la nyes ltung dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos/ smaun 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ rang bde 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas sgo gsum gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas ma dag pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs te/ snod cud dag pa'i 'khor lo gzigs pas/ sku la tshul khrims dri zhim po ldang te/ gzim khang gi nang thams cad kyang dri zhim pos khyab pa yod cing*/ gsol 'phro'i na bza' dang dbu zhwa la sogs pa gzhan la gnas bsnams kyi dri zhim po yang zla re tsam gyi bar du mi yal bar yong gin 'dug go /dgung lo lnga bcu bdun pa'i bar du sha yang gtan nas mi gsol ba la/ de lo bla ma dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ bla ma dkon rgyal ba gnyis la lung mang po mdzad pa'i dus sku khams zi ba byung bas/ khong rnam gnyis kyis sha gsol bar nan chen po zhus pas/ de phyin chad la phan par dgongs nas gsol ba yin ces grag go / tshul khrims gsum dang bslab gsum sdom gsum la/ / dri mas ma gos tshul khrims dri zhim ldang*/ / sems dpa' khyed kyis tshul khrims phar phyin te/ / nyi zer phog pa'i pad ma gzhon nu 'dra/ / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ dge ba'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i rgyal sras la/ / gnod byed thams cad rin chen gter dang mtshungs/ / de phyir kun la zhe 'gras med pa y-i/ / bzod pa sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/

de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid la gzhan gyis gnod pa che chung ci byas kyang de'i lan du phan 'dogs pa ma gtogs pa thugs su rgyud 'khrug pa mi srid de/ 'di ltar rtogs ldan rje 'bul ba bya bas dngul chur yong nas dang po gzim khang la 'dzegs nas sku mtshams bshig nye gnas la gri bton nas dza sdigs rnams byas/ de'i rting la gser yig pa dang dben shrī'i rtsar rdzun ci rigs byas pa la brten nas/ gser yig pas sems dpa' chen po la bzang btson gyi rnam pa byas pa'i dus na sems dpa'i gsung na re/ sngon la rtogs ldan dang dben shri gnyis kar la tshig ngan re tsam re shor te/ de ma kha dran pas zin nas bshags pa byas khong tsho gang dga' byas la btang gsungs/ dus phyis rtogs ldan dngul chur byung nas phrad ma thag skad cig snga ma la dmu rgod 'di kun ma byung na dga' ba la bsam pa cig byung ba yin te/ skad cig phyi ma la de bzhin byas na sems can blo spangs par yang 'gro/ dus phyis gnod pa byed pa kho las ma byung ba la gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' yang 'gal 'gro/ kho byung ba legs nga kho gang dag byed dgos bsam nas/ chos kyang gang 'dod zer byin/ lto gos kyang ci rigs pa byin/ mig legs shos nas ltos/ ston pa zla bzang la yang kho 'gegs pa la sogs ma byed byas pa'i rgyu mtshan de bzhin yin gsungs/ ma tsam bdag gi bshes la sgo gsum gyis/ / gnod pa byas pa mthong thos dran gyur na/ / bzod dang snying rje stobs kyis gnod byed la/ / ci nus dngos sam bsam pas phan gdags bgyi/ /zhes sogs gnod lan du phan 'dogs par dam bcas pa bzhin mdzad do/ / gnod byed rlung gis 'khrugs par mi nus shing*/ / zhe sdang me lces bsregs pa zhi bar byed/ / sems dpa' khyed kyi bzod pa'i phar phyin de/ / mi 'khrug 'pho ba med pa'i rgya mtsho 'dra/ / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/

rang don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i nyan rang yang*/ / mgo la me shor bzlog ltar brtson mthong na/ / 'gro kun don du yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ / brtson 'grus brtson pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar go cha'i brtson 'grus kyis sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar dam bcas nas/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis dbu yang sngas la mi 'jog cing*/ sku rnam snang gi chos drug dang nam du yang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas/ 'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ / mtshan med dag la mtshan bcas 'di dag gis/ / mi gnod gda' zhing thabs shes zung 'brel phyir/ / brtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed pa spro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la chos spyod kyi rim pa 'di mdzad do/ /nang phyogs bzhengs nas sku khrus mdzad do/ /phyag brgya rtsa re phul ba'i yan lag bdun nas rgyas par mdzad nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len cing gtor ma'i rim pa la tsha gong du dkar cha bzhi/ tsha ba gsol nas brgya rtsa mi g.yo ba dang*/ g.yu gu/ sgrol ma nyer gcig dang*/ bul gtong*/ bar do'i gtor ma la sogs rnams mdzad nas/ yang smon 'jug sems bskyed bsdus pa re blangs nas bskor ba brgya tsa re mdzad pa'i bar de la/ ma ni khri tsho gnyis gnyis/ yum sgrub sgrol ma tshar bcu gsum re/ bhe sha tse nyer gcig rnam rgyal gyi gzungs tshar gcig dgongs mo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bsgoms nas snying po stong phrag re bzlas pa dang*/ gzim khar yan lag bdun pa phul nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len pa rnams mtshams kyi dus su 'chag med yin/ gzhan nges pa med gsungs/ des na gnas lugs kyi don rtogs nas/ chos spyod kyi rim pa nyams su len tshul 'di ni/ sa lam bgrod pa'i dbang du byas na/

nyi ma dang zla ba lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ zhes mdo nas gsungs pa de ltar yin pa nges so/ / srid pa'i bde la chags rdul chen pos kyang*/ / mi ldog brtan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang*/ / g.yel ba med par thabs shes zung 'jug gis/ / lam la 'bad pa sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus yin/ / grangs med bskal bar skad cig re re la/ / grangs med sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ / dpag med sdug bsngal chen po khur blangs kyang*/ / rlom med chog par mi 'dzin brtson 'grus yin/ /zhes sogs gsung ngo*/ / snying rje chen po'i shugs kyi rab bskul nas/ / go cha sbyor ba chog par mi 'dzin pa'i/ / sems dpa' khyod kyi brtson 'grus phar phyin de/ / rta bdun rgyal po gling bzhi phyin pa 'dra/ / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lag len ston pa ni/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ / nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ / gzugs med bzhi las yang dag 'das pa yi/ / bsam gtan sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ mtha' yas 'gro la snying rje che skyes nas/ / bdag nyid bde 'dod sdug bsngal bral 'dod ltar/ / 'gro ba kun kyang de ltar 'gyur 'dod blo/ / bcos min sgom pa bdag gzhan snyam pa ste/ / brtse chen stobs kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ / bdag la smin 'dod bdag gi bde dge rnams/ / gzhan la smin 'dod bcos ma min pa'i blos/ / bdag gzhan rje ba'i byang chub sems mchog yin/ / shes bya'i gnas lugs blo las 'das pa'i phyir/ / yin min la sogs yid byed rnams spangs nas/ / spros med ngang la 'dzin med gnas pa 'di/ / don dam byang chub sems kyi mnyam bzhag yin/ / rjes la snang ba thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ / snang yang bden pa med par shes byas nas/ / zhen med ngang nas gzhan don byed pa ni/

/ don dam byang sems rjes thob nyams len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ sems can thams cad la ma'i bu gcig pa yid du 'ong ba la byams shing brtse ba ltar/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'am bdag pas gzhan gces par sgom pa kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'jug snang ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa don dam byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis goms par byas pa la brten nas/ 'di ltar chos thams cad mi shes pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad 'gyur ba med par mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ pad ma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ le lo thams cad bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ri rab 'dra ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ 'jig rten gsum la mngon par ma zhen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug tshul dang*/ spyan lnga dang mngon par shes pa drug dang*/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sogs yon tan brgya phrag du ma mnga' tshul rnams ni/ bdag lta bu'i blo dman pa'i yul la 'das pa'i phyir/ brjod par mi spobs shing*/ zhing khams gzigs tshul dang*/ mngon par shes pa mnga' tshul gsungs pa gcig gnyis gcig brjod na/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus na'ang*/ rmi lam du dag pa'i zhing khams gang 'dod pa lta ba dang*/

de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa la chos nyan nus par zhig yod ces mkhan byang rtse ba la gsungs ces thos so/ /chos gsungs pa'i tshe na yang lung 'dren la sogs pa'i tshig nam thogs dus spyan nam mkha' la cher mdzad pas shar re gsungs nas yong ba 'dug pas yid dam gyi lhas shod pa yin nges par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes chen po byung zhing*/ thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub bo/ /sngar snga mo'i dus su ston pa zla bzang kyis sa skyar don gcig la phyin dus mkhan byang rtse ba bsnyungs nas da res rang sku gshegs pa 'dra zer yin 'dug pa thos nas ston pas tshur dngul chur slebs dus drung du zhus pas/ de nyin thugs khral chen po mdzad yin 'dug zer/ sang tsha ba'i dus su/ mdang ngas rmi lam cig bzung nas mkhan byang rtse ba la byin brlabs dang dbang bskur yang bya/ rten 'brel brtags pas da res mi lto ba'i rigs su 'dug gi gsungs zer/ dus phyis bsnyung ba'i dus su rmi lam du phyin pa'i zhing khams de rnams kyi bkod pa ji ltar mthong ba bzhin yi ger bkod pa cig byed bsam pa yin na'ang mtshams kyis dus dge sbyor res sems brid nas ma grub/ mtshams grol nas chos nyan rnams kyi 'dod pa skong skong nas brel drags pas lag len la ma thebs gzhan gyi bskul mkhan yang ma byung bas lan gsungs zer/ mngon par shes pa gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ mkhan byang rtse ba la nga'i 'di bden te nyams pa'i rnam rtog cig byung ba/ chos gsungs pa'i 'phros la mi la la'i rnam rtog la nga'i 'di kho na bden snyam pas 'dug te/ de yang bag min gsung bas 'jigs chum pa ci byung gsung*/ slob dpon seng ge dar la sku 'gag gcig gnang ba mthong bas slob dpon bde bzang gi rtog pa la yang sku 'gag cig gnang na snyam pa byung bas/ khong gi gnas khang sleb pa dang*/ sku 'gag cig skyel mi btang bas/

ngo tsha ba la tshugs pa ma byung zer/ lo tsā ba nam bzang gis shing thog cig 'bul ba mthong bas shing thog la bro ba ci 'dras yod bsam pa byung bas/ bro ba ci 'dra bdog gam legs po gda'o gsungs nas/ khong gis mdun du skur byung bas khong la kha skyengs po byung zer/ mkhan po zang phug pa'i rtog pa la/ gzim mal na g.yi dkar gyi gdan cig 'dug pa mthong ba dang*/ 'di nga la yod na bla bre byed pa yin te snyam pa byung ba dang*/ gdan de gnang nas nyid cag rang re la gang dga' ba mdzod zer nas byung zer/ gzhan yang dngul chu ba la dmag yong ba'i dus mngon par shes pa gsungs pa dang*/ gser yig pa byung ba'i res mngon shes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma thub pa la mngon shes gsungs pa dang*/ nye gnas ston pa la mngon shes lan mang por gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon yon tan 'od la gsungs pa dang*/ jo nang pa'i dge slong blo gros bzang po la mngon shes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal ldan bzang po yul du 'gro ba la mngon shes gsungs pa dang*/ bdag rang gi yang sems kyi rnam rtog mkhyen nas gsungs pa la sogs pa'i rnam grangs su du ma zhig thos te yi ge mang dogs nas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / gzung 'dzin zhi bde brlabs kyis bskyod mi nus/ / ting 'dzin bang rim mngon shes drug gis mdzes/ / sems dpa' khyod kyi bsam gtan phar phyin te/ / rin chen bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po 'dra/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ shes rab med na pha rol phyin lnga yis/ / rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mi nus pas/ / thabs dang ldan zhing 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i/ / shes rab sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni thos bsam gyis shes rab kun rdzob bden pa'i gnas lugs thams cad gtan la phebs pas ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i shes rab chen po dang ldan zhing*/

rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po gnyis zung 'jug tu bsgoms pa la brten nas/ don dam bden pa chos kyi sku mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i shes rab chen po dang ldan pas/ chos thams cad skye mched pa'am rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i mkhyen gnyis kyi 'od zer chen pos/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom nas gdul bya'i phan bde'i lo tog smin par mdzad nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang bas phyogs thams cad khyab par mdzad cing*/ 'di ltar yang gsung ngo*/ /shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rtsi yis ma zin na thabs kyis chu kun la ji tsam 'bad cing snying rje kun ji ltar che yang 'khor ba las ma 'das/ 'khor ba las ma 'das byas nas bzhag pas yang mi yong*/ thabs kyis cha yin pas med thabs med/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang bral na/ shes rab kyis bdag med pa'i don mngon sum du rtogs/ lta ba kun ji ltar mtho yang nyan rang gi lam las ma 'das/ dper na bya nam mkha' la 'gro ba la gshog pa g.yas kyang dgos te g.yon kyang dgos pa ltar/ thabs shes rab zung du ma 'brel na gang rung cig gis sangs rgyas thob par mi nus te/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*/ / des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ / 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom byed na'ang*/ / 'khor ba 'di gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ / gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ / 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'da' mi gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs/ de ltar thabs kyi cha la 'bad gyur kyang*/ / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mi 'gyur bas/ / bden gnyis gnas lugs 'di ltar sgom par bya/ rang bzhin med pa kun rdzob rang bzhin yin/ / mtha' las 'das phyir nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/

/ rkyen las skyes phyir skye ba med pa ste/ / rten 'brel yin phyir rang gi ngo bos stong/ / dam pa'i don ni spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ / smra bsam brjod med 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis/ / 'ga' yang mthong med tshul gyis mthong ba yin/ / de ltar chos nyid spros dang bral ba las/ / mnyam bzhag mi gnas tshul gyis gnas byas nas/ / rjes thob chos kun sgyu 'drar shes pa yis/ / ye shes tshogs ni rab tu rdzogs par 'gyur/ / zhes kyang gsung ngo*/ / mkhyen brtse'i bsil zer rab tu 'phros pa yis/ / ma rig mun pa'i tshogs kun legs bcom nas/ / gdul bya kun da'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad de/ / rang byung ye shes ze 'bru gsal bar bya/ / mkhyen gnyis ldan pa'i sems dpa' khyed nyid kyi/ / dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba 'dra/ /de lta bas na/ pha rol du phyin pa drug bsgoms pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya zhing*/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi le'u ste drug pa'o// //

mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi la bslab pa las dang po rang gi 'khrul pa la brtag pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ rang gi 'khrul ba rang gi ma brtag na/ / chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas/ / de phyir rgyun du rang gi 'khrul ba la/ / brtags nas spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang rang gi 'khrul pa la brtag pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar gsungs te/ rang la rang gi gros 'di 'debs so ke mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang bzang ba'i yon tan gang yang med bzhin du/ rang bzang por re ba'i rlom stangs can/ /rang skyon ri rab tsam yang mi mthong zhing*// gzhan skyon rdul phran tsam la'ang rtog /rang don zhe la bzhag nas gzhan don byed par smra/ /chos par rdzus nas tshe 'di'i che thabs 'ba' zhig sgrub pa khyod kyis snang yang rang gi spyod pa la ma brtag par rang gis rang bslus sngar yang sdug bsngal mang po myong zhing*/ da dung 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol ba'i gdeng med pa 'di khyod rang gis nyes pa yin zhing*/ da yang gtan gyi bde ba thob par 'dod na dben pa'i gnas su sdod la blo bla ma dang dkon mchog kho na la gtod/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad spongs la chos brgyad can gyi mi dang ma 'grogs/ rang 'dod 'khri ba chod la gzhan don gyi go cha skye/ nga rgyal dang khong yus spongs la dman cha zung*/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mdzad spyod bsams la dka' thub kyi dran skyed ces sogs gsung ngo*/ / byang sems kyi nyes pa mi gleng ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ nyon mongs dbang gis rgyal sras gzhan dag gi / nyes pa gleng na bdag nyid nyams 'gyur bas/ / theg pa che la zhugs pa'i gang zag gi / nyes pa mi smra rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ chos kyi gsung gleng dang gzhan la phan pa'i gsungs tsam la rtogs pa/

don med kyi smra brjod mi gsung zhing*/ khyad par du gzhan gyi nyes pa gleng ba gtan nas mi srid cing 'ga' zhig gis nged kyi bla ma bzang*/ khyed kyi bla ma mi bzang zer ba la/ chos zab mi zab dang*/ lta ba log ma log sogs gzhan gyi nyes pa gleng ba gsan na/ dmigs su bkar nas mi gsung kyang*/ chos gsung ba'i dus su/ spyir long gtam la snying po med/ mi dge ba 'phel dogs su gzhan la smad pas rang mi mtho ba'i steng du/ nyes pa 'phog chags sdang 'phel/ khyad par chos dang gang zag la sde rigs su phye nas smod pa 'di rang 'jigs gsung*/ smra ba mang pos mi dge skye srid cing*/ / de ma skyed kyang don med du 'da' bas/ / rang sa gzhan la phan nges ma rtogs pa/ / smra brjod spong ba brtson 'grus grogs su gces/ /gsungs so/ / sbyin bdag gi khyim la chags pa spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ rnyed bkur dbang gis phan tshun rtsod 'gyur zhing*/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur bas/ / mdza' bshes khyim dang sbyin bdag khyim rnams la/ / chags pa spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pas ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched kyi yum bsnyung ba'i dus/ sems dpa' chen po dngul chu nas gdan drangs te/ tshe dbang dang gtong len gyi dmigs pa mdzad pas re zhig nad las grol bar mdzad cing*/ ma gcig pa'i dgongs pa la/ zla ba cig bzhugs pa'i zhu ba byed dgos bsam nas/ dbang gi 'bul ba yang ma byas par nang phyogs spos phor khyer nas gdan 'dren du phyin tsa na/ tho rangs kha gsang nas dngul chu bzhud 'dug ces grag go /lan cig dar sdings pa'i ma gcig yum sras gsum g.yog mo dang bcas pa mjal du byung bas/ nye gnas kyi sras mo yin pa ngo ma shes par/ g.yog mo dang sras mo mnyam por za ma ngan ngon las ma drangs pas/ 'dis sras mo ngo ma shes par 'dug

ko long yong las che brda' cig btang na snyam pa sha shar nas/ ga re gang byung la thong zhog snying po med bsam nas bzhag gsung*/ skabs cig tu rang res gzhan gyi dad rdzas dang 'bul ba'i rigs ye mi len pa yun ring po byas kyang*/ de'i rjes la 'bul ba cher byed pa la gdab lan chung ngu gter/ 'bul ba chung ngu byed pa gdab lan cung drag tu ster bas kyang yun ring rab cig byas/ da lta ni tig tig med/ gang byung la bzhag gsung*/ yar lung pa'i bskor rab kun gyis 'bul ba chen po rim pa mang po byas te/ rang res gdab lan ja sun cig kyang blud pa med gsung*/ rtsub mo'i tshig spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ rtsub mo'i tshig gis gzhan sems 'khrug 'gyur zhing*/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul nyams 'gyur bas/ / de phyir gzhan gyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i/ / tshig rtsub spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol gyi su la'ang tshig ngan smra mi nus gsung zhing*/ ji 'dra cig la yang*/ bla ma'am slob dpon nam dge bshes dbon po'i ston pa'am/ dpon la sogs pa'i zhe sa ma bcug par ming nas 'bod pa mi srid cing*/ dus gtan du 'grogs pa'i nye gnas la'ang*/ ston pa zla bzang gsung ba ma gtogs ming rkyang pa nas 'bod pa'i srol med do/ / nyon mongs pa spong tshul gyi phyag len ston pa ni/ nyon mongs goms na gnyen pos bzlog dka' bas/ / dran shes skyes bus gnyen po'i mtshan bzung nas/ / chags sogs nyon mongs dang por skyes ma thag / 'bur 'joms byed pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btab ste/ de yang 'di lta thos so/ / thengs gcig rgun 'brum/ chang la ka ra dkar po btab pa cig drangs pas/ de res gsol nas/ rting la drangs pas ha cang yang ro zhim drags 'dug pas/ ha cang ro zhim pa dang dang mngar ba'i sred pas mthung na yang nyes par 'gyur ba yin gsungs nas mi gsol bar 'dug zer ro/

/ 'khrul dang skyon brjod zhen chags rtsub tshig dang*/ / nyon mongs mun pa'i tshogs kun legs bcom nas/ / yang dag thar lam legs par gsal bar mdzad/ /bstan pa'i sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/ mdor na gang du spyod lam ci byed kyang*/ / rang gi sems kyi gnas skabs ci 'dra zhes/ / rgyun du dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ / gzhan don sgrub pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ ched par dang por mdo rgyud nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bas gzhan don sgrub tshul ston pa ni/ bdag byang chub la nan tan byed pas gzhan yang byed du 'jug pas te/ de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya'o/ /zhes pas/ mgon po byams pas/ bshes gnyen dam pa dul zhing nyer zhi ba/ / yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gi phyug / de nyid rab tu rtogs pas smra mkhas ldan/ / brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs pa bstain ces dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang*/ / bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ / skyon med skyes bu dam pa ni/ / chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes dang*/ brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ / bstan pa nyid dang lag bskyang dang*/ / dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel ba/ / 'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi brtags/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbang ler/ dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg par lhag par gnas/ /de nyid bsgoms shing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs/ /slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpa' rab grags pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi don thams cad gong du brjod zin cing*/

des na skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang bas/ rim gro dang bkur sti dang*/ mchod pa byas shing bsten par byas pa rnams kyis 'di phyi thams cad kyi don grub pa yin no/ /dad mos kyis chu gtsang gis gang ba'i gdul bya'i snod du sku gnyis kyis gzugs brnyan gsal bar mdzad pas gzhan don bsgrub tshul ston pa ni/ ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ / lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ / de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ / thub pa'i dbang po sku yi gzugs brnyan shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo'i gsung na re/ ngas skabs 'ga' rer spyan ras gzigs su mthong yin yod gsungs zer/ da yod pa'i rtags su khong gi bla ma'i mos gus de 'dra ba gzhan la yod par mi 'dugakhong mnga' ris na bzhugs pa'i dus zhu yig gi lan gsung yig dang na bza' cig bskur bas rgyang grags tsam gyis nas khong rang gi dbu mdzad pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis snam sbyar gsol/ rol cha khyer nas bsu ba mdzad phyag mang po phul byas zer/ bsnyung gzhi yod pa la phan par 'dug gsungs nas gsang chab gsol ba dang*/ bshes khu rgyun du mdzad/ chos gsungs pa'i dus su chos rje spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal nas gsungs te lung 'dren thams cad kyang sems dpa' chen po'i gsung sgros 'ba' zhig la mdzad cing*/ bdag gi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dum pa 'di rje rin po che la brten nas byung ba yin gsungs nas mtshan brjod pa'i tshe yang phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan chab 'byin cing*/ sems dpa' chen pos kyang gzhan la ma gnang ba'i bla med dang yo ga'i dbang bka' ci rigs dang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid rdzogs par yang mkhan chen pa la gnang 'dug go /nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yod pa'i rtogs ldan cig dang lab byung bas/ khong na re ngas skabs 'ga' rer rje rin po che'i mgur yan chad de bcu gcig zhal du mthong ba de 'dra byung*/

bde bar gshegs pa'i dus jo nang na yod pas shākya thub pa'i rnam pa ru nam mkha' la byon pa mthong zer/ yang khams pa'i bya bral ba cig chos nyan 'phro la gangs te se la 'gro 'dod pa byung ba'i nub mo rmi lam du sems dpa' chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi rnam par byon nas/ khyod gar 'gro ba yin/ chos nyan 'phro 'di nyon la rgyug gsungs pas/ zla bo byung yang 'dres shol nas bsdad zer ba dang*/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi gsung na re/ nyang stod pa yin pa'i bya bral ba cig gis 'dir khrid zhus nas bsod snyoms la song nas log byung bas/ khong na re dmar khrid zhu dus khyed thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi bar mngon gsum du mthong ba cig byung de'i byin brlabs yin pa 'dra/ bsod snyoms la phyin dus/ khyed thugs rje chen por spyi gtsug tu bsgoms tsa na khyi rnams log gis song zer/ de kun 'o skol thugs rje chen po dngos su mthong zer nas dag snang chen po gda' gsungs/ bya bral ba nam mkha' 'od zer bya ba rdor gling na mtshams la yod dus/ rmi lam du/ sang rong gi 'phags pa wa ti 'di mar byon par yod khyod mjal du e 'gro zer nas byung bas/ gnyid sad nas de ci yin snyam nas yod tsa na/ yon bdag gis sang chos rje rgyal sras pa 'di na mar 'byon pa yod zer ba'i brda' skyel mi cig btang nas byung zer ba dang*/ yang dbus pa'i dge bshes bla ma'i mos gus chen po byas pa cig ngang lab zhib po byung bas/ dang po dngul chu phyin pa'i dus su mjal kha ma byung par sgug dgos pa byung ba'i nub cig rmi lam du chu chen po cig la ma thar bar lus 'dug pa la/ mi dkar po cig byung nas thag pa skya nar ba gcig btang byung ba la 'chang pas pha rir then pa rmis pas bla ma 'dis bdag kyang 'khor ba'i chu bo las sgrol bar 'dug snyam pa byung zer/ yang nub cig bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyis nam mkhar sprin dkar po'i go bar nas rgyang byung ba la/

stod pa cig shar te 'phro la gnyid sad zer/ dus da nas bzung nas bla ma la spyan ras gzigs dngos kyi 'du shes skyes shing mos gus thun mong ma yin pa tshud las/ dge sbyor 'phel ba'i skabs cig tu bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral med du song tshad pa cig yang byung ba yin te/ phyis lod du song dred nas de 'dra mi 'dug zer/ dus phyis khong gis sems nyid ngal so'i khrid zhus pa'i dus nyin cig sems de yang rang bzhin gyis gnas pas byung zhing sems dpa' chen po'i zhal ras g.yon pa'i logs la sku mdog zhal ras dang mthun pa la thugs rje chen po khar sa pa ni'i rnam pa gtsug tor dang bcas bzhengs pa cig de'i nyin nas mthong zer/ de nas zhag gcig gnyis song ba'i dus su slob dpon 'jam dkar ba dang gral lhan du byung bas/ chos rje'i zhal ras g.yon logs 'di la lha'i rnam pas 'dug te e gzigs byas pas/ zhal ras ma ltas nas/ nyid rang gi rnam rtog yin mchi nyid kyis kyang rdzun ma zer a zer nas byung*/ khong rang gis rgyun du mthong bas mos gus kyis khyad par du 'dug snyam pa cig byung zhes grag go /yang chen po dpal rgyal bas tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur zhus dus ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs su sems dpa' chen po'i zhal ras dkar tsher re yod 'phro la/ dbu skra'i mtshams nas dmar khrig khrig yong zhing*/ cung zad song ba dang*/ zhal ras li khri'i mdog ltar dmar la dngas par mthong bas/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dngos kyi 'du shes skyes ces grag go / karma ma pa rang byung rdo rje'i bu chen rmi lam dang rtsa rlung la mnga' brnyes pa'i rtogs ldan spro bo bya ba la bdag gi mjal du phyin dus/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gleng byung bas/ khong gi gsung na re/ sngar gi byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan de dang*/ skyer sgang de gnyis kyang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin par 'dug

da lta khyod kyi bla ma bo dong thogs med de thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan nga'i rmi lam du yang byung gsungs/ khyod kyang bla ma de la mos gus tshul cig yin par 'dug lar yang khyod kyi bla ma de ri chen po cig gi steng na thugs rje chen po'i rnam par byas nas nga la yang ma ṇi pad me'i chos ston gsung yin 'dug pa rmis gsungs/ lar yang thugs rje chen po zer tsa na/ mdog dkar dkar byas pa'i gyang logs na bris pa de la zer ba ma yin/ sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa lta bu'i 'du shes mnga' ba/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klong 'khrug pa khyod kyi bla ma de 'dra cig la zer ba yin/ nga yang rkang pa dang mig mi bde ba min na de dang cig mjal nas thugs rje chen po'i chos skor 'dra ba zhu 'dod de gsungs/ nga'i rtsa ru gtsang phyogs la 'gro zer ba'i slob bu byung tshad la thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa bo dong thogs med la mjol gcig khyung po rnal 'byor gyi skye ba nga'i grogs po khyung po ba tshul khrims mgon la mjol cig gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i rnams grangs mang po thos te/ mang pas 'jigs nas ma bris shing*/ bdag rang la mngon par shes pa gsungs tshul dang*/ dag snang gi mthong snang byung tshul than thun yod pa rnams ni/ bdag skrag par gyur dogs pa'i phyir 'dir ma bris so/ / las can rnams kyi sangs rgyas dngos su mthong*/ / dag snang can gyi spyan ras gzigs su mthong*/ / rmongs pa yis kyang bshes gnyen dam par mthong*/ / sprul sku bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// 'bad med lhun grub kyis 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gzhan don sgrub tshul ston pa ni/ ji ltar nor bu 'bad med par/ / rang gi 'di ni ston pa ltar/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni gzo med par/ / de bzhin mdzad pa nges par bstan/ / ji ltar mkha' la 'jig rten gyi/ / bya ba rgyun mi 'chad par snang*/

/ de bzhin zag med dbyings kyis kyang*/ / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs med ngang nas zhen med gzhan don la/ / brtson par byas pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab cing rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad de/ gsung rab kyi 'phrin las kyis rgya nag po'i yul du rgyal po yab sras kyis phyag tu yang phal che ba phebs nas gzigs pas shin tu dad par gyur te/ 'di pa mdzad pa'i bla ma de gdan 'drongs na/ nged hor mi thams cad tshogs bsags pa yin zer nas/ mjal ba med kyang rtag tu mtshan brjod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ gsung rab rnams kyi lung yod pa rtsad bcad nas lung len pa/ khyad par du rgyal bu chen po de ni blo gros kyi nor bu ldan pa cig yod par 'dug pas/ mdo sde rgyan gyi ṭīkka sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa de/ gser yig pa 'ga' zhig la lung thob nas gdan drangs te/ ṭīkka de'i steng nas mdo sde rgyan smra ba la mkhas pa tsam yod ces/ dpags shi rnams gleng ngo*/ /de lta bu'i rgyal bu chen po des rgyal sras lag len la 'grel pa legs po brtsams nas rgya nag gi phyogs thams cad dar bar byas yod ces kyang grag go /gzhan yang rgya gar bal po mdo stod smad/ mi nyag gi yul/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum la sogs pa thams cad du sems dpa' chen po gsung rabs rnams kyis phebs nas/ 'bri ba dang klog pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed par gyur to/ / zhes grag go /des na sems dpa' chen po 'di'i mtshan thos pa thams cad kyang tha shal cig ma rtogs pa ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'byin par byed la/ sku mthong pa tsam gyis tshe 'di'i snang ba dang bral nas blo sna chos la 'gyur zhing*/ thugs dran pa tsam gyis snying rje dang ting nge 'dzin 'bad rtsol med par skye zhing khrid btab pa'i dus su phal che ba sngon 'gro'i dus nas sgom rang babs su skye ba kun gyis mthun snang du grub cing*/

dus phyis zla ba dgu sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs nas/ zla ba gsum gsum sku mtshams sengs te/ phyogs thams cad nas 'dus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang*/ tshe blos btang ba'i bya bral ba rnams kyi skar ma tsam dang*/ gzhan yang mi chen gyi rigs la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang*/ mdor na tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad cing*/ de'i dus su gzhan gyi phul ba'i sna lo dang*/ sha khyi dang tshe thar gyi lug yod pa kun kyang dus re rgyug ste 'dus nas chos nyan yin yod pa la thengs cig snar thang nas khrid zhu ba la byung ba'i btsun pa cig gis khos bla mas gsungs pa bzhin ma byas par/ shes pa phar spro ba dang*/ tshur bsdu ba dang*/ de ma khad nas rlung bsgoms 'dug pas/ kho smyau nas tshogs chos gsung pa'i dus su sgren mor shor byung ba la kho 'dzin du phyin pa rnams la rdo rgyab nas 'gro sa ma byung skabs su/ gna' mo drung nas chos nyan yin yod pa har te langs nas kho'i phyir rgyugs song ste/ har har langs yin te kho la brdungs tsa na khos ra co nas bzung yin phyir 'bul byed kyin tshogs chos ma grol gyi bar du khong gnyis 'dzin yin 'dug gzhug khos dran pa rnyed nas 'dug pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ da rang khos dro ma bteg mchi/ nyid kyi gos cig g.yog nas khrid shog gsungs/ kho'i tsar bdag gi phyin pas dran pas rnyed nas ngo tsha zhing 'dug drung du khrid phyin pa dang*/ rje btsun ma tshar cig gsungs nas byin brlabs mdzad do/ /de ring nyid kyi gegs sel de gna' mo mos byas/ mos kyang go cang gsung ba la/ khos ngus pas/ sgrol ma gyis la skad chen po thon la ngus gsung bas/ gna' mo des rje btsun ma'i 'phrin las byas pa yin par 'dug /lar bla ma la byin rlabs dang thugs rje yod tsa na dud 'gros kyang mi'i gegs sel nus par 'dug snyam pa byung zhing*/

de lta bu'i ya mtshan che cig byung ba de dus kyis tshogs pa thams cad la mngon sum du grub bo/ /bla ma khyung po'i slob ma gsum gyis bogs 'don gyi gdams pa cig zhus zer yin 'dug pas/ tshe 'di blos thong sems can la byams snying rje sgoms bla ma la gsol ba dungs pa thob la spros pa med pa'i ngang la yengs pa med par zhogs gsungs/ de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di ni 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i mi chen rnams las kyang*/ snyom chung chos don du gnyer ba rnams la mnyes cing khyad par du khrid zhu ba rnams la mnyes te/ khrid zhu ba 'di rnams dus rgyun du rang bsgom pa ma byung yang khrid zhu ba'i rin de la 'jur po re sgom par 'dug de stobs kyi phal cher la nyams myong dga' rab skye yin 'dug pas/ gdul bya skyong ba'i dus khrid 'bogs pa 'di 'gro don chung rgyu mi 'dug gsungs/ phyogs phyogs nas kyi mjal 'phrad pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur ba nang na yod pa'i dus su/ khrid pa rnams 'tshogs nas gda' zhus na/ do zhag mtshams grol ba'i skabs 'dir gal che shos 'chad pa 'di yin pas/ gzhan rnams dum pas sgor byon/ khrid pa tsho la shog gis gsungs nas/ chos gsungs*/ 'gron po mang po rang nang na yod na stan khyer 'o skol rang sgor chos 'chad du bya'o gsungs nas phyir byon nas chos gsung ngo*/ /da lta'i slob dpon tsho la ltas de lta bu'i mdzad spyod rang dka' bar gda'o/ khrid tshar ba'i rjes thams cad du mi la ras pas dwags po lha rje la gdams ngag zab shos rang cig yod pa 'gro khar sbyin zer ba'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas thams cad la sgom skyes 'dug pas snying rus skyed la sgom dgos pa yin/ sgom chen po bya ba stan thog tu sdod tshugs pa rang cig dgos gsungs/ yang dgon pa 'drongs khar khong gis gsung na re/ nga shi nas khyod sgom chen pho mo rnams kyis rab kyi lo dgu dgu 'bring gi lo gsum gsum tha mas kyang zla ba gsum gsum ri la bsdad nas sgrub pa ma byas na/

nga dang dam tshig med gsungs nas zhal chems bzhag 'dug de bzhin du thams cad kyi rgyun du sgom pa byung na ni shin tu legs/ ma tha la yang srod tho rangs dran tsam re ma byas na dam tshig med pa yin gsungs pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i drung du khrid zhus pa rnams kyis kyang ye ma sgom par rgyang skyungs rang byas na dam tshig la 'gal 'gro nyen yod pas 'bum gsum gdon dgos pa yod do/ /mdor na slob bu'i rigs kyang*/ rgya gar rgya nag bal po hor yu gur sog po/ 'ga'/ mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang*/ ya rtse mnga' ris la sogs pa'i mi rigs dang*/ skad rigs mi cig pa grangs med pa cig smin cing grol bar mdzad cing*/ sems dpa' chen po 'di'i rnam par thar pa dang*/ 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyi mi langs te/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la ltas na skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho na la sbyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ ting nge 'dzin dang mngon pa shes pa mnga' tshul la ltas na/ skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas ting nge 'dzin kho na bsgoms pa 'dra yod/ rmi lam la dbang thob pa la ltas na skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ sgyu lus rmi lam kho na la goms par byas pa 'dra ba yod/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa'i ltas skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas bskyed rim kho na la goms par byas pa 'dra ba yod/ sku tshe 'dir yang dang po bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus kyi slob ma ston chen thon pa la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa bshad nyan mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ sku mtshams dam po bcad pa'i lo grangs la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa dben pa brten pa 'dra ba yod/ phyag dang skor ba mdzad pa'i grangs chad la ltas na sku tshe rangs la phyag dang bskor ba kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ ma ṇi dang rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i grangs chad la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa bzlas brjod kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/

so sor thar pa'i sdom pa phog pa'i slob ma dge tshul dang dge slong la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa mkhan slob mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slob ma la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa phog pa 'dra ba yod/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'khrungs nas gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' byed pa'i slob ma la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi khrid bskyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa don dam byang chub kyi khrid bskyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ des na sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa'i gru chen por zhugs te/ tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen po nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi nor bu blangs te/ sems can grangs med pa'i dbul ba bsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul bdag gi blos mi 'tshal zhing thams cad kyi gzigs pa de'i yin no/ / tshad med bzhi'i nam mkha' yangs pa las/ / bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i 'od stong dang ldan pa'i/ / 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i tsha zer rab 'phros pas/ / gdul bya'i gling bzhi'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ / thub bstan pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad de/ / stong nyid snying rje'i ze 'bru gsal ba las/ / phan bde'i bcud dang ldan pa'i sbrang rtsi yis/ / gdul bya bung pa'i tshogs rnams tshims par mdzad/ /

dge ba byang chub bsngo ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/ de ltar brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir/ / 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyis/ / byang chub bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar gsungs te/ dge ba bsags pa byang chub tu ma bsngos na/ yul khyad par can la khong khro skyes pa la sogs pa dge ba mdzad pa'i rgyu 'ga' zhig byung na mdzad cing*/ byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dge ba ni mi mdzad pas/ rang nyid cig pu'i don du khams gsum gyi bde 'bras dang theg pa dman par mi bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che/ bsngo ba'i dpang por rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsams la/ bsngo bya sngo byed la sogs pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs bzhin du bsngo/ bsngo bzhin mi dmigs par shes dgos/ de ltar mi shes na yang 'o skol so so'i skye bo mos pas spyod pa yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs kun du bzang po la sogs pas ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin bdag gis kyang bsngo snyam pa byas pas chog gsungs/ bsngo ba'i tshig kyang 'jam dpal dpa' bos zhes sogs rnams gsung ngo*/ / dus gsum dge ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ / khams gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal phyir du/ / 'khor gsum dag pa'i tshul gyi bsngo mdzad pa'i/ / bsngo ba mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de man chad kyis phyag len sum cu so bdun gyis don tshan rnams bstan zin nas/ da brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu ba ston pa la/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams la gsungs pa'i don/ / dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi rjes 'brang nas/ / rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len sum cu bdun/ / rgyal sras lam la slob 'dod don du bkod/ / ces pas/ gang gi don du brtsams pa bstan/ / blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung pa'i phyir/
