/ mkhas pa dges ba'i sdeb sbyor ma mchis kyang*/ / mdo dang dam pa'i gsung la brten pa'i phyir/ / rgyal sras lag len 'khrul med legs par sems/ / zhes rgyal sras lag len 'khrul med yin par bstan/ / 'on kyang rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen rnams/ / blo dman bdag 'dras gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ / 'gal dang ma 'grel la sogs nyes pa'i tshogs/ / dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ / ces pa khengs skyungs zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ / de las byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ / kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems mchog gis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ / spyan ras gzigs mgon de dang mtshungs par shog / ces pas brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /mdor bsdu na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod kyis rnam par thar pa rnams la sgro ma btags skur ba ma btab par don la gnas tshod ci dang ci yin pa ma lus par brjod nus kyang*/ thams cad yon tan kho na brjod par 'gyur gyi skyon gyi gnas skabs su gyur pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ bdag lta bu'i blo dman pa rnams kyi yul las 'das kyang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gdan sa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pas 'khrungs yul dang rigs rus/ yab yum dang*/ bla ma bsten tshul dang*/ mdo rgyud po ti mkhyen tshul rnams thams cad rags rim cig sems dpa' chen po rang gi gsungs pa de la gzhi byas/ sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo dam pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo'i gsung las byung ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma bsten yun ring ba rnams kyi gsung las byung ba ci rigs/ khyad par du lo sum cu rtsa grangs kyi bar lus dang grib ma'i tshul du zhabs tog bsgrubs pa nye gnas ston pa'i ngag las byung ba rnams dang*/ bdag rang gis mthong thos la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams kyis nang nas che long tsam zhig btus te rgyal sras lag len dang bstun nas bsnyung ba'i tshul ma bstan gong yan chad kyi sku tshe 'di'i rnam par thar pa rags rim cig bkod pa'o/

/de lta bas na mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi nyon mongs pa spong tshul/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba la bslabs pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos gzhi nyon mongs pa spong tshul/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams gdul ba dang las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa stan pa'i phyir zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar/ bdag cag dbus su 'gro ba'i dus su/ ma shi na zhabs drung du myur du yong par zhu zhus pas/ bde mchog gi thugs dam gyi thang ka dang na bza' gcig gnang nas/ 'o skol rgas drags pas da rang ched pos mi sdod mchi/ nyid log nas yong dus 'o skol rang phrad pa dka' gsungs pas/ dus rgyun du thugs sna thung thung gi gsung 'byon pa de/ de dus rang bzhin gsung ba yin snyam pa ma rtogs pa mngon shes gsung ba yin snyam pa ma byung ste/ thog tu khel byung ngo*/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i sngar lo ngam rings chos rje'i nye gnas dge bshes rgyal bzang bya ba dang*/ nye gnas ston pa la zhu ba brgyud nas/ sang red sku mtshams gsengs nas zla ba gsum chos gsungs pa de/ mdog gis sa char byon pas gsungs par zhu/ dpon slob du byon pa'i zhabs tog dang mgron po ji tsam byung ba 'dam la byin zer ba gang dgos pa nged rang gis sgrub/ drung du zhus zer nas zhus pas/ khong gi de lta sems nan ltar bzang blo stobs che ste/ rang red sang phod da tsam rang khong gis gdan 'dren pa de las thag ring cig tu 'gro nyen 'dug /lar gyi kyang da na so rgas pas/ zla ba gsum gsum po'i mtshams gseng ba 'di la/

g.yeng ba ches 'dug snyam yod pa la/ de na yar 'gro ba la ga la yod/ khyed la nor yod par 'dug pas/ nga gdan ma 'drongs kyang chos phyogs gzhan dang gzhan du gtong bar zhu gyis/ sang red gzhan du 'gro ba'i gleng mo de kun khong dang gzhan la 'da' ba/ grags pa btegs pa las mi yong gsungs zer/ yang de'i zla gong du gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa yod pa 'dug zer ba cig thos nas slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi drung du zhus pas/ yong don med mchi/ pho tshod med par byung srid na'ang*/ de gong du gdan 'dren gzhan cig yod par gda' yi gsung zer/ de'i e sku mtshams la 'jug khar phyag rdzas gang yod thams cad 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dag skye bo'i rnams la 'gyed chen po mdzad cing*/ byang chub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rgya chen po bsgrubs/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i gzhan don kho na mdzad pa'i zhor la/ rang don thob bya thams cad thob/ spangs bya thams cad spangs/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyis kyang*/ sku rgyab bsnyung ba dang*/ sman pa 'tsho byed las sman bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa ltar/ sa mo bya'i lo zla gnyis pa nas bsnyung pa'i tshul bstan te/ lha rje la ston pa dang gsol sman bsten zhu zhus pas/ nga'i bsam pa la sus kyang ma tshor bar shi ba cig byed bsam pa yin gsungs pas/ nye gnas kyis phyis mi thams cad kyis gsol sman bsten pa la sogs pa'i zhu ba gang yang ma byas zer ba'i khag yong lags zhus pas/ de rang mad gsungs nas/ lha rjes phyag rtsa ltas pas gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pas phebs pa la lta rgyu mi bdog mchi gsungs zer/ de'i dus su nyin cig slob dpon nam mkha' seng ge la brgyad stong pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags dang rtag tu ngu gnyis kyi le'u sgrogs gsungs la/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thob tshul gyi skabs su/

nged kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di dag gi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin la ltas na/ gang mnyam par bzhag par bya ba'am/ byang chub tu spyod pa la gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i chos de gang yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te zhes pa'i skabs su/ de 'dra cig rang yin gsungs nas/ yun ring po'i bar du ting nge 'dzin la 'byams zhes grag go /de dus drung rang du nyin cig mi lngas sman bla'i cho ga rgyas pa cig skad gsang mthon po'i sgo nas byas pa tshar rting*/ yun ring po zhig na/ khyed rnams kyis sman bla byas sam ma byas gsung ba la tshar zhus pas/ khyed rnams grabs byed 'dug pa de dran pa yin te/ rjes la mnyam bzhag cig la yengs nas/ khyed rnams kyis cho ga byas pa ma tshor ba 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus sa g.yo ba dang*/ nam tho rangs kha gzims khang dang stan gyi bar thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa la sogs pa'i ltas chen po rnams byung bas thams cad sems ma bde bar/ sku rim la 'jad stong bskor bsags nas 'gyed byed pa dang*/ sku rim dang gsol 'debs nang mar bsgrubs pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs thams cad du gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ khyad par du bdag nyid chen po nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo dam pa mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo dang*/ chos rje nyi ma gzhon nu gnyis kyi bzhugs stan phul me tog gtor nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i mthu chen po bsten nas/ zla gsum bzhi'i dbang du bsnyung pa dngas par gyur to/ /zhes grag go /de'i dus su sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khong rnams gnyis la nad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra dang kha med kyang dge sbyor 'phel du song*/ rig pa dang po yod gsungs zer/ de nas yang zla ba bdun pa nas bsnyun log pa'i tshul bstan te/ spyir yang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku thob pas/

bsnyun mi mnga' yang*/ yang dag ji bzhin mthong ba'i phyir/ / skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*/ / snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang*/ / 'chi dang na dang rga bar ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa la/ da rung sman dang lha rje bsten pa zhu zhus pas/ na so mthar phyin pa dang nad 'dzin ches pa'i phyir/ phan par dka' bas dgag sgrub med par rang sor glod nas 'jog pa yin/ lar yang rang nyid mi bsgrub pa de la gzhan la yang bstan par mi rigs/ 'o skol gyis dod lo sa skyar phy-in dus/ tsibs ri ba yin pa'i rtog ldan cig sa skya'i yang dgon na nad drag pos btab 'dug pa cig na re/ nad la sogs pa lam du 'khyer na ji ltar byed zer ba la/ bdag gzhan sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di/ / na na na ste na bas dga'/ / sngar bsags kyi las ngan 'dzad pa yin/ / chos spyod kyi bya ba sna tshogs kyang*/ / sgrib gnyis sbyong pa'i ched du yin/ / na ba med na med de dga'/ / lus sems bde na dge sbyor 'phel/ / mi lus don can byed pa yang*/ / sgo gsum dge la sbyor ba yin/ / 'byor pa med na med de dga'/ / bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la med/ / 'thab rtsol kyi khro 'khrugs ji snyed pa/ / 'dzin chags kyi nor las byung bar nges/ / 'byor pa yod na yod de dga'/ / bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bas chog/ 'phral phugs kyis phan bde ji snyed pa/ / bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yin par nges/ / myur du shi na shi bas dga'/ / rkyen ngan gyis bar du ma chod cing*/ / mtshams sbyor gyi bag chags bzang 'grogs pas/ / ma nor gyi lam du tshud par nges/ / yun du gson na gson pas dga'/ / nyams myong gi lo thog skyes pa la/ / gdam ngag gi brlan drod ma yal bar/ / yun du bsten pas smin par 'gyur/ /ces bstan pa bzhin du/ 'o skol rang gang byung la dga' ba sgom pa'i man ngag 'di nyams su len pa'i phyir phan pa'i thabs mi tshol/ don la nad ces bya ba grub pa yang med cing*/

'khrul pa'i blo ngor snang ba 'di/ rgyu 'bras slu ba med par ston pa'am chos pa'i shan 'byed lta bu'am sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i thabs mchog kyang yin/ dge sbyor gyi bskul lcags lta bur yang 'dug pas/ 'di spong ba'i thabs mi tshol/ phyogs kyi rim gro 'di rnams kyang nga thar la 'chir ma bcug gsung ba la/ drung gi zhal mthong ba dang gsung thos su re ba'i gdul bya dpag med mchis pas da rung sku tshe byin gyis rlob par zhu zhus pas/ phru ba'i nang na med par gzar bur 'byung ba 'di mi rigs pa yin na'ang*/ phan thogs pa yang mang rab byung*/ gzhan don gyi las la ches bya ba ma mchis kyang*/ 'o skol gyi tshod rtsis pa'i zang zing yang cung mang ba tsam yang mi shi yang gzhan don chung du yang mi 'gro mchi gsungs pa las/ drung nas gzhan don gzhan du rgya che yang*/ bdag cag gdul bya rnams mgon po med par 'gyur bas/ ci nas kyang bzhugs par zhus pas/ nus pa med na lhan cig 'grogs kyang dgos pa chung nus pa byung na myur du 'gro ba thams cad sgrol bar 'dod na/ blo gtad pa'i ltos dang bcas pa khyed rnams yal bar ga la 'dor/ nga dang phral ba la mya ngan bya mi dgos/ rgyun du gsol ba thob dang kho bo yod mtshungs kyi gsungs zhes grag go / de'i dus mkhan chen byang rtse bas byon nas gdan bzhugs zhus pas ma bzhes par/ tshur la gdan bzhugs mdzad/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sngar gyi bzhugs gdan gyi steng du yang stan brtsegs gsungs nas mkhan chen pa bzhugs su bcug rten 'brel mdzad pas/ dngos su gsung ma byon yang bzhugs stan gyi steng du bzhugs gsungs pa de/ chos rgyud zung zer ba'i zhal lta ru go zhes nye gnas ston par gsung ngo*/ /de dus thams cad la mjal kha cig gtong bar zhu zhus pas da lta'i skabs 'di 'drar phrad kyang rang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod pa las mi yong gsungs zer/ de'i dus kyang mtshan bcas kyi thugs dam rnams ye ma chags par mdzad pa dang*/

gnal bsrung ba'i phyir/ dkon brtsegs bsgrags pa'i dus/ mgur ma blangs pa'i dus su/ shugs chen po bshums pas/ do zhag mtshan bcas kyi thugs dam rnams kyang glod pa dang*/ khyad par du snying rje'i dmigs pa mi mdzad par zhu/ glo bur du gser ma byung dogs yong bar gda' zhus pas/ 'o skaul gyi mtshan med la mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor gyis mi gnod par gda' zhing thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i phyir/ rtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed spro bar 'dug snying rje'i dmigs pa ched kyis ma bzung kyang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam ngang shugs kyis skye bar 'dug byung rgyal du btang na nyid cag rnams yang bar dogs nas dran 'dzin chen po byas pa yin/ 'chi khar 'pho ba yang sgom pa la 'di 'dra'i 'phro la shi na legs pa yin mod gsungs zer/ de dus spyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa thob pa/ khyad par du sgyu lus rmi lam la dbang 'byor ba'i mkhas sgrub chen po/ sems dpa' chen po'i thugs la bla ma rdor gzhon pa bya ba dngul chu na sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i chu skyel la zhu ba bskur nas/ drung nas bskur pa 'di la gsol ba thebs mi thebs kyi rmi lam gcig bzung nas lan cig yig ger btab la bskur bar zhu zhus pas/ da res rang gsol ba thebs snyam pa mi 'dug lhag pa'i yi dam lha dpag tu med pa 'du ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro sa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ lha dang lha mo du mas mchod pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa rnams kyis bsu ba dang*/ chos rje nyid kyang zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la thugs spro ba rnam 'gyur la sogs gtan tshigs su du ma zhig 'dug te/ zhib tu bshad na ci rigs kyi blor mi shong pa'i rgyu mtshan cig 'dug pas mi 'chad de tsam gyi go mod gsungs zer/ de dus jo nang gi sgrub pa mo rlung ltas rtag po yod zer ba cig na re yang*/ sems dpa' chen po bsnyung pa 'di la/

khong rang gis zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad na gsol ba thebs tsam du 'dug ste/ sems dpa' chen po khong rang yang bzhugs pa'i thugs dgongs mi mdzad pa thugs thag btungs 'dug pas/ sku rim kyang gal che ste de bas kyang drung la rang gi rten 'brel gtso che zer ba thos nas/ drung du zhus pas/ 'o na rlung ltas kyang re rtags yod par 'dug 'o skol la sdod pa'i mtshams rang med gsung zer/ 'o na 'di ltar gyis gsungs pa'i zhal ta gsungs par zhu zhus pas/ sngon gyi dus na dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la g.yog po rnams kyis kha chems 'jog par zhus pas/ kha chems khams 'di bzang du song tsa na byed zer ba'i gtam cig 'dug ste/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis khams 'di bzang du 'gro rgyu cig mi yong*/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan dar gyis kyang don gyis na/ kha chems 'dra ba'i yi ge cig bskur 'dug kha chems 'jogs pa skabs su babs dug na'ang*/ nad kyi gdung lus kyi shed zad pa'i skabs 'dir tshigs bzhi po re tsam pa dang lab pa la yang cung gal yong gin 'dug lar gyis 'o skol khams bzang dus su'ang chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang*/ khrigs ka 'di ltar yin gyi tig tig med par/ gang byung la gtong gin yod pa de yin mod/ nga 'chi kha dang shi ba'i rjes la 'di ltar byed kyi khrigs ka de bas kyang ga na 'ong*/ gal te kha chems la nyan mkhan yod na sngar khams bzang dus rang gis shes tshod dpe mkhyud med par bstan/ rtsom pa yang che chung ci rigs pa byas shing khyad par du tshigs bcad che chung mang dag cig yig ger bkod pa/ de rnams kha chems yin/ de ma gtogs do zhag 'brel med tshigs su smras pa la song med/ de la bsams nas phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ shi yang kha chems gzhan 'ga' ma mchis so/ /byas pa de ka yin/ nyid cag rang rnams kyang blo dkon mchog la gtod tshe 'di dang ma 'dres pa'i chos re gyis/

sems can gyi don du chos tshul bzhin du byed pa thams cad rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rgyud 'dzin yin pa la/ 'o skol gyi lta mos kyang ci 'tshal/ des na kun gyi chos rgyud kyang legs par zung*/ khyad par du ston pa zla bzang rang yang dge sbyor la 'bad pa thon/ bya bral ming btags yin pa'i phyir/ longs spyod med na legs pas/ nga'i rjes su bre gang btang rgyu ma byung kyang bzod/ nus pa byung tshad kyis snyom chung la byams su byed pa dang*/ khyad par du da lta rang res skyong dgos yin yod pa'i ma nus pa 'di rnams bskyang ran legs po gyis/ sdug ge rnams snying rje ba yin/ la'ang rgyu'i dngos gzhi de ka yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ / nang gcig phyag mdzub g.yas pa nam mkha' la ker mdzad nas/ mdang kha che paṇa chen shākya shri dpon slob la 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur bzang po grub yod do gsung ba la/ drung nas 'bul ba mdzad pa'i dus na kha che paṇa chen gang na bzhugs lags zhus pas/ byams pa mgon po'i drung na bzhugs mchi gsungs zer/ de la 'phros pas/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la sngar nas byang cha chen po cig yod/ zhing khams grangs med pa lta ba dang*/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la chos nyan pa la sogs pa 'bad rtsol mi dgos par yod pa cig byung*/ bar skabs cig tu 'grib 'dug pa yin ta/ ding sang na ba 'dis rmi lam song tshud 'dug ma 'gags pa'i snang ba 'di mtshar che bar skabs su 'grib pa de yang*/ gso de ka 'dra de skyes pa des yang lan nam gsungs/ lar blo chos su song ba re byung na 'jig rten gyi bsod nams chen po skad zer ba 'di kun la byung na rang legs par 'dug te/ 'bad rtsol gyis ma bsgrubs par byung na longs spyad du rung ces sogs kyi dgag sgrub mang po bshad 'dug na'ang*/ 'byor na'ang 'byor pa lam du slongs/ rgud na'ang rgud pa lam du slongs pa 'di la ci dru'i cu gal cig 'dug gsungs zer/

zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs/ slob dpon dpal ye la dmar rtsaung slaung la mdun rgyab cig bsgyur gsungs te/ de bzhin byas pas/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas yun ring po bshums pa'i bar skabs cig tu gsung mang rab byon pa'i tshig 'bru gang yin ma go nas/ nang par rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nga bsnyem ma nyal byas pa de'i mdun na rje btsun byon 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma'i 'dun du nga nyal bsdad pas mi yong*/ rtsor langs la gsol ba gdab dgos bsam nas de lta byas pa yin gsung ba la rje btsun ma rnal 'byor ma lags sam sgrol ma lags zhus pas/ spyan nam mkha' la cher mdzad nas/ sgrol ma sgrol ma ces lan gnyis gsungs pas/ rje btsun ma gsung 'byon gi gda' lags sam zhus pas/ hā de 'dra mi 'dug ste/ 'o skol dngos kyi sems can gyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas rje btsun ma la byas pa med pa'i yus mang po btsongs gsungs de dang dus mtshungs pa/ nyang stong du si tu 'phags pa'i sar bu mo grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa cig la/ lhab kha babs nas dang por mig gi yul rgyal 'pham 'chad pa'i 'phro la/ de 'dra rnams ta cha med de/ nyi ma nub phyogs ya gi nas bla ma rgyal sras thogs med bya ba zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la rje btsun ma sgrol mas g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gdan drangs nas 'gro ba 'dug zer nas byung zhes grag go / de dus nyin cig da rung yug cig 'chi na mi 'chi bar 'dug kyang rtsa kho ni btul 'dug rtsa la yang 'jungs mi 'dug gsung nas phyag rkyang byung ba la bltas pas rtsa btul btul 'dug ste/ de la brten nas bsnyung g.yog pa cig gis/ bla ma la mos gus che rab yod kyang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes med pa'i rtags sam/ 'on kyang gsung 'di rnams 'byon pa'i rkyen du/ rtsa btul ched po mi sdod pa yin zer/ gal te mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas sku gshegs na/ 'pho ba la sogs pa thugs dam gyi gsal 'debs 'di ltar gyis gsung ba'i zhal ta thugs la 'dog mi mtshams ma lags sam zhus pas/

he nyid ni mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas shi na zer yin 'dug ste/ shi yang mi 'dod thog tu bab pa min/ 'di kho yong ba'i grabs cig sngar du tshar mi rgan gyi las thabs zin/ pho lo bdun cu don lnga lon 'dug tshe yang thung thung min/ mtshams grol nas mi mang po 'tshogs pa dang chos ston pa'i 'phro yang med pas na ba'i dus kyang snga/ 'chi ran 'di 'dra cig yang 'dug snyam pa'i blo'i lhag ma yang lus pa med/ do cig nas ston ston 'di 'gro don re dga' re yong gin 'dug te/ 'gro don chung ngu yang mi 'gro byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di dang nam yang 'bral ma myong*/ na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud byas pa dang 'dra bar/ ci yin cha med cig la khar sing lcid po na ba nas bzung ste ding sang gi bar du/ lus la shed med kyang lhag par du byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'phel ba'i skabs 'di 'jog pa'i 'chi ba rnyed dka' yang*/ bdag gis 'bad med du rnyed pa dkon mchog drin yin/ de lta bu'i ngang nas 'chi ba de ka 'pho ba zer ba yin/ gzhan gsal 'thebs bya rgyu med/ byas kyang dga' ru e gtong yang mi shes de'i sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ sus kyang g.yeng par 'gyur ba med/ ces pa de rang khyed rang rnams yang ma 'gal bas mdzod gsung zhing de nas kyang zla ba phyed dang gnyis bzhugs zhes grag go /zhing khams gang du skye ba zhes zhus pas/ 'gro la phan par 'gyur na dmyal bar 'gro ba yang shin tu spro mi phan na dag pa'i zhing yang mi 'dod lags zhus/ de dus dgong cig maṇḍal dang mchod pa sna lnga khyer shog gsung nas/ bdud rtsi phyag mdzub kyis gtor zhing phud mchod rgyas pa re mdzad/ yang phyag thal mo sbyar zhing dbu dud pa re mdzad/ mchod pa rnam lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan lnga bskyar yin 'bul/ drung na 'khod pa rnams la yang mchod pa phul gsung nas spyan chab 'byin gyin 'dug pa'i nang par rgyu mtshan zhus pas/

yi dam 'dra byon pas khyed rnam pas yang mchod pa phul byas pa yin/ gzhan bshad rgyu tsam mi gda'i gsung nas/ zhib cha gsung du ma gnang zhes grag go /slob dpon yon tan 'od bsnyung g.yog kyi re mod la yod pa'i skabs su nub cig srod kyi cha la ma dag pa'i las snang thams cad 'gags nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dngas shing thogs med pa nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rgya khyon dang rtsa gnas gzhal bar mi nus pa 'dug gsung gin phyag nam mkha' la yug yug mdzad de/ btegs na spar spar gyis byed/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa la sogs pa mtshar du che ba cig gi dbus na/ rang re 'dug pa de'i khor yug kun gyi tshogs grangs med pas bskor 'dug de dus rtsa na yod pa'i gnad yin na bla ma rgya ma ba rnam pa gsal bar 'dug gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi snang ba za zi lang long brjod kyis mi lang pa cig 'dug te/ da ste mgyogs por 'gro bar 'dug gi gsung zer/ de'i nang phyogs slob dpon dpal yes glang ri thang ba bde bar gshegs kha bzhin du/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu gda' lags sam zhus pas/ da lta za zi'i snang ba sna tshogs gcig la yengs nas 'gro yin 'dug te/ de thams cad la mngon zhen bya rgyu med/ rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra gsung zer/ bde bar gshegs la khad pa'i dus der yang sngar nas nyal ba dang mnyes pa la ma goms par/ tsog tsog por sdod pa 'di ka bde bar 'dug gsungs nas dang po bsnyung ba'i mgo brtsams nas phyis bde bar gshegs kyi bar du/ sku rnam snang gi chos bdun dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas/ bcu dgu'i nub mo nas gsungs gcad mdzad de/ spyan la yang 'gyar 'gyur med par/ 'od gsal chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gdul ba dang*/ las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa dang*/ zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che bar dgongs te/ sangs rgyas 'das nas lo gsum stong lnga brgya dang gsum song ba'i dus/

sems dpa' chen po nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhes pas/ sa mo bya'i lo zla ba bcu pa tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu/ res gza' spen pa'i nyi ma'am/ skar ma lag la yod pa'i dgong mo'i cha/ gzim khang chos rdzong gi spu shu la nyi ma nub pa dang mnyam du/ 'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig nas/ chos sku zhi ba chen po'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ de'i tshe bar do na gnas pa'i sems can grangs med pa'i don mdzad de/ de'i nub mo yang*/ dngul chu'i steng gi bar snang thams cad 'ja' tshon sna lnga dang*/ 'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyis khengs te/ sgra chen po grags pa dang*/ dri zhim po'i ngad pas khyab pa dang*/ sa chen po g.yos pas sman bla'i tsag khri'i steng nas gser sku lhung pa tsam byung zer cing*/ lha'i me tog gi char kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu bab ces grag go /de'i dus su mi thams cad mya ngan gyis gdungs pas ngud mo'i sgra chen po 'byin pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ gna' mo dang sha khyi la sogs dud 'gro yis kyang mya ngan chen po byas te/ bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa nas gna' mo dang sha khyi gnyis ka ri la rgyang bcad nas gzims khang tho phyir la ma 'khor ba la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i nyin mor byung nas ched dang*/ don gyis gzims khang la skor ba mang po byas te/ gdung la gsol ba 'debs pa'i skabs su/ gna' mo de yang na ba med par gzim khang gi 'og na 'pho ba btab pa bzhin byas nas shi 'dug zer/ sha khyi de yang de nas ring por ma lon pa shi 'dug go /sems dpa' chen po de nyid bde bar gshegs nas zhag lnga nyi ma drug song ba'i nub mo/ mtshams dam po la yod pa'i sgrub pa po dag snang can 'ga' zhig gis spyan gzigs khar sa pa ni spyan drangs te bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs par mthong ba dang*/ la las rje btsun ma sgrol mas bsu ba byas nas/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa mthong ba dang*/

la la dag gi kha che paṇa chen gyi gdan drangs te/ dga' ldan du gshegs par mthong ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bsus te/ po tar lar gshegs pa mthong ba dang*/ la la dag ni mchod rten dkar po bar snang khengs pa zhig gi bang rim la rim gyis 'dzegs nas byon te/ rdo rje dril bu'i sgra sil sil sgrog bzhin du/ 'o skol 'og min du 'gro yong gsung nas/ mchod rten dang bcas pa nam mkha' la gshegs par mthong ba la sogs pa'i mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma zhig 'dug jo nang gi sgrub pa mo tshul bzang bya ba'i nyams snang la spyan ras gzigs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig 'dug pa bshigs nas shar phyogs la bzhud pa'i snang ba byung zer ro/ / gang zhig mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston tshe/ / la ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ / khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog sgrol ma sogs/ / yi dam dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ / mi pham mgon dang paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs/ / chos dang zang zing mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ / ma 'ongs zhing khams gdul bya dang bcas pa/ / gzigs shing gshegs par mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul ston pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar bde bar gshegs nas zhag bdun nas spur bzhus te/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos thog drangs pa'i/ bu chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i zhal phyai ste/ gdung la mchod pa yun ring por phul nas/ sa skya'i thog drangs pa'i dgon sde thams cad du ja skol la sogs gshegs rdzongs rnams legs par bsgrubs pa'i skabs su/ gdung khang zhal phye ba la de dus sku byon pa ni ma mthong zer zhing*/ ring bsrel dngas shing 'od 'tsher ba mu tig gi mdog lta bu byas pa ni mang po mthong zhing*/

rang rang so so'i lag du phyin nas bde mchog dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ don zhags dang sgrol ma la sogs pa byon 'dug zer ba thos shing dngos su mthong ba ni med do// bdag rang la bde bar ma gshegs gong du gnang ba'i zhal chems cig la/ dung g.yas su 'khyil pa la nyi zla'i gzugs kyis brgyan pa byon pa ni thams cad kyi mthong ba de yin no/ /de nas sku gdung ring bsrel thams cad/ rgya nag yan/ rgya gar tshun chod/ thams cad du khyab par byas te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po khu dbon dang*/ rgyal po chen po yab sras kyis thog drangs pa'i che 'bring chu gsum/ mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi phyag tu theng ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur to/ /khyad par du chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang gu shṛ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam pa gnyis kyis/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lang khang du/ nang rten de bzhin gshegs pa sman bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sku/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan bzhengs nas de'i khri rgyab rin chen dpung par bzos te/ khri rgyab la sman bla'i lha tshogs thams cad tshang bar bkod cing*/ legs par grub pa dang sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa dang*/ bka' 'bum dang na bza' la sogs pa bzhugs shing bzung 'bum dang*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal mo che'i dbu skra dang*/ gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa nang du bzhugs te/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la/ zung khar rin chen sdings su/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rab tu gnas pa mdzad nas/ yang gdan drangs te/ yang ga'i gru la byon pas/ chu phar tshur gnyis ka 'ja' 'od kyis 'brel ba byung zhing*/ dpal sdings la sogs pa'i gdan drangs pa rnams su 'ja' 'od dang me tog char bab zhing mdor na yang lam 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad nas/

bo dong e'i kun dga' ra ba na/ e pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i phyi rten rnam rgyal gyi gser 'bum dang bcas pa'i drung na mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag tu med pas spras te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis mchod pa'i yul du bzhug so/ /de'i rjes la yang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos zhal lta dang bdag rkyen dngos gzhi mdzad/ dbus phyogs nas skud gser lhag ma ni brgya dang nyi shu byung ba'i phal cher kyang sku la gsol te/ bstan pa'i gtso bo'i sku mi tshad ma sprul sku 'dzam gling brgyan/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku 'dra dngos su byon pa 'dra ba bzhengs te/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa dang*/ dbu zhwa na bza' la sogs zhal gsol sder dang*/ gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po'i dbu skra gsung ri srel dang*/ gzungs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos/ chos rje nyi ma gzhon nu gnyis kyi rab tu gnas pa mdzad de/ ri bo po ta la dang mtshungs par 'gyur pa dngul chu'i chos rdzong na/ mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spras te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad du mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs so/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po dang po bsnyung ba nas brtsams te/ bde bar gshegs nas spur sbyangs su/ gdung la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs gshegs rdzongs byed pa'i dus thams cad dang*/ mthar phyi rten dang nang rten bzhengs nas rab tu gnas dus mchod pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi dus su 'dir/ gang gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gshig byas nas/ / dag pa'i zhing gzhan gshegs par gyur pa'i tshe/ / spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun sgrol ma la sogs/ / yi dam dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ dpa' bo dpa' mo lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ / bsu ba'i phyir du nam mkha' sprin bzhin stibs/

/ ri dang bcas pa'i sa chen rnam par gsol/ / lha rnams kyi ni rnga bo che dag kyang*/ / zab cing snyan pa'i sgra chen sgrog par gyur/ / tsan dan phye mal bsgos pa'i me tog rnams/ / nam mkha'i nang nas lding zhing 'bab par byed/ / mtshan mos dus kyang 'od kyi du ba yi/ / ston ka'i zla bzhin rab tu gsal bar snang*/ / ser bu dal dbus ldang ba'i rlung gis kyang*/ / ljon shing sna tshogs me tog dri zhil thul/ / rab tu gus pas de la mchod byed 'dra/ / lha'i bu dang bu mor bcas rnams kyang*/ / me tog sogs kyis gus par mchod pa yi/ / thal mo sbyar ba pad mo kha 'bus 'dra/ / sprin chen rnams kyis bla re bris pa ni/ / lha bzo mkhas pas bris pa'i sa ṭa 'dra/ / bar snang 'ja' tshon sna lngas khengs pa ni/ / la la dar gyi yol ba bkram pa 'dra/ / la la 'ja' tshon lding khang phub pa bzhin/ / la la rma bya'i 'jug ma bkram pa bzhin/ / la la rma bya'i gdugs legs phub pa'am/ / za 'og bla re lta bur rnam pa mdzes/ /de bas na gdul ba'i don du/ mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan tshul dang*/ de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul gyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // rtsol bral gang gi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gting*/ /rtsol bcas blo'i dpag par mi nus kyang*/ /rtsol bas legs bshad 'phreng bas mchod pa 'di/ /rtsol med thugs rje che la dad pa dang*/ /gzhan la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun phyir dang*/ /rang gi dad pa'i dran pa gso phyir du/ /gang gi yon tan rgya mtsho'i chu gter nas/ /chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te brjod pa la/ /'gal dang ma 'brel nyes pa gang mchis pa/ /blo dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /de las byung ba'i dge bas 'gro kun gyi/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang myur du thob par shog

/chos sku kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings las/ /gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa yi/ /mkhyen rtse'i tsha zer 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /ma rig mun sel chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong thos dran gyur na/ /spyan chab si ti'i rgyun ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa de la 'dud/ /thabs kyi gru chen shes rab zags ldan can/ /gang gis bzung ste 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can thams cad sgrol bar dam bcas nas/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa de la 'dud/ /snying rjes gzhan gyis dbang du gyur pa yis/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len byed cing*/ /bdag gi bde dge gzhan la gtong mdzad pa'i/ /kun rdzob byang sems 'byongs pa de la 'dud/ /dran snang thams cad chos skur shar ba yis/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i sprin tshogs mkha' la yal/ /ci ltar spyad kyang phyag rgya chen mo'i klaung*/ /don dam byang sems 'byongs pa de la 'dud*/ /dpag bsam shing dang nor bu rin chen ltar/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /'gro ba'i dgos 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /sbyin pa'i gter chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshul khrims gnyis dang bslab gsum sdom gsum la/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs kyi ma gos pas/ /dge sbyong mchog gyur rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshul khrims mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag cing*/ /gnod pa byas kyang khro bar mi byed la/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis 'khrug par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bzod pa'i rgya mtsho bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /snying rje chen po'i shugs kyis rab bskul nas/ /'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /brtson 'grus mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyi dang nang gi dben pa rab brten nas/

/ting 'dzin brgya phrag kun la snyoms 'jug cing*/ /mngon shes yon tan kun la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /bsam gtan mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos kun skye ba med par rtogs pa'i blo/ /dmigs med snying rje che dang 'brel pa'i mthus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /shes rab mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /ma skyes mi 'gag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /dbyings rig dbyer med so sor rang gis rig /chos sku mngon du gyur pa de la 'dud/ /dag pa'i gnas su mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /rgyal sras rnams la theg chen ston pa'i gsung*/ /bde stong zung 'jug zag pa med pa'i thugs/ /nges pa lnga ldan mnga' ba de la 'dud/ /grangs med zhing du grangs med sku sprul nas/ /grangs med gsung gi grangs med chos bstan la/ /grangs med sems can tshogs rnams smin mdzad pa'i/ /grangs med sprul pa 'gyed pa de la 'dud/ /mkhyen rtse'i gangs ri'i ngogs nas legs 'ong pa'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /phan bde'i lo tog smin par mdzad pa yi/ /'phrin las mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'grel pa 'grel bshad rnams/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la rab mkhas pas/ /bshad rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa de la 'dud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dben par rab brten nas/ /rgyud sde'i snying po stong nyid snying rje la/ /bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa lhur blangs pas/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa rgyas mdzad de la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i snying po bshad sgrub gnyis po yis/ /bstan pa'i rin chen phyogs bcur gsal mdzad pas/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /bstan pa'i bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /le lo can rnams myur du bskul bya'i phyir/ /'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshegs nas/

/ri bo gru 'dzin dngul chu'i chos rdzong du/ /mya ngan 'das tshul bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya'i don du zhing gzhan gshegs pa ni/ /sku gzugs ring bsrel mang pos zhing 'di yi/ /gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad phyir/ /sku gzugs ring bsrel sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi rtag snying po med pa'i lus srog la/ /'jigs med rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo 'di yis/ /ci byas tshe 'di'i mdun mar song lags pas/ /tshe 'di blo yis thong par byin gyis rlobs/ /btsan dug lta bu'i kun 'byung 'khor ba 'di/ /bdud rtsi lta bur zhim par 'dzin pa'i blos/ /srid pa'i zhen pa spong par ma nus pas/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /thogs med dus kyi drin can pha ma rnams/ /yal bar bor nas rang don lhur len 'dis/ /gzhan don bsam sbyor phun tshogs ma skyes pas/ /smon 'jug byang sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i bden med snang ba la/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gis bden par 'dzin pa'i blos/ /thog ma med nas 'khor bar bcings lags pa/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rin chen bzang la de dpon mkhas pa bzhin/ /dam pa rnams la khyod thugs lhag par dges/ /shang shong dma' ba'i phyogs su chu rgyun bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs rje dma' la rtag par 'jug /gangs ri'i rtse na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /chen po rnams kyi gtsug na lhag par mdzes*/ /bu sdug smyo bar gyur la ma bzhin du/ /log par bsgrubs la'ang khyod thugs brtse ba can/ /'di la ltos pa'i bu rnams mya ngan gyis/ /rab tu gdung ba'i ngud mo'i sgra 'byin zhing*/ /mchi ma'i char 'bebs sems ni klong po gyur/ /shing chad bzhin du lus ni sa la sdebs/ /snying gi bud shing mya ngan me yis bsregs/ /kye ma kyi hud 'di 'dra'i dus 'byung ba/ /mya ngan mchi mas sa gzhi chag chag btab/

/khyed ni dus gsum ma sgrib sa ler mkhyen/ /'di 'dra thugs kyi bzod dam chos kyi rje/ /khyed sku 'od stong ldan pa zhing gzhan gshegs/ /ma rig mun pa'i klong 'khyam bdag cag rnams/ /mtsho skam drung du ngang pa lhag pa 'dra/ /khyod ni dmigs pa'i yul du wal wal wal/ /rtsol med mchi ma'i chu rgyun zhaṃ zhaṃ zhaṃ/ /smre sngags 'byin pa'i 'o dod lhang lhang lhang*/ /dad cing mos pa'i yid ni dung dung dung*/ /'di 'dra thugs kyis bzod dam chos kyi rje/ /khyed nyid ma rtogs re sa su 'dug gzigs/ /yongs 'dzin yid bzhin nor bu zhing gzhan gshegs/ /bdag blo dbul ba'i gdung ba su yi sel/ /khyed sku pad mo'i tshal rab mi snang na/ /dad ldan bung pa'i tshogs rnams su la 'khor/ /bshes gnyen thams cad mkhyen pa zhing gzhan gshegs/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams su yis skyong*/ /yongs 'dzin lha dbang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /theg chen chos kyi char pa su yis 'bebs/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon shing zhing gzhan gshegs/ /chos dang zang zing 'bras bu gang las len/ /'jig rten dbang po rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ /bdag sogs mgon med skyabs med su la re/ /kye ma chos rje da rung sa phyogs 'dir/ /sngar bzhin byon nas bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /rjes su 'dzin cing thub pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mi mdzad dam/ /bdag kyang 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /srid pa'i bde la chags par mi byed cing*/ /rang nyid zhi bde don du mi gnyer bar/ /khyed bzhin 'gro ba'i don la rtson par shog /tshe rabs kun du khyed sku'i grib ma bzhin/ /rjes su 'brang zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs par mthung nas 'khor gyi nang nas kyang*/ /sras kyi thu bo dam pa byed par shog /skye zhing skye ba rtag par thams cad du/ /rigs bzang gzugs mdzes bla ma la gus shing*/ /shes rab snying rje ting 'dzin mngon shes sogs/

/yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod gyur cig /bdag gi dge ba dus gsum ci bsags pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don chen sgrub pa'i phyir/ /kun tu bzang dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis/ /ji ltar spyad bzhin bdag kyang spyod par shog /mdor na dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam ji snyed pa/ /bdag nyid byang chub snying por mchis pa'i tshe/ /de dag thams cad bdag gi spyod par shog /gang dag bdag la dad dang sdang ba dang*/ /bstod dang smod dang phan dang gnod byed dang*/ /gang gi bdag thos mthong dang dran pa rnams/ /thams cad myur du byang chub thob par shog /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin chen dang*/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe 'phrin las dang*/ /sems can rnams kyis bsam pa dge ba dang*/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar shog / rgyal ba rgya mtsho rab tu mchod pa dang*/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho ma lus sbyang byed cing*/ /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni smin byed pa'i/ /smon lam rgya mtsho myur du 'grub par shog /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes kyang bya/ rgyal sras lag len gy-i don gyi 'grel pa byed par bshad pa pad mo'i tshal ces kyang bya ba/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i don du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid la mos pa dang gus pa lhur len pa/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyis/ phag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la ri bo gru 'dzin dngul chu'i dben gnas su bkod pa'o// // dge'o// //
